Bava Metzia 33a:18-33b:5: Tanu rabbanan: haoskin bemikra – midda veenah midda, bammishna – midda venotlin aleha sachar, battalmud – en lach midda gedola mizzo, uleolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud.
Ha gufa kashya. amrat battalmud en lecha midda gedola mizzo, vahadar amrat: uleolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud! amar rabbi yochanan:
Bime rabbi nishnet mishna zo, shevaku kulle alma matnitin vaazalu batar talmuda, hadar derash lehu: uleolam heve ratz lammishna yoter min hattalmud.
May derush? kiddaresh rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay, may dichtiv: "hagged leammi pisham ulevet yaakov chattotam"?

"Hagged leammi pisham" – ellu talmide chachamim, sheshshegagot naasot lahem kizdonot. "ulevet yaakov chattotam" – ellu amme haaretz, shezzedonot naasot lahem kishgagot. vehayeynu ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: heve zahir battalmud, sheshshiggat talmud ola zadon.

Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: may dichtiv "shimu devar Adonai hacharedim el devaro" – ellu talmide chachamim, "[amru] achechem" – ellu baale mikra, "sonechem" – ellu baale mishna, "menaddechem" – ellu amme haaretz.
Shemma tomar pasak sivram uvatal sikkuyam? talmud lomar: "venire besimchatchem". shemma tomar yisrael yevoshu? talmud lomar: "vehem yevoshu", ummot haolam yevoshu veyisrael yismachu.
Berakhot 6a:7-16: Tanya, abba binyamin omer: en tefilla shel adam nishmaat ella bevet hakkeneset, shenneemar: "lishmoa el harinna veel hattefilla". bimkom rinna — sham tehe tefilla.
Amar ravin bar rav adda, amar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu matzuy bevet hakkeneset — shenneemar: "elohim nitztzav baadat el".
Uminnayin laasara shemmitpallelin sheshshechina immahem — shenneemar: "elohim nitztzav baadat el".
Uminnayin lishlosha sheyyoshvin baddin sheshshechina immahem, shenneemar: "bekerev elohim yishpot".
Uminnayin lishnayim sheyyoshvin veoskin battora sheshshechina immahem — shenneemar: "az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai" vegomer.
May "ulechoshve shemo"? amar rav ashe: chashav adam laasot mitzva, veneenas, velo asaah — maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah.
Uminnayin sheafillu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora sheshshechina immo — shenneemar: "bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha".
Vechi meachar daafillu chad, tere mibbaya?! tere — mikkatvan millayyhu besefer hazzichronot, chad — la mikkatvan milleh besefer hazzichronot.
Vechi meachar daafillu tere, telata mibbaya?! mahu detema: dina shelama bealma hu, vela atya shechina, kamashma lan dedina name hayeynu tora.
Vechi meachar daafillu telata, asara mibbaya?! asara — kadma shechina veatya. telata — ad deyatvi.
I Kings 2:1-6: Vayyikrevu yeme-david lamut vaytzav et-shelomo veno lemor
Anochi holech bederech kol-haaretz vechazakta vehayita leish
Veshamarta et-mishmeret ׀ Adonai elohecha lalechet bidrachav lishmor chukkotav mitzvotav umishpatav veedvotav kakkatuv betorat moshe lemaan taskil et kol-asher taase veet kol-asher tifne sham
Lemaan yakim Adonai et-devaro asher dibber alay lemor im-yishmeru vanecha et-darkam lalechet lefanay beemet bechol-levavam uvechol-nafsham lemor lo-yikkaret lecha ish meal kisse yisrael

Vegam atta yadata et asher-asa li yoav ben-tzeruya asher asa lishne-sare tzivot yisrael leavner ben-ner velaamasa ven-yeter vayyahargem vayyasem deme-milchama beshalom vayyitten deme milchama bachagorato asher bemotnav uvenaalo asher beraglav
Veasita kechochmatecha velo-tored sevato beshalom sheol
I Kings 2:11-15: Vehayyamim asher malach david al-yisrael arbaim shana bechevron malach sheva shanim uvirushala͏m malach sheloshim veshalosh shanim
Ushelomo yashav al-kisse david aviv vattikkon malchuto meod {s}
Vayyavo adoniyyahu ven-chaggit el-bat-sheva em-shelomo vattomer hashalom boecha vayyomer shalom
Vayyomer davar li elayich vattomer dabber
Vayyomer at yadaat ki-li hayta hammelucha vealay samu chol-yisrael penehem limloch vattissov hammelucha vattehi leachi ki meAdonai hayta lo
I Kings 2:16-21: Veatta sheela achat anochi shoel meittach al-tashivi et-panay vattomer elav dabber
Vayyomer imri-na lishlomo hammelech ki lo-yashiv et-panayich veyitten-li et-avishag hashshunammit leishsha
Vattomer bat-sheva tov anochi adabber alecha el-hammelech
Vattavo vat-sheva el-hammelech shelomo ledabber-lo al-adoniyyahu vayyakom hammelech likratah vayyishtachu lah vayyeshev al-kiso vayyasem kisse leem hammelech vatteshev limino
Vattomer sheela achat ketanna anochi shoelet meittach al-tashev et-panay vayyomer-lah hammelech shaali immi ki lo-ashiv et-panayich
Vattomer yuttan et-avishag hashshunammit laadoniyyahu achicha leishsha
I Kings 2:22-26: Vayyaan hammelech shelomo vayyomer leimmo velama at shoelet et-avishag hashshunammit laadoniyyahu veshaali-lo et-hammelucha ki hu achi haggadol mimmenni velo uleevyatar hakkohen uleyoav ben-tzeruya {p}
Vayyishshava hammelech shelomo baAdonai lemor ko yaase-li elohim vecho yosif ki venafsho dibber adoniyyahu et-haddavar hazze
Veatta chay-Adonai asher hechinani (vayvasheybeyney) [vayyoshivani] al-kisse david avi vaasher asa-li bayit kaasher dibber ki hayyom yumat adoniyyahu
Vayyishlach hammelech shelomo beyad benayahu ven-yehoyada vayyifga-bo vayyamot {s}
Uleevyatar hakkohen amar hammelech anatot lech al-sadecha ki ish mavet atta uvayyom hazze lo amitecha ki-nasata et-aron adonay Adonai lifne david avi vechi hitannita bechol asher-hitanna avi
I Kings 2:7-10: Velivne varzillay haggiladi taase-chesed vehayu beochle shulchanecha ki-chen karvu elay bevorchi mippene avshalom achicha
Vehinne immecha shimi ven-gera ven-hayemini mibbachurim vehu killani kelala nimretzet beyom lechti machanayim vehu-yarad likrati hayyarden vaeshshava lo vaAdonai lemor im-amitcha becharev
Veatta al-tenakkehu ki ish chacham atta veyadata et asher taase-lo vehoradta et-sevato bedam sheol
Vayyishkav david im-avotav vayyikkaver beir david {p}
Mishnah Meilah 2:8-3:2: Hammenachot, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. kadshu vakkeli, huchsheru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. karav hakkometz, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame. veen moalin bashsheyarim, aval moalim bakkometz ad sheyyetze levet haddashen:

Hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, umenachot kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachin, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. kadshu vakkeli, huchsheru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina, vechayyavin alehen mishshum notar umishshum tame, ufiggul en bahen. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyesh lo mattirin, en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame, ad sheyyikrevu mattirav. vechol sheen lo mattirin, kevan shekkadash bakkeli, chayyavin alav mishshum notar umishshum tame, ufiggul en bo:

Velad chattat utemurat chattat vechattat shemmetu vealeha, yamutu. sheavra shenatah, vesheavda veshennimtzet baalat mum, im mishshekkipperu habbealim, tamut, veenah osa temura, velo nehenim, velo moalin. veim ad shello chipperu habbealim, tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi vedameha acheret, veosa temura, umoalim bah:

Hammafrish maot linziruto, lo nehenin velo moalin, mippene shehen reuyin lavo chullan shelamim. met, hayu setumim, yippelu lindava. hayu meforashim, deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenim velo moalin bahen. deme ola, yaviu ola umoalin bahen. udeme shelamim, yaviu shelamim, veneechalim leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem:
Mishnah Meilah 3:3-6: Rabbi yishmael omer, haddam, kal bitchillato vechamur besofo, vehannesachim, chomer bitchillatan vekal besofan. haddam, battechilla en moalim bo. yatza lenachal kidron, moalim bo. hannesachim, battechilla moalim bahen. yatzu lashshitin, en moalim bahem:

Dishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora, lo nehenin velo moalin. hammakdish dishshun battechilla, moalim bo. torim shello higgia zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan, lo nehenim velo moalim. rabbi shimon omer, torin shello higgia zemannan, moalin bahen. uvene yona sheavar zemannan, lo nehenin velo moalin:

Chalev hammukdashin uvetze torin, lo nehenin velo moalim. bamme devarim amurim, bekadshe mizbeach. aval bekadshe vedek habbayit, hikdish tarnegolet, moalin bah uvevetzatah. chamor, moalin bah uvachalavah:

Kol harauy lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit, levedek habbayit velo lammizbeach, lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit, moalin bo. ketzad, hikdish bor male mayim, ashpa melea zevel, shovach male yonim, ilan male ferot, sade melea asavim, moalin bahem uvema shebbetochan. aval im hikdish bor veachar kach nitmalle mayim, ashpa veachar kach nitmala zevel, shovach veachar kach nitmalle yonim, ilan veachar kach nitmalle ferot, sade veachar kach nitmala asavim, moalin bahen, veen moalin bema shebbetochan, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi shimon omer, hammakdish sade veilan, moalin bahem uvegiddulehem, mippene shehen giddule hekdesh. velad meusseret lo yinak min hameusseret. vaacherim mitnaddevim ken. velad mukdashin lo yinak min hammukdashin. vaacherim mitnaddevim ken. happoalim lo yochlu miggerogarot shel hekdesh. vechen para lo tochal mikkarshine hekdesh:
Mishnah Meilah 3:7-4:3:
Sharshe ilan shel hedyot bain beshel hekdesh veshel hekdesh bain beshel hedyot, lo nehenin velo moalin. hammayan shehu yotze mittoch sede hekdesh, lo nehenin velo moalin. yatza chutz lassade, nehenin mimmennu. hammayim shebbechad shel zahav, lo nehenin velo moalin. nittenu vitzlochit, moalin bahem. arava, lo nehenin velo moalin. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, notnin hayu mimmenna zekenim belulevehem:  
Ken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh, lo nehenin velo moalin. shebbaashera, yattiz bekane. hammakdish et hachoresh, moalin bechullo. haggizbarim shellakchu et haetzim, moalin baetzim, veen moalin lo vashshippuy velo vanneviyya:  
Kadshe hammizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila, ulechayyev alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. kadshe vedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze. kadshe hammizbeach vekadshe vedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze limila: 
Chamishsha devarim baola mitztarfin ze im ze. habbasar, vehachelev, vehassolet, vehayyayin, vehashshamen. veshishsha battoda. habbasar, vehachelev, vehassolet, vehayyayin, vehashshemen, vehallachem. hatteruma, uterumat maaser, uterumat maaser shel demay, hachalla, vehabbikkurim, mitztarfin ze im ze leesor ulechayyev alehen et hachomesh: 
Kol happiggulin mitztarfin ze im ze. kol hannotarin mitztarfin ze im ze. kol hannevelot mitztarfot zo im zo. kol hashsheratzim mitztarfin ze im ze. dam hashsheretz uvesaro mitztarfin. kelal amar rabbi yehoshua, kol shettumato veshiuro shavin, mitztarfin ze im ze. tumato velo shiuro, shiuro velo tumato, lo tumato velo shiuro, en mitztarfin ze im ze:
Mishnah Meilah 4:4-5:1:
Happiggul vehannotar en mitztarfin ze im ze, mippene shehem shene shemot. hashsheretz vehannevela, vechen hannevela uvesar hammet, en mitztarfin ze im ze letamme afillu chakkal shebbishnehem. haochel shennitma veav hattuma veshennitma vivlad hattuma, mitztarfin ze im ze letamme chakkal shebbishnehem: 
Kol hoochalin mitztarfin, lifsol et haggeviyya vechachatzi feras, bimzon shete seuddot laeruv, bechabbetza letamme tumat ochalin, bechaggerogeret lehotzaat shabbat, bechakkotevet beyom hakkippurim. kol hammashkin mitztarfin, lifsol et haggeviyya virviit, uvimlo lugmav beyom hakkippurim: 
Haarla vechile hakkerem mitztarfin ze im ze. rabbi shimon omer, enan mitztarfin. habbeged vehassak, hassak vehaor, haor vehammappatz, mitztarfin ze im ze. rabbi shimon omer, mippene shehen reuyin littamme moshav: 
Hannehene shave feruta min hahekdesh, af al pi shello fagam, maal, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, kol davar sheyesh bo fegam, lo maal ad sheyyifgom. vechol davar sheen bo fegam, kevan shennehena, maal. ketzad. natna katla vetzavvarah, tabbaat beyadah, shatta vechos shel zahav, kevan shennehenet, maala. lavash bechaluk, kissa vetallit, bikka bekurdom, lo maal ad sheyyifgom. talash min hachattat keshehi chayya, lo maal ad sheyyifgom. keshehi meta, kevan shennehena, maal:
Mishnah Meilah 5:2-5:
Nehena vechachatzi feruta ufagam bechachatzi feruta, o shennehena veshave feruta bedavar echad ufagam beshave feruta bedavar acher, hare ze lo maal, ad shennehene veshave feruta veyifgom beshave feruta bedavar echad: 
En moel achar moel bammukdashin, ella vehema uchele sharet. ketzad. rachav al gabbe vehema uva chavero verachav uva chavero verachav, shata vechos shel zahav uva chavero veshata uva chavero veshata, talash min hachattat uva chavero vetalash uva chavero vetalash, kullan maalu. rabbi omer, kol sheen lo fidyon, yesh bo moel achar moel: 
Natal even o kora shel hekdesh, hare ze lo maal. netanah lachavero, hu maal vachavero lo maal. benaah betoch beto, hare ze lo maal, ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave feruta. natal peruta shel hekdesh, hare ze lo maal. netanah lachavero, hu maal vachavero lo maal. netanah labballan, af al pi shello rachatz, maal, shehu omer lo, hare merchatz petucha, hikkanes urechotz: 
Achilato vaachilat chavero, hanayato vahanayat chavero, achilato vahanayat chavero, hanayato vaachilat chavero, mitztarfin ze im ze, vaafillu lizman merubbe:
Mishnah Meilah 6:1-5:
Hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto, baal habbayit maal. lo asa shelichuto, hashshaliach maal. ketzad. amar lo, ten basar laorchim venatan lahem kaved, kaved venatan lahem basar, hashshaliach maal. amar lo, ten lahem chaticha chaticha, vehu amar tolu shetayim shetayim, vehem natlu shalosh shalosh, kullan maalu. amar lo, have li min hachallon o miggeluskema, vehevi lo, af al pi sheamar baal habbayit lo haya velibbi ella mizze vehevi mizze, baal habbayit maal. aval im amar lo, have li min hachallon vehevi lo miggeluskema, o min geluskema vehevi lo min hachallon, hashshaliach maal: 
Shalach beyad cheresh, shote, vekatan, im asu shelichuto, baal habbayit maal. lo asu shelichuto, hachenvani maal. shalach beyad pikkeach, venizkar ad shello higgia etzel hachenvani, hachenvani maal kesheyyotzi. ketzad yaase. notel peruta o cheli veyomar, peruta shel hekdesh bechol makom shehi, mechullelet al ze, shehahekdesh nifde vechesef uveshave chasef: 
Natan lo feruta, amar lo, have li vechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot, halach vehevi lo vechullah nerot o vechullah petilot, o sheamar lo, have li vechullah nerot o vechullah petilot, halach vehevi lo vechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot, shenehem lo maalu. aval im amar lo, have li vechetzyah nerot mimmakom peloni uvechetzyah petilot mimmakom peloni, vehalach vehevi lo nerot mibbet petilot ufetilot mibbet nerot, hashshaliach maal: 
Natan lo shete ferutot, amar lo, have li etrog, vehalach vehevi lo vifruta etrog uvifruta rimmon, shenehem maalu. rabbi yehuda omer, baal habbayit lo maal, shehu omer lo, etrog gadol hayiti mevakkesh veheveta li katan vara. natan lo dinar zahav, amar lo have li chaluk, vehalach vehevi lo vishlosha chaluk uvishlosha tallit, shenehem maalu. rabbi yehuda omer, baal habbayit lo maal, shehu omer lo, chaluk gadol hayiti mevakkesh veheveta li katan vara: 
Hammafkid maot etzel hashshulchani, im tzerurin, lo yishtammesh bahem. lefichach, im hotzi, maal. im muttarim, yishtammesh bahen. lefichach, im hotzi, lo maal. etzel baal habbayit, ben kach uven kach, lo yishtammesh bahem. lefichach, im hotzi, maal. hachenvani kevaal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, keshulchani:
Mishnah Nazir 2:10-3:4:
Hareni nazir lichsheyyehe li ven, venazir mea yom. nolad lo ven ad shivim, lo hifsid kelum. leachar shivim, soter shivim, sheen tiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom: 
Mi sheamar hareni nazir, megalleach yom sheloshim veechad. veim gillach leyom sheloshim, yatza. hareni nazir sheloshim yom, im gillach leyom sheloshim lo yatza: 
Mi shennazar shete neziriyyot, megalleach et harishona yom sheloshim veechad, veet hashsheniyya yom shishshim veechad. veim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim, megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim. veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad, yatza. vezo edut heid rabbi pappeyas al mi shennazar shete neziriyyot, sheim gillach et harishona sheloshim yom, megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim. veim gillach leyom shishshim chaser echad, yatza, sheyyom sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan: 
Mi sheamar hareni nazir, nitma yom sheloshim, soter et hakkol. rabbi eliezer omer, eno soter ella shiva. hareni nazir sheloshim yom, nitma yom sheloshim, soter et hakkol: 
Hareni nazir mea yom, nitma yom mea, soter et hakkol. rabbi eliezer omer, eno soter ella sheloshim. nitma yom mea veechad, soter sheloshim yom. rabbi eliezer omer, eno soter ella shiva:
Mishnah Nazir 3:5-4:1:
Mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, afillu haya sham sheloshim yom, en olin lo min hamminyan veeno mevi karban tuma. yatza venichnas, olin lo min hamminyan umevi karban tuma. rabbi eliezer omer, lo vo vayyom, shenneemar (Bamidbar 6) vehayyamim harishonim yippelu, ad sheyyihyu lo yamim rishonim: 
Mi shennazar nezirut harebe vehishlim et neziruto, veachar kach ba laaretz, bet shammay omrim, nazir sheloshim yom, uvet hillel omrim, nazir battechilla. maase vehilni hammalka, shehalach benah lammilchama, veamra, im yavo veni min hammilchama veshalom ehe nezira sheva shanim, uva venah min hammilchama, vehayta nezira sheva shanim. uvesof sheva shanim alta laaretz, vehoruha vet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot. uvesof sheva shanim nitmet, venimtzet nezira esrim veachat shana. amar rabbi yehuda, lo hayta nezira ella arba esre shana: 
Mi shehayu shete chitte edim meidot oto, ellu meidim shennazar shetayim, veellu meidim shennazar chamesh, bet shammay omrim, nechleka haedut veen kan nezirut. uvet hillel omrim, yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim, sheyyehe nazir shetayim: 
Mi sheamar hareni nazir, veshama chavero veamar vaani, vaani, kullam nezirin. huttar harishon, hutteru chullan. huttar haacharon, haacharon muttar vechullam asurin. amar hareni nazir, veshama chavero veamar, pi chefiv useari chisaro, hare ze nazir. hareni nazir, veshama ishto veamra, vaani, mefer et shellah, veshello kayyam. hareni nezira, veshama balah veamar, vaani, eno yachol lehafer:
Mishnah Nazir 4:2-5:
Hareni nazir, vaat, veamra amen, mefer et shellah, veshello kayyam. hareni nezira, vaatta, veamar amen, eno yachol lehafer: 
Haishsha shennadra venazir, vehayta shota veyayin umittammea lemetim, hare zo sofeget et haarbaim. hefer lah balah vehi lo yada shehefer lah balah, vehayta shota veyayin umittammea lemetim, enah sofeget et haarbaim. rabbi yehuda omer, im enah sofeget et haarbaim, tispog makkat mardut: 
Haishsha shennadra venazir vehifrisha et behemtah veachar kach hefer lah balah, im shello hayta vehemtah, tetze vetire vaeder. veim shellah hayta vehemtah, hachattat tamut, veola tikrav ola, vehashshelamim yikrevu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem. hayu lah maot setumim, yippelu lindava. maot meforashim, deme chattat, yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenim velo moalim bahen. deme ola, yaviu ola, umoalim bahen. deme shelamim, yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem: 
Nizrak aleha echad min haddamim, eno yachol lehafer. rabbi akiva omer, afillu nishchata aleha achat mikkol habbehemot, eno yachol lehafer. bamme devarim amurim, betiglachat hattohora. aval betiglachat hattuma, yafer, shehu yachol lomar i efshi veishsha menuvvalet. rabbi omer, af betiglachat hattohora yafer, shehu yachol lomar i efshi beishsha megullachat:
Mishnah Nazir 4:6-5:3:
Haish maddir et beno venazir, veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir. ketzad, gillach o sheggillechuhu kerovav, micha o shemmichu kerovav, hayta lo vehema mufreshet, hachattat tamut veola tikrav ola vehashshelamim yikrevu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem. hayu lo maot setumin, yippelu lindava. maot meforashin, deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenin velo moalin. deme ola, yaviu ola umoalin bahen. deme shelamim, yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lachem: 
Haish megalleach al nezirut aviv veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha. ketzad. mi shehaya aviv nazir vehifrish maot setumim al neziruto umet, veamar hareni nazir al menat sheagallach al meot abba, amar rabbi yose, hare ellu yippelu lindava, en ze megalleach al nezirut aviv. ezehu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv, mi shehaya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot setumim linziruto umet, zehu shemmegalleach al nezirut aviv: 
Bet shammay omrim, hekdesh taut hekdesh. uvet hillel omrim, eno hekdesh. ketzad. amar, shor shachor sheyyetze mibbeti rishon hare hu hekdesh, veyatza lavan, bet shammay omrim hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh: 
Dinar zahav sheyyaale veyadi rishon hare hu hekdesh, veala shel kesef, bet shammay omrim hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh. chavit shel yayin shettaale veyadi rishona hare hi hekdesh, vealta shel shemen, bet shammay omrim hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh: 
Mi shennadar benazir venishal lechacham vaasaro, mone mishshaa shennadar. nishal lechacham vehittiro, hayta lo vehema mufreshet, tetze vetire vaeder. amru vet hillel levet shammay, i attem modim baze shehu hekdesh taut shettetze vetire vaeder. amru lahen bet shammay, i attem modim bemi shettaa vekara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri shehu mekuddash. amru lahem bet hillel, lo hashshevet kiddesho. uma illu taa vehinniach et hashshevet al shemini veal shenem asar, shemma asa chelum. ella katuv shekkiddesh et haasiri, hu kiddesh et hatteshii veet achad asar:
Mishnah Nazir 5:4-7:
Mi shennadar benazir vehalach lehavi et behemto umetzaah shennigneva, im ad shello nigneva vehemto nazar, hare ze nazir. veim mishshennigneva vehemto nazar, eno nazir. vezo taut taa nachum hammadi keshealu nezirim min haggola umatzu vet hammikdash charev, amar lahem nachum hammadi, illu heyitem yodim shebbet hammikdash charev heyitem nozrim. amru lo lo, vehittiran nachum hammadi. ucheshebba haddavar etzel chachamim, amru lo, kol shennazar ad shello charav bet hammikdash, nazir. umishshecharav bet hammikdash, eno nazir: 
Hayu mehallechin badderech veechad ba chenegdan, amar echad mehen hareni nazir shezze feloni, veechad amar hareni nazir sheen ze feloni, hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir, sheen echad mikkem nazir, sheshshenechem nezirim, shekkullechem nezirim, bet shammay omrim kullam nezirim. uvet hillel omrim, eno nazir ella mi shello nitkayyemu devarav. verabbi tarfon omer, en echad mehem nazir: 
Hirtia laachorav, eno nazir. rabbi shimon omer, yomar, im haya chidvaray, hareni nezir chova. veim lav, hareni nezir nedava: 
Raa et hakkoy veamar, hareni nazir shezze chayya, hareni nazir shezze eno chayya, hareni nazir shezze vehema, hareni nazir sheen ze vehema, hareni nazir shezze chayya uvehema, hareni nazir sheen ze lo chayya velo vehema, hareni nazir sheechad mikkem nazir, hareni nazir sheen echad mikkem nazir, hareni nazir shekkullechem nezirim, hare chullam nezirim:
Mishnah Nazir 6:1-4:
Shelosha minin asurin bannazir, hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggafen. vechol hayyotze min haggefen mitztarfin ze im ze. veeno chayyav ad sheyyochal min haanavim kazzayit. mishna rishona, ad sheyyishte reviit yayin. rabbi akiva omer, afillu shara fitto veyayin veyesh bah kede letzaref kazzayit, chayyav: 
Vechayyav al hayyayin bifne atzmo, veal haanavim bifne atzman, veal hachartzannim bifne atzman, veal hazzaggim bifne atzman. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, eno chayyav ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezaggan. ellu hen chartzannim veellu hen zaggim, hachartzannim ellu hachitzonim, hazzaggim ellu happenimim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, shello tite, kezog shel behema, hachitzon zog vehappenimi inbal: 
Setam nezirut sheloshim yom. gillach o sheggillechuhu listim, soter sheloshim yom. nazir sheggillach ben bezug ben betaar o shessifsef kol shehu, chayyav. nazir chofef umefaspes, aval lo sorek. rabbi yishmael omer, lo yachof baadama, mippene shemmashsheret et hassear: 
Nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tishte al tishte, vehu shote, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya megalleach kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach, vehu megalleach, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tittamma al tittamma, vehu mittamme, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
Mishnah Sheviit 4:1-4:
Barishona hayu omrim, melakket adam etzim vaavanim vaasavim mittoch shello, kederech shehu melakket mittoch shel chavero, et haggas haggas. mishsherabbu ovre avera, hitkinu sheyyehe ze melakket mittoch shel ze, veze melakket mittoch shel ze, shello vetova, veen tzarich lomar sheyyekatztzetz lahem mezonot: 
Sade shennitkavvetza, tizzara bemotzae sheviit. shennittayyeva o shenniddayyera, lo tizzara bemotzae sheviit. sade shennittayyeva, bet shammay omrim, en ochlin peroteha bashsheviit, uvet hillel omrim, ochlin. bet shammay omrim, en ochlin perot sheviit betova, uvet hillel omrim, ochlin betova veshello vetova. rabbi yehuda omer, chilluf haddevarim, zo mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel: 
Chochrin nirin min hannachrim bashsheviit, aval lo miyyisrael. umachazikin yede nachrim bashsheviit, aval lo yede yisrael. veshoalin bishloman, mippene darche shalom: 
Hammedel bazzetim, bet shammay omrim, yagom. uvet hillel omrim, yesharesh. umodim bemachalik, ad sheyyagom. eze hu hammedel, echad o shenayim. hammachalik, shelosha, ze vetzad ze. bamme devarim amurim, mittoch shello, aval mittoch shel chavero, af hammachalik, yesharesh:
Mishnah Sheviit 4:10-5:3:
Meematay en kotztzin et hailan bashsheviit. bet shammay omrim, kol hailan mishsheyyotzi. uvet hillel omrim, hecharuvin mishsheyyeshalshelu, vehaggefanim mishsheyyegaru, vehazzetim mishsheyyanetzu, ushear kol ilan mishsheyyotzi. vechol hailan, kevan shebba leonat hammaasrot, muttar lekatztzo. kamma yehe vazzayit velo yekutztzennu, rova. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol lefi hazzayit: 
Benot shuach, sheviit shellahen, sheniyya, shehen osot leshalosh shanim. rabbi yehuda omer, happarsaot, sheviit shellahen, motzae sheviit, shehen osot lishte shanim. amru lo, lo amru ella venot shuach: 
Hattomen et halluf bashsheviit, rabbi meir omer, lo yifchot missatayim, ad gova shelosha tefachim, vetefach afar al gabbav. vachachamim omrim, lo yifchot mearbaat kabbim, ad gova tefach, vetefach afar al gabbav. vetomno vimkom derisat adam: 
Luf sheavra alav sheviit, rabbi eliezer omer, im laktu haaniyyim et alav, lakatu. veim lav, yaase cheshbon im haaniyyim. rabbi yehoshua omer, im laktu haaniyyim et alav, lakatu. veim lav, en laaniyyim alav cheshbon:
Mishnah Sheviit 4:5-9:
Hammavkia bazzayit, lo yechappehu veafar, aval mechasse hu baavanim o vekash. hakkotzetz korot shikma, lo yechappehu veafar, aval mechasse hu baavanim o vekash. en kotztzin betulat shikma bashsheviit, mippene shehi avoda. rabbi yehuda omer, kedarkah, asur, ella o magbiah asara tefachim, o gomem meal haaretz: 
Hamezannev bigfanim vehakkotzetz kanim, rabbi yose haggelili omer, yarchik tefach. rabbi akiva omer, kotzetz kedarko, bakkardom o vammaggal, uvammegera, uvechol ma sheyyirtze. ilan shennifshach, koshrin oto bashsheviit, lo sheyyaale, ella shello yosif: 
Meematay ochlin perot hailan bashsheviit, happaggim mishsheyyazrichu, ochel bahem pitto bassade. bichalu, kones letoch beto. vechen kayyotze vahem bishar shene shavua, chayyav bammaasrot: 
Habboser, mishshehevi mayim, ochel bo pitto bassade. hivish, kones letoch beto. vechen kayyotze vo bishar shene shavua, chayyav bemaasrot: 
Zetim, mishsheyyachnisu reviit lisa, potzea veochel bassade. hichnisu chatzi log, kotesh vesach bassade. hichnisu shelish, kotesh bassade vechones letoch beto. vechen kayyotze vahem bishar shene shavua, chayyavim bemaasrot. ushear kol perot hailan, keonatan lammaasrot, ken onatan lashsheviit:
Mishnah Sheviit 5:4-7:
Luf shel erev sheviit shenichnas lashsheviit, vechen betzalim hakketzonim, vechen pua shel iddit, bet shammay omrim, okrin otan bemaarufot shel etz. uvet hillel omrim, bekardummot shel mattachot. umodim befua shel tzelaot, sheokrin otah bekardummot shel mattachot: 
Meematay muttar adam likkach luf bemotzae sheviit, rabbi yehuda omer, miyyad. vachachamim omrim, mishsheyyirbe hechadash: 
Ellu chelim sheen haumman rashshay lemachram bashsheviit, macharesha vechol keleha, haol, vehammizre, vehaddakar. aval mocher hu maggal yad umaggal katzir, vaagala vechol keleha. ze hakkelal, kol shemmelachto meyuchedet laavera, asur. leissur ulehetter, muttar: 
Hayyotzer, mocher chamishsha kadde shemen vachamishsha asar kadde yayin, shekken darko lehavi min hahefker. veim hevi yoter mikkan, muttar. umocher lenachrim baaretz, uleyyisrael bechutza laaretz:
Mishnah Sheviit 5:8-6:3: Bet shammay omrim, lo yimkor lo fara choreshet bashsheviit. uvet hillel mattirin, mippene shehu yachol leshachatah. mocher lo perot afillu bishat hazzera, umashil lo seato af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo goren, uforet lo maot af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo poalim. vechullan, beferush, asurin:

Mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur. aval lo tavor velo titchan immah. eshet chaver mashelet leeshet am haaretz nafa uchevara, uvoreret vetochenet umarkedet immah. aval mishshettattil hammayim, lo tigga etzlah, sheen machzikin yede ovre avera. vechullan lo amru ella mippene darche shalom. umachazikin yede nachrim bashsheviit, aval lo yede yisrael. veshoalin bishloman, mippene darche shalom:

Shalosh aratzot lashsheviit. kol shehecheziku ole vavel, meeretz yisrael vead keziv, lo neechol velo neevad. vechol shehecheziku ole mitzrayim, mikkeziv vead hannahar vead amana, neechol, aval lo neevad. min hannahar umeamana velifnim, neechol veneevad:

Osin betalush besureya, aval lo vimchubbar. dashim vezorin vedorchin umeammerin, aval lo kotzrin velo votzrin velo moskim. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol shekkayyotze vo muttar beeretz yisrael, osin oto besureya:

Betzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim vetzimmechu, im hayu healin shellahem shechorin, asurin. horiku, hare ellu muttarin. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, im yecholin lehittalesh bealin shellahen, asurin. ucheneged ken, motzae sheviit, muttarin:
Mishnah Sheviit 6:4-7:1: Meematay muttar adam likkach yarak bemotzae sheviit, mishsheyyaase chayyotze vo. asa habbakkir, huttar haafil. rabbi hittir likkach yarak bemotzae sheviit miyyad:
En motziin shemen serefa uferot sheviit mehaaretz lechutz laaretz. amar rabbi shimon, shamati veferush, shemmotziin lesureya veen motziin lechutz laaretz:
En meviin teruma mechutza laaretz laaretz. amar rabbi shimon, shamati beferush, shemmeviin missureya veen meviin michutza laaretz:

Kelal gadol amru bashsheviit, kol shehu maachal adam umaachal behema, umimmin hatztzovim, veeno mitkayyem baaretz, yesh lo sheviit uledamav sheviit, yesh lo biur uledamav biur. veeze ze, ale halluf hashshote, vaale haddandanna, haulshin, vehakkereshin, vehargila, venetz hechalav. umaachal behema, hachochim vehaddardarim. umimmin hatztzovim, sefiche istis, vekotza. yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit, yesh lahem biur velidmehen biur:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 2:10-11: Asur laadam lihyot achzari velo yitpayyes ella yehe noach lirtzot vekashe lichos uveshaa shemmevakkesh mimmennu hachote limchol mochel belev shalem uvenefesh chafetza. vaafillu hetzer lo vechata lo harebe lo yikkom velo yittor. vezehu darkam shel zera yisrael velibbam hannachon. aval haovde kochavim arle lev enan ken ella (veevratan) [veevrato] shemara netzach. vechen hu omer al haggivonim lefi shello machalu velo nitpayyesu vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma:

Hachote lachavero umet chavero kodem sheyyevakkesh mechila mevi asara bene adam umaamidan al kivro veyomar bifnehem chatati laAdonai elohe yisrael velifloni ze shekkach vechach asiti lo. veim haya chayyav lo mamon yachaziro layyorshim. lo haya yodea lo yorshin yannichennu bevet din veyitvadde:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 2:5-7: Veshevach gadol lashshav sheyyitvadde barabbim veyodia peshaav lahem umegalle averot shebbeno leven chavero laacherim veomer lahem amnam chatati lifloni veasiti lo kach vechach vahareni hayyom shav umitnachem. vechol hammitgae veeno modia ella mechasse peshaav en teshuvato gemura shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 28 13)</small> "mechasse feshaav lo yatzliach". bamme devarim amurim baaverot shebben adam lachavero aval baaverot shebben adam lammakom eno tzarich lefarsem atzmo veazzut panim hi lo im gillam. ella shav lifne hael baruch hu uforet chataav lefanav umitvadde alehem lifne rabbim setam. vetova hi lo shello nitgalla avono shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 32 1)</small> "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa":

Af al pi shehatteshuva vehatztzeaka yafa laolam. baasara hayyamim shebben rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim hi yafa beyoter umitkabbelet hi miyyad shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noah 6)</small> "dirshu Adonai behimmatzo". bamme devarim amurim beyachid aval tzibbur kol zeman sheosim teshuva vetzoakin belev shalem hem naanin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 7)</small> "chaAdonai elohenu bechol karenu elav":

Yom hakkippurim hu zeman teshuva lakkol layyachid velarabbim vehu ketz mechila uselicha leyisrael. lefichach chayyavim hakkol laasot teshuva ulehitvaddot beyom hakkippurim. umitzvat vidduy yom hakkippurim sheyyatchil meerev hayyom kodem sheyyochal shemma yechanek basseudda kodem sheyyitvadde. veaf al pi shehitvadda kodem sheyyochal chozer umitvadde belele yom hakkippurim arvit vechozer umitvadde beshacharit uvemusaf uvemincha uvinila. vehechan mitvadde. yachid achar tefillato usheliach tzibbur beemtza tefillato bivracha reviit:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 2:9: En hatteshuva velo yom hakkippurim mechapperin ella al averot shebben adam lammakom kegon mi sheachal davar asur o baal beila asura vechayyotze bahen. aval averot shebben adam lachavero kegon hachovel et chavero o hamekallel chavero o gozlo vechayyotze bahen eno nimchal lo leolam ad sheyyitten lachavero ma shehu chayyav lo viratztzehu. af al pi shehechezir lo mamon shehu chayyav lo tzarich leratztzoto velishl mimmennu sheyyimchol lo. afillu lo hiknit et chavero ella bidvarim tzarich lefayyeso velifgoa bo ad sheyyimchol lo. lo ratza chavero limchol lo mevi lo shura shel shelosha bene adam mereav ufogin bo umevakkeshin mimmennu. lo nitratztza lahen mevi lo sheniyya ushelishit. lo ratza menicho veholech lo veze shello machal hu hachote. veim haya rabbo holech uva afillu elef peamim ad sheyyimchol lo:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:1-2: Kol echad veechad mibbene haadam yesh lo zechuyyot vaavonot. mi shezzechuyyotav yeterot al avonotav tzaddik. umi sheavonotav yeterot al zechuyyotav rasha. mechetza lemechetza benoni. vechen hammedina im hayu zechuyyot kol yoshveha merubbot al avonotehen hare zo tzaddeket. veim hayu avonotehem merubbin hare zo reshaa. vechen kol haolam kullo:

Adam sheavonotav merubbin al zechuyyotav miyyad hu met berisho shenneemar al rov avonech. vechen medina sheavonoteha merubbin miyyad hi ovedet shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 20)</small> "zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba" vegomer. vechen kol haolam kullo im hayu avonotehem merubbin mizzechuyyotehen miyyad hen nishchatin shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 6 5)</small> "vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam". veshikkul ze eno lefi minyan hazzechuyyot vehaavonot ella lefi gadlam. yesh zechut shehi keneged kamma avonot shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 14 13)</small> "yaan nimtza vo davar tov". veyesh avon shehu keneged kamma zechuyyot shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 9 18)</small> "vechote echad yeabbed tova harebe". veen shoklin ella bedato shel el deot vehu hayyodea heach orchin hazzechuyyot keneged haavonot:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:3-4: Kol mi shennicham al hammitzvot sheasa vetaha al hazzechuyyot veamar belibbo uma hoalti baasiyyatan halevay lo asiti otan hare ze ibbed et kullan veen mazkirim lo shum zechut baolam shenneemar <small>(yechezkel log 12)</small> "vetzidkat hatztzaddik lo tatztzilennu beyom risho", en ze ella betohe al harishonot. ucheshem sheshshoklin zechuyyot adam vaavonotav bishat mitato kach bechol shana veshana shoklin avonot kol echad veechad mibbae haolam im zechuyyotav, beyom tov shel rosh hashshana. mi shennimtza tzaddik nechtam lechayyim. umi shennimtza rasha nechtam lemita. vehabbenoni tolin oto ad yom hakkippurim im asa teshuva nechtam lechayyim veim lav nechtam lemita:

Af al pi shettekiat shofar berosh hashshana gezerat hakkatuv remez yesh bo kelomar oro yeshenim mishshenatchem venirdamim hakitzu mittardematchem vechappesu bemaasechem vechizru bitshuva vezichru boraachem. ellu hashshochchim et haemet behavele hazzeman veshogim kol shenatam behevel varik asher lo yoil velo yatztzil, habbitu lenafshotechem vehetivu darchechem umaallechem veyaazov kol echad mikkem darko haraa umachashavto asher lo tova. lefichach tzarich kol adam sheyyire atzmo kol hashshana kullah keillu chetzyo zakkay vechetzyo chayyav. vechen kol haolam chetzyo zakkay vechetzyo chayyav. chata chet echad hare hichria et atzmo veet kol haolam kullo lechaf chova vegaram lo hashechata. asa mitzva achat hare hichria et atzmo veet kol haolam kullo lechaf zechut vegaram lo velahem teshua vehatztzala shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 10 25)</small> "vetzaddik yesod olam" ze shetztzadak hichria et kol haolam lizchut vehitztzilo. umippene inyan ze nahagu kol bet yisrael leharebot bitzdaka uvemaasim tovim velaasok bemitzvot merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim yeter mikkol hashshana. venahagu kullam lakum ballayla baasara yamim ellu ulehitpallel bevatte kenesiyyot bedivre tachanunim uvechibbushin ad sheyyeor hayyom:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:9-10:
Chelev shehitticho vekirve dagim shennimmochu noten letochan shemen kol shehu umadlik. aval shemanin sheen madlikin bahen afillu ervan bishmanim shemmadlikin bahen lo yadlik mippene sheen nimshachin: 
En madlikin beitran mippene sherecho ra shemma yannichennu veyetze vechova alav leshev leor hanner. velo botzori mippene sherecho tov shemma yikkach mimmennu min hanner veod mippene shehu af. velo beneft lavan vaafillu bechol mippene shehu af veyavo lide sakkana:
Niddah 15a:11-15: Umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa ketem, amar rav lemafrea, verabbi meir hi.
Ushemuel amar: mikkan ulehabba, verabbanan hi. mikkan ulehabba peshita!
Mahu detema: hoil umeet leet derabbanan, uchetamim derabbanan — ma meet leet lo metammea et boalah, af ketamim — lo metammea et boalah, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! hatam — en "shor shachut lefanecha", hacha — yesh "shor shachut lefanecha".
Vechen amar resh lakish: lemafrea, verabbi meir hi. rabbi yochanan amar: mikkan ulehabba, verabbanan hi.
Proverbs 10:31-11:4: Pi-tzaddik yanuv chochma uleshon tahpuchot tikkaret
Sifte tzaddik yedun ratzon ufi reshaim tahpuchot
Mozne mirma toavat Adonai veeven shelema retzono
Tummat yesharim tanchem veselef bogdim (vashedam) [yeshoddem]
Lo-yoil hon beyom evra utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet
Proverbs 11:14-19: Been tachbulot yippol-am uteshua berov yoetz
Ra-yeroa ki-arav zar vesone tokim boteach
Gomel nafsho ish chased veocher sheero achzari
Rasha ose feullat-shaker vezorea tzedaka secher emet
Proverbs 11:20-24: Toavat Adonai ikkeshe-lev uretzono temime darech
Yad leyad lo-yinnake ra vezera tzaddikim nimlat
Nezem zahav beaf chazir ishsha yafa vesarat taam
Taavat tzaddikim ach-tov tikvat reshaim evra
Yesh mefazzer venosaf od vechosech miyyosher ach-lemachsor
Proverbs 11:5-8: Tzidkat tamim teyashsher darko uverishato yippol rasha
Tzidkat yesharim tatztzilem uvehavvat bogdim yillachedu
Bemot adam rasha tovad tikva vetochelet onim avada
Tzaddik mitztzara nechelatz vayyavo rasha tachtav
Proverbs 11:9-13: Befe chanef yashchit reehu uvedaat tzaddikim yechaletzu
Betuv tzaddikim taalotz kirya uvaavod reshaim rinna
Bevirkat yesharim tarum karet uvefi reshaim tehares
Holech rachil megalle-sod veneeman-ruach mechasse davar
Shabbat 105a:2-5: Katav ot achat notarikon, rabbi yehoshua ben betira mechayyev vachachamim potrin. amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: minnayin lilshon notarikon min hattora, shenneemar: "ki av hamon goyim netatticha" — av netatticha laummot, bachur netatticha baummot, hamon chaviv netatticha baummot, melech netatticha laummot, vatik netatticha baummot, neeman netatticha laummot.
Rabbi yochanan dideh amar: "anochi", notarikon: ana nafshi ketavit yehavit. rabbanan amri: amira neima ketiva yehiva. ikka deamri "anochi" lemafrea: yehiva ketiva neemanin amareha.

Deve rabbi natan amri: "ki yarat hadderech lenegdi" — yara, raata, natta. deve rabbi yishmael tana: "karmel" — kar male. rav acha bar yaakov amar: "vehu killani kelala nimretzet", notarikon: noef hu, moavi hu, rotzeach hu, tzorer hu, toeva hu.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: "ma nedabber uma nitztaddak" — nechonim anachnu, tzaddikim anachnu, tehorim anachnu, dakkim anachnu, kedoshim anachnu.
Yevamot 105a:13-18: Kidrav shemuel bar amme. deamar rav shemuel bar amme amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin ligzar din sheyyesh immo shevua sheeno mitkarea, shenneemar: "lachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper avon bet eli bezevach uvemincha ad olam".

Amar rabba: bezevach uvemincha eno mitkapper, aval mitkapper hu bedivre tora. abbaye amar: bezevach uvemincha eno mitkapper, aval mitkapper bigmilut chasadim. rabba veabbaye middevet eli kaatu, rabba daasak battora — chaya arbein shenin, abbaye daasak betora uvigmilut chasadim — chaya shittin shenin.

Tanu rabbanan: mishpacha achat hayta birushalayim shehayu metim keven shemone esre shana. bau vehodiu et rabban yochanan ben zakkay. amar lahem: shemma mimmishpachat eli attem, shenneemar: "vechol marbit betcha yamutu anashim" — lechu veisku battora vetichyu. halchu veasku battora vechayu, vehayu korin otan "mishpachat yochanan" al shemo.
Amar rav shemuel bar uneya amar rav: minnayin ligzar din shel tzibbur sheeno nechtam? eno nechtam?! veha ketiv: "ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam avonech lefanay"!
Ella: minnayin sheafillu nechtam mitkarea — shenneemar: "mi chaAdonai elohenu bechol korenu elav", vehachtiv: "dirshu Adonai behimmatzo"! la kashya: ha beyachid, ha betzibbur.
Yachid emat? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim.
Zevachim 118a:15-118b:5: Kodshe kodashim. mena hane mille? amar rabbi oshaya, deamar kera: "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha bechol makom asher (atta) tire" – bechol makom asher tire i atta maale, aval atta ochel bechol makom sheatta roe.
Ema: bechol makom sheatta roe i atta maale, aval atta zoveach bechol makom shettire!
Amar rabbi yannay, amar kera: "sham taale... vesham taase".
Rabbi avdimi bar chassa amar, amar kera:
"Velo taanat shilo" – makom shekkol haroe oto mitanneach alav al achilat kadashim shello.
Rabbi avahu amar, amar kera: "ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin" – ayin shello ratzta lizzon velehanot middavar sheeno shello, tizke vetochal kimlo eneha.
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: "uretzon shochni sene" – ayin shello ratzta lehanot middavar sheeno shello, tizke vetochal ben hassenuin.

Tana: roe sheamru – roe kullo, velo hammafsik beno leveno. amar leh rabbi shimon ben elyakim lerabbi elazar, asbera lach: kegon be chenishta demaon. amar rav pappa: roe sheamru – lo roe kullo, ella roe miktzato.
Bae rav pappa: omed veroe, yoshev veeno roe – may? bae rabbi yirmeya: omed al gabbe hannachal veroe, (yoshev) betoch hannachal veeno roe – may? teku.
Zohar, Vayechi 16: Vaychi yaakov vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz vegomer, zakkain inun yisrael, yattir mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, dekudesha berich hu kara lon tzaddikim. leachsin lon yerutat almin bealma deate, leitanaga behahu alma, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titanneg al Adonai. may tama. begin demitdabbekin begufa demalka, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

Ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz, hay kera raza illaa ihu ben mechatzde chakla, deha beraza deaggadta tane ribbi shimon. deachsanat yeruta illaa dehahi eretz, let man deyarit lah, bar hahu deikre tzaddik. (sefer acher dehay eretz, velet man deyarit la, bar hahu deikre tzaddik, deha tzaddik yarit lematronita vadday) deha matronita beh itdabbekat leitbassema, vetzaddik yarit lematronita vadday.

Uf hacha, bachavivuta dekudesha berich hu leyisrael, amar, veammech kullam tzaddikim, uvegin kach leolam yirshu eretz, itchazun leyarit lematronita. may tama ikrun tzaddikim, umay tama yartin lematronita. begin deitgazzaru. kema detaninan, kol man deitgezar, veayyil behay (sefer acher berit kaddisha veayil behay) achsana, venatir lehay berit, al veitdabbak begufa demalka, veal behay tzaddik. uvegine kach ikrun tzaddikim, veal da leolam yirshu aretz. may aretz, da eretz hachayyim.

Ahadar veamar, netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. nitzer mattaay, anafa meinun anafin, denata kudesha berich hu kad bara alma. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:8) vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem, vehay eretz chad minnayyhu. begini kach, nitzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer.

Davar acher, veammech kullam tzaddikim, da yaakov uvenoy denachatu lemitzrayim ben am keshe kedal, veishtakkachu kullehu zakkain. uvegin kach ketiv, leolam yirshu eretz demmittamman seliku lirayt ara kaddisha.
Vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim, ammay parshata da setima. ribbi yaakov amar, beshata demit yaakov, istimu enehon deyisrael. ribbi yehuda amar, dichden nachatu legaluta, veishtabidu behon.

Ribbi shimon amar, ma ketiv leela, vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen vayyeachazu vah vayyifru vayyirbu meod. uchetiv vaychi yaakov, dela itchaze leafrasha ben da leda. ma inun kayyme betafnukin demalchin, vekabbilu innuga vechissufin legarmayyhu. uf yaakov name, kayyaym betafnuke malchin, beinnuga vechissufa legarmeh, la itperash da min da.

Vehacha ikre vaychi. deha kol yomoy la ikre vaychi, begin dechol yomoy betzaara havu, betzaara ishtakkechan, aleh ketiv, (iyyov 3:26) lo shalavti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez. batar denachat lemitzrayim, ikre vaychi. chama livreh malka, chama lechol benoy zakkain tzaddikin, vechullehu betaanuge vetafnuke alma, vehu yativ benihon kachamar tav deyativ al duredayyeh, keden ikre vaychi yaakov. vela parish ben vayyifru vayyirbu meod levaychi yaakov, vehachi itchaze.

Sheva esre shana, may tama sheva esre shana. ella amar rabbi shimon, kol yomoy deyaakov betzaara havu, betzaara aavar lon bekadmita, kevan dechama leyosef, vehava kaim kammeh, kad yaakov mistakkel beyosef, hava ishtelim benafsheh, keillu chama leimmeh deyosef. deshappiru deyosef dame leshappiru derachel. vehava dame begarmeh kema dela aavar aleh tzaara beyomoy.

Vechad yosef itperash minneh, keden itkeyyaym, lo shalavti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez. deda kashya leh leyaakov mikkol ma deavar, uvezimna deitperash yosef minneh, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 37:2) yosef ben sheva esre shana haya roe vegomer. vechol yomin deyaakov, la hava leh tzaara kehay, vehava bache kol yoma leinun sheva esre shana deyosef.

May kaativu leh, (Bereshit 46:4) veyosef yashit yado al enecha, ha lecha sheva esre shana ochoranin, beinnugin vetafnukin vahanaot vechissufin. hada hu dichtiv vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim sheva esre shana vegomer. tana, kol inun shenin, shechinta yekara dekudesha berich hu, immeh ishtakkecha, uvegin kach chayyim ikrun.

Ta chaze, ketiv vattechi ruach yaakov avihem, itchaze deha bekadmita mit hava hahu rucha dileh, vela hava mitkavven lekabbela rucha ochora. deha rucha dilela, la sharya berekanya. amar ribbi yose, shechinta la sharya, ella beatar shelim, vela beatar chaser, vela beatar pagim, vela beatar atziv, ella beatar deitkavvevn, beatar chadu. uvegin kach, kol inun shenin deyosef itperash meavoy, veyaakov hava atziv, la sharya beh shechinta.

Tana, amar ribbi elazar amar ribbi abba, ketiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana. leafaka, delet pulechana dekudesha berich hu, ella miggo chedva. deamar ribbi elazar, let shechinta sharya miggo atzvut, dichtiv (Melachim b 3:15) veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamenaggen. menaggen menaggen telat zimne ammay. begin leatara rucha mishlemuta decholla, dehu ruach shelema.

Amar ribbi abba, tamman taninan, mearba sitrin kolla ishtakkach, vechol sharashin deillain vetattain behu achidan. vetana da ayil veda nafik da satim veda parish, itachad chad bachavertah, veinun avahan decholla.

Ribbi shimon amar, (Devarim 10:15) rak baavotecha chashak Adonai, ketiv baavotecha, mammash telata, umashma dichtiv rak, rak mammash, umeillen mitparshan umitachadan kol shear ochoranin, vesalkin shema leitattera.
Zohar, Vayechi 32: Veshachavti im avotay, zakkaa chulekehon daavahata, dekudesha berich hu avid lon reticha kaddisha leela, veitree behu, leitattera immehon. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 10:15) rak baavotecha chashak Adonai vegomer. amar ribbi elazar, yaakov hava yada, deha ittura dileh baavahateh hu, deha ittura daavahan immeh hu, vehu immehon. veal da beatvavn gelifin taninan, 300 telat kishrin, teren kishrin, chad mehay sitra, vechad mehay sitra, vechad dechalil lon. veda hu detaninan, (Shemot 26:28-29) vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze, vehahu kishra divemtzaita, achid lehay sitra, ulehay sitra. veal hay ketiv, veshachavti im avotay vadday.

Veshachavti im avotay vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 42:18) hachershim shemau vehaivrim habbitu lirot. hachershim shemau, illen bene nasha dela tzayytin lemillule orayyta, vela pakchin udenayyhu, lemishma lefikkude demarehon. vehaivrim, dela mistakkelin leminda al ma inun kayymin. deha bechol yoma veyoma karoza nafik vekare, velet man deyashgach.

Detanya, inun yomin debar nash kad itbere, behahu yoma denafak lealma, kullehu kayymin bekiyyumayyhu. veazlin vetasin bealma, nachatin veazharan lebar nash, kol yoma veyoma bilchodoy. vechad hahu yoma ate veazhar leh, uvar nash avid behahu yoma chova kamme mareh. hahu yoma salik bechissufa, veashid sahaduta, vekaim bilchodoy levar.

Vetana, batar dekaim bilchodoy, yativ, ad devar nash avid minneh teshuva. zacha, tav hahu yoma leatreh. la zacha, hahu yoma nachit, veishtattaf behahu rucha dilvar, vetav leveteh. veittakkan bediukeneh dehahu bar nash mammash, begin leavasha leh, vedayyayr immeh beveta. veit dediyyura letav i hu zache. vei lav, diyyureh immeh levish.

Ben kach uven kach, itpakdan inun yomin vechaserim, vela alin beminyayna deinun deishtaaru. vavy lehahu bar nash, degara yomoy kamme malka kaddisha, vela shavik leela yomin, leitattera behu behahu alma, uleitkarva bahadayyhu kamme malka kaddisha.

Ta chaze, kad kerivu inun yomin kamme malka kaddisha. i hu zakkaa, hay bar nash denafik mealma, salik veal beinun yomin. veinun levushe yekar, demitlabbesha beh nishmateh. veinun yomin havu, dezacha behu, vela chav behu.

Vavy lehahu degara yomoy leela. dechad baan lealbasha leh beyomoy, inun yomin defagim ihu bechovoy, chasrin mehahu levusha, veitlabbash bemana chasera. kol sheken i saggiin inun, vela lehve leh lebar nash bamme deitlabbash behahu alma. keden vavy leh, vavy lenafsheh, dedayynin leh baggehinnam al inun yomin. yomin al yomin, yomin al chad terin. dechad nafik mehay alma, la ashkach yomin deitlabbash behu, vela have leh levusha bame deitkasse. zakkain inun tzaddikaya, deyomehon kullehon temirin inun legabbeh demalka kaddisha, veitavid minnayyhu levushe yekar, leitlabbesha behu bealma deate.

Taninan beraza dematnitin, may dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:7) vayyedu ki erummim hem, yedia yade mammash. dehahu levusha dikar, deitavid meinun yomin, gara minnayyhu, vela ishtaar yoma meinun yomin leitlabbesha beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:16) galmi rau enycha veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu. yamim yutzaru. yamim yutzaru vadday, velo echad bahem, deha la ishtaar chad minnayyhu leitlabbesha behu. ad deishtaddal adam, veavad teshuva, vekudesha berich hu kabbil leh, veavid leh mana (mane) levusha ochoranin, vela min yomoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:21) vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto katnot or vayyalbishem.

Ta chaze, beavraham dezacha, ma ketiv, (Bereshit kad) ba bayyamim, mishshum dezacha. kad istallak mehay alma, beinun yomin mammash dileh, al veitlabbash behu, vela gara mehahu levush yekar kelum, dichtiv ba bayyamim. beiyyov ma ketiv, (iyyov 1:21) vayyomer arom yatzati mibbeten immi vearom ashuv shamma. deha la ishtaar levusha leitlabbesha beh.

Tana, zakkain inun tzaddikaya, deyomehon zakkain, veishtaaru lealma deate (zakkain), vechad nafkin, mitchabberan kullehu, veitavidu levushe yekar, leitlabbesha beh. uvehahu levusha, zachan leitannaga meinnuga dealma deate, uvehahu levusha, zeminin laachayay ulemekam. vechol inun deit lehu levusha yekumun, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 38:14) vayyityatztzevu kemo levush. vavy leinun chayyayve alma, deyomehon bechovehon (almin) chasrin, vela ishtaar minnayyhu, bamme deitkasyayn, kad yifkun mealma.

Tana, kol inun zakkain, dezachu leitlabbesha bilvush yekar beyomehon, mitatteran behahu alma (sefer acher golma), meitture demitattere behu avahan, mehahu nachal denagid venafik leginta deeden. hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya moach) venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha vegomer. veinun chayyayve alma, dela zachu leitlabbesha bilvusha deyomehon, alayyhu ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:6) vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov veshachan charerim bammidbar.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov, derachatzanu yattir hava leh, dichtiv veshachavti im avotay. deezke behu vela beochora. deezke behu, leitlabbesha beyomin dileh, uveyomin dilhon.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ketiv, (Bereshit 27:27) vayarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu. begadav. bigde esav mibbae leh. deha lav dideh havu, ella deesav havu hanehu begadim. dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:15) vattikkach rivka et bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot, bigde esav ketiv (hacha), vehacha reach begadav, deyaakov mashma.

Ella, hachi okimna, vayyarach, kelomar, istakkal lehala, vearach recha dilvushoy dehahu alma, keden barcheh. veal da ketiv, ree reach beni kereach sade, da hu chakal detappuchin kaddishin. amar, hoil vezachita beinun levushe yekar, veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim. may mashma, begin divhahu chakal detappuchin kaddishin, natil (sefer acher natif) talla kol yoma, mehahu atar deikre shamayim, dichtiv mittal hashshamayim.

Amar ribbi yose, becholla barcheh, mittal hashshamayim umishmanni haaretz. may tama, begin devayyarach et reach begadav. begadav mammash, kema deokimna. tana, elef vachamash mea rechin, salkin bechol yoma miggan eden, demitbasseme behu inun levushin dikar dehahu alma, demitatteran min yomoy devar nash.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kamma levushin inun. amar ribbi elazar, ture (Vayikra amud alef amud bet) dealma, al da peligu. aval telata inun. chad demitlabbeshe behahu levusha, rucha divginta deeden deara. vechad yekara mikkolla, demitlabbesha beh nishmata bego tzerora dechayye, ben purepira demalka. vechad levusha dilvar, dekaim vela kaim, itchaze vela itchaze. behay mitlabbesha beh nafsha, veazla veshata bealma.
Uvechol resh yarche (shatta) veshabbatta, azlat veitkashsherat berucha divginta deeden deara, dekayyma ben pargoda yakkira, uminneh olif veyada ma deyada, veshat veoda leh bealma.

Tana, bitren kishshurin itkashshar nafsha, bechol resh yarcha veshabbatta, bekishshura derucha, di ben reche busemin divginta deeden deara, umittamman azil veshat, veitkashshar im rucha benishmata ditzrira bitzrora dechayye, umitravya umitzanat meinun zivin yekarin, dehay sitra, udehay sitra. hada hu dichtiv, venachacha Adonai tamid, tamid dayyka.

Vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha. mahu betzachtzachot. ella tzachuta chad, kad itkashshar berucha divginta diltatta, tzachuta dilgav min tzachuta, kad mitkashsheran benishmata dilela, bitzrora dechayye, vehayeynu betzach chad, tzachot teren, deinun leela leela, beyakkiru denishmata vadday, kelomar tzachtzachot, man yarit da, nafshecha. nafshecha mammash. zakkaa chulekehon detzaddikayay.

Amar rabbi shimon, kad ana ben inun chavrayay devavel, mitkanshe gabbay, veolfe mille beitgalleyay, veinun ayyle lon begushepanka defarzela takkifa, setima mikkol sitrin. kamma zimnin olifna lon archoy deginta demalka, orchoy demalka. (nusach acher kema zimnin amena lon archoy deorayyta demalka kaddisha veorchin illain).

Kamma zimnin olifna lon kol innun dargin detzaddikaya divhahu alma, vechullehu mistafe lememar millin illen, ella laan (maalaalayn) begimguma. begini kach pesilusin ikrun, kehahu pesiluta dimgamgem befumeh.

Aval lizchuta dainna lehu, hoil umistafe. deha avira kaddisha verucha kaddisha itade minnayyhu, veyanke meavira verucha dirshuta ochora. vela od ella dekeshet itchaze alayyhu, velav inun keday lemechome sever anpoy (sefer acher deeliyyahu), kol shekken sever anpin ochoranin.

Aval da mehaneya lehu, deana shechiach bealma veana simana (nusach acher samcha) bealma, deha bechayyay la yativ alma betzaara, vela itdan bedina dilela, batray la yakum dara kedara da. vezammin alma dela yishtakkach man deyagin alayyhu, vechol anpin chatzifin yishtakkechun ben leela ben letatta. leela, bechovayyhu diltatta, vachatzifuta dilhon.

Uzeminin beni alma detzavvchin, velet man deyashgach alayyhu. yehadderun resha lechol sitre alma, vela yetuvun beasvavta. aval chad asuta ashkachna lehu bealma vela yattir, behahu atar deyishtakkechun inun delaan beorayyta, veishtakkach benayyhu (Vayikra amud alef amud alef) sefer tora dela mishtakkar beh. kad mafke hay, begineh mitare illae vetattae. vechol shekken i achtiv beh shema kaddisha kedka chaze, veha olifna milla.

Vavy ledara deitgalleyay benayyhu sefer tora, vela mitare aleh leela vetatta. man itar aleh beshata dealma betzaara tefe, veitzterich alma lemitra, veitzterich leaglaa sefer tora yattir bedochaka dealma.

Dechad alma betzaara, uvaan bene nasha rachamin ale kivre, kullehu metin mitarin aleh, deha nafsha akdimat umodaa lerucha, deha sefer tora ishtakkach begaluta, deigle bedochaka dealma, vechayyay atan uvaan rachame.

Keden rucha moda linshama, uneshama lekudesha berich hu, ucheden kudesha berich hu itar, vechas al alma, veda al galuta desefer tora meatrih, vechayyay atin lemive rachamay al kivre metayay. vavy ledara i itzterich sefer tora leaglaa leh meatar leatar, afillu mibbe kenishta leve kenishta, deha la ishtakkach benayyhu al ma yishgechun alayyhu.

Veda la yadin kullehu bene nasha, deha shechinta kad itgalleyay galuta batraa. ad la tistallak leela, ma ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 9:1) mi yittenini bammidbar melon orchim. levatar bezimna dedachaka ishtakkach tefe bealma, tamman ishtakkechat, uvegaluta desefer tora, tamman hi, vecholla mitarin aleh, illae vetattae.

Amar ribbi shimon, i hanne bavlae tippeshae, yindeun millin deraze dechachmeta, al ma kaim alma, vesamchoy al ma ka mitraggeshan. kad yishtakkach bedochaka, yindeun shevacha derav (hamenuna) yeva sava. kad ishtakkach benayyhu, vela havu yade shivcheh. veha ashkachna milloy mitkashsheran bemilloy dishlomo malka, beraza illaa dechachmeta, veinun la havu yade shevacheh.

Vehasheta azlin batar mille dechachmeta, velet man dekaim alah, velet man dekare. veim kol da, it benayyhu pikchin beibbura deshatta uvikviuta deyarche, af al gav dela ityeyhiv lehu, vela itmasar bidayyhu.

Taninan, teresar yarche, hay nefesh ihi mitkashshera begufa bekivra, veitdanu bedina kechada, bar hahi nefesh detzaddikayay, kema deukemuha, uzemina bekivra, veyada betzaara dileh, uvetzaara dechayye yada (sefer acher lo yada), vela ishtaddelat alayyhu.
Ulevatar teresar yarche, itlabbash bilvusha chad, veazil veshat bealma, veyada min rucha ma deyada, veishtedal tzaara lealma, ulemibbae rachame. uleminda (lehu) tzaara dechayye.

Uman itar lechol hay, bezimna deit zakkaa, deoda lehu kedka yeut, vehahu zakkaa ishtemoda benayyhu. detanya, zakkaa kad ishtaar bealma, ben chayyay, uven metaya ishtemoda, deha kol yoma machreze aleh benayyhu, vechad tzaara tafe bealma, vehu la yachil laagana al dara, hu oda lehu tzaara dealma.

Vechad la ishtakkach zakkaa demachreze aleh benayyhu, vela ishtakkach (davar acher 33 benayyhu) man deitar lehu betzaara dealma, ella sefer tora. keden illae vetattae mitarin aleh, utzerichin kolla deyishtakkechun behahi zimna bitshuva. vei la mishtakkeche, ha mare dedina itarun alayyhu, veafillu ruach deginta deeden, mitarin alayyhu, begineh desefer tora, kidittemar.

Tana, veshachavti im avotay, begufa, benafsha, berucha, benishmata, birticha chada, bedarga illaa. amar ribbi yehuda, kamma atimin mikkolla bene alma, dela yade, vela mashgiche, vela shame, vela mistakkele bemille dealma. vehech kudesha berich hu mishtakkach alayyhu berachamin, bechol zeman veidan, velet man deyashgach.

Telat zimnin beyoma, al rucha chada bimarta dechafelta, venashiv bekivre avahata, veitseyayn kol garmin, vekayyme bekiyyuma, vehahu rucha nagid talla milleela, meresha demalka, atar demishtakkeche avahan illae. vechad mate (sefer acher matear) hahu talla minnayyhu, mitarin avahan diltatta.

Vetana, nachit hahu talla bedargin yedian, darga batar darga, umate legan eden diltatta. umehahu talla, itseche bevusemin deginta deeden. veitar rucha chada, dechalil bitren ochoranin vesalik veshat bene busemin, veayil befitcha dimarta, keden mitarin avahan, inun vezivugan, uvean rachame al benoy.

Vechad ishtakkach alma betzaara, begin deinun demichin al chove alma, vehahu talla la itnegid vela ishtakkach, ad deitar sefer tora, kedka chaze bealma. venafsha oda lerucha, verucha lenishmata, venishmata lekudesha berich hu. keden yativ malka bekurseyay derachame, venagid meattika kaddisha illaa, negidu detalla devadolcha. umate lerisha demalka, umitbarchin avahan. venagid hahu talla, leinun demichin, ucheden mitchabberan (nusach acher mitbarchan) kullehu, vechayis kudesha berich hu al alma. vetana, la chayis kudesha berich hu al alma, ad deoda laavahan uveginayyhu alma itbarcha. amar ribbi yose, vadday hachi hu, veha ashkachna mille besifra dishlomo malka, hahu illaa, dekara leh eta dechachmeta decholla.

Verav hamenuna, hachi galle veamar, deha achziyyu leh, deyattir avdat rachel, dekayyma befarashat orchin, bechol zimna deitzterich alma, mikkullehu. veraza demilla, aron vechapporet ucheruvim bechuleka devinyamin, deityelid beorcha, ushechinta al kolla:
Zohar, Vayechi 38: Hammalacha haggoel oti mikkol ra. ribbi elazar amar, kevan devarich yaakov veitkavvevn mittatta leela, keden amshich meela letatta, dichtiv haelohim haroe oti, kevan deihu natil, yahiv birchan lehay atar, kevan deamte birchan lehay atar, keden patach veamar hammalach haggoel vegomer.

Patach veamar, (Melachim 1 8:7) ki hakkeruvim porse kenafayim el mekom haaron vegomer. ta chaze, keruvim beat uvenisa havu kayyme, telat zimnin beyoma havu parse gadfehon, vesachche al arona letatta, dichtiv porse chenafayim, peruse la ketiv, ella porse.

Veta chaze, kudesha berich hu avid letatta kegavvna dilela, keruvim, diukena dilhon kechezu ravyayn, vekayymin techot hay atar, mimina umismala, veillen itbarchan bekadmita mehanehu birchan denagdan meela, umehacha nagde birchan letatta.

Veal da ketiv, hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra. oti, denatil birchan miggevavnin dilela, vechevan deihu natil, yevarech et hannearim, da raza dichruvim, deminnayyhu nagde birchan meilae letattae (vetattae):

Hammalacha haggoel oti mikkol ra yevarech et hannearim vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Mishlei 19:14) bayit vahon nachalat avot, vechi nachalat avot inhu, veha kudesha berich hu yahiv kolla lebar nash. ella, dechevan deachsin beta levar nash umamona, lezimnin deyachasin kolla livreh, vihe achsana deavot. aval umeAdonai ishsha maskalet, begin deitteta, kad achsin lah bar nash, meim kudesha berich hu achsin lah, deha la yachsin lah kudesha berich hu lebar nash, ella kad machrizin aleh birkia.

Dekudesha berich hu mezavvevg zivugin, ad la yetun lealma. vechad zachu bene nasha lefum ovadehon, hachi yahave lon itteta, vecholla itgalleyayn kammeh dekudesha berich hu, ulefum ovadin dezakkain, hachi mezavvivg ziuugin.

Ulezimnin deka seliku biklitin, veaste hahu bar nash archeh, salik ziuugeh leochora, ad deyichshar ovadoy, vechad yichshar ovadoy, o demate zimneh, itdache gevar mikkamme gevar, veate hay venatil dileh. veda kashe kammi kudesha berich hu mikkolla ledachya bar nash mikkamme gavra ochora, uvegin kach kudesha berich hu ihu yahiv itteta lebar nash, uminneh atyayn ziuugin. veal da umeAdonai ishsha maskalet.

Begin kach, kudesha berich hu yahiv kolla levar nash. vei tema ishsha maskalet vela ochora. ta chaze, af al gav dekudesha berich hu azmin tavan lebar nash lemehav leh, vehu aste archoy meim kudesha berich hu legabbe sitra ochora, mehahu sitra ochora deitdabbak beh, yete leh man deyete, bechol (nusach acher kol) kitrugin, vechol bishin, vela atyayn leh meim kudesha berich hu, ella mehahu sitra bisha deitdabbak beh, beinun ovadin deavad.

Veal da, itteta delav ihi maskelet, kara al da shelomo, (Kohelet 7:26) umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha. begin dechovoy debar nash, hu mashich aleh, beinun ovadin deavad. veal da kad kudesha berich hu itrae beh bevar nash, begin ovadoy dechashran, ihu azmin leh intu deihi maskelet, ufarik leh befurekan, miggo sitra ochora.

Veal da amar yaakov, hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra. may mikkol ra, dela izdammenat li itteta, deihi miggo sitra ochora, vela iara pesul bezari (sefer acher baarasey), dechullehu tzaddike usheleme bishlimu, begin deitperak mikkol ra, veyaakov la itdabbak behahu sitra ochora kelal.

Veal da, hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra yevarech et hannearim. may tama itchazu leitbarcha, begin denatir yosef at kayyayma kaddisha, veal da amar yosef banay hem asher natan li elohim baze, achme leh raza divrit denatar leh. uvegin denatar leh, itchazu leitbarcha veitchaze ihu levirchan saggiin. begin da lechullehu yahav bircha chad, uleyosef birchan saggiin, mashma dichtiv birchot avicha gavru al birchot horay vegomer, birchot shadayim varacham tihyena lerosh yosef.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Rosh Chodesh amud bet) (Tehillim 123:1) elecha nasati et enay hayyoshvi bashshamayim, hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, tzelota debar nash deitkavvevn bah, ihu leela leumeka illaa, demittamman nagde kol birchan vechol cheru, umittamman nafke lekayyma kolla.

Veal da yattir yod, begin dela pasik yod, meatar da lealmin. uvegin da ketiv, hayyoshvi bashshamayim, achid leela, beraza dechachmeta illaa, veachid letatta, deyativ al karseya deavahan, yativ al karseya deikre shamayim, uvegin kach hayyoshvi bashshamayim ketiv.

Umehacha, kad birchan nagde meela meumeka da, kullehu natil lon hay atar deikre shamayim, umehay nagde letatta, ad dematu letzaddikayyay keyayma dealma, umehacha mitbarchin kol inun chayyaylin, vechol inun mashshiryayn liznayyhu, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, beshivin uteren nehorin, istallak atara dechol mashshiryayn, iggula dealma, beshivin duchete, chad iggula lechullehu (leel 53 amud bet) bego hahu iggula nekuda chada dekayyma beemtzaita, mehay nekuda, ittezanat kol hahu iggula, bet kodesh hakkodashim, ihu atar lehahu rucha dechol ruchin (sefer acher hacha raza dechol razin) ittammar begavveh. hay temiru ihu bego chelaha, temira ihu bego lego, kad salka da, kolla salkin avatrah. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 1:4) mashcheni acharecha narutza.
Zohar, Vayechi 63: Amar ribbi yitzchak, ilmale la izdamman lan orcha da ella lemishma millin illen, day lan. amar ribbi yehuda, yaot hu lehay yenuka dela yinda kol hay, veana mistafina aleh. i yitkayyaym bealma begin hay. amar ribbi yitzchak velamma. amar leh, begin dehay ravya yachil leistakkela beatra delet reshu levar nash leistakkela beh. umistafina aloy, dead la yimte lefirkoy, yashgach veyistakkal veyaanshun leh.

Shama hahu yenuka. amar, la mistafina meonasha lealmin, deha beshata deistallik abba mealma, barich li vetzalle alay. vidana dizchuta deabba yagin alay. amru leh, uman hu avuch. amar, (nusach acher leta rav yehuda) bereh derav hamenuna sava, natlu leh, vearkevuha al kitfayyhu telat milin.
Karu aleh, (Shoftim 14:14) mehaochel yatza maachol umeaz yatza matok vegomer. amar lon hahu yenuka, milla ata lidayychu, parishu lah. amru leh, kudesha berich hu zammin lan archa dechayye, ema ant.

Patach veamar, mehaochel yatza maachol umeaz yatza matok. hay kera, asmachta it lan beh, mehaochel, da tzaddik, dichtiv, (Mishlei 13:25) tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho. tzaddik ochel vadday, venatil kolla, ammay, lesova nafsho. lemehav sava, lehahu atar deikre nafsho dedavid. yatza maachol, deilmale hahu tzaddik, la yippuk mezona lealmin, vela yachil alma lekayyma (beh). umeaz yatza matok, da yitzchak, devarich leyaakov betal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz.

Tu, af al gav decholla chad, ilmale tukefa dedina kashya, la nafka devash. man devash. da tora shebbeal pe, dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:11) umetukim middevash venofet tzufim. meaz, da tora shebbichtav, dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten. yatza matok, da tora shebbeal pe.

Azlu kechada telat yomin, ad dematu leturesa dekira deimmeh. kevan dechamat lon atkanit beta, veyatvu tamman telat yomin ochoranin. berchuhu, veazlu, vesidderu millin kammeh derabbi shimon. amar, vadday yerutat orayyta achsin, veilmale zechuta daavahan yitannash milleela, aval kudesha berich hu leinun deazlin batar orayyta, achsinu lah inun uvenayyhu lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 59:21) vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai ruchi asher alecha vegomer.
Zohar, Vayechi 68: Yissashchar chamor garem rovetz ben hammishpetayim. amar ribbi elazar, vechi yissashchar chamor ikre. i begin deishtaddal beorayyta, nikreyeh leh sus o arye, o namer, ammay chamor. ella amru, begin dachamor natil matula, vela bait bemareh kishar beire, vela it beh gassut haruach, vela chayyish lemishkav beatar mittakkan. uf hachi yissashchar, deishtaddeluteh beorayyta, natil matula deorayyta, vela bait beh bekudesha berich hu, vela it beh gassut haruach, kachamor dela chayish likara dileh, ella likara demareh (sefer acher derabbeh). rovetz ben hammishpetayim, kidamrinan veal haaretz tishan, vechayye tzaar tichye, uvattora atta amel.

Davar acher yissashkar chamor garem rovetz vegomer. patach veamar, (Tehillim 27:1) ledavid Adonai ori veyishi mimmi ira Adonai maoz chayyay mimmi efchad, kamma chavivin inun millin deorayyta, kamma chavivin inun demishtaddele beorayyta, kamme kudesha berich hu. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, la dachil mippige alma, natir hu leela, natir hu letatta. vela od, ella dechafit lechol pegie dealma, veachit lon leumeke dithoma rabba.

Ta chaze, beshata deal lelya, (leel 172 amud alef) patchin setimin, vechalbe vachamare sharyayn veshatan bealma, veityeyhivat reshu lechabbala, vechol bene alma nayyme bearsayyhu, venishmathon detzaddikayay salkin leitanaga leela. kad itar ruach tzafon, veitpelig lelya, itaruta kaddisha itar bealma, veittemar bechamma duchete.

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, deihu kaim behahi shata, veishtedal beorayyta. kevan deihu patach beorayyta, kol inun zinin bishin, ail lon benukeve dithoma rabba, vechafit leh lachamor, venachit leh betafsere ditchot afra, dezuhame kisra.

Begine kach, yissashchar, deishtaddeluteh beorayyta, kafet leh lachamor, venachit leh. mehahu geram hammaalot, deihu salik lenizka alma, veshavve madoreh ben hammishpetayim, ben zuhame detafseri deafra.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv. vayyar menucha ki tov veet haaretz ki naema vayyet shichmo lisbol vayhi lemas oved. vayyar menucha ki tov, da tora shebbichtav. veet haaretz ki naema, da tora shebbeal pe. vayyet shichmo lisbol, lemisbal ula deorayyta, uledavka bah yome velele. vayhi lemas oved, lemehve palach lekudesha berich hu, uleitdabbeka beh, uleattasha garmeh bah.

Ribbi shimon veribbi yose veribbi chiyyay havu ka azle miggalila illaa litverya, amar rabbi shimon, nehach venishtaddal beorayyta, dechol man deyada leishtaddela beorayyta, vela ishtaddal, itchayyev benafsheh. vela od ella deyahavin leh ula deara, veshibuda bisha, dichtiv beyissashochar, vayyet shichmo lisbol, mahu vayyet, sata. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 8:3) vayyattu achare habbatza. man desata archeh vegarmeh, dela lemisbal ula deorayyta, miyyad vayhi lemas oved.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle. zakkain inun bene alma, inun demishtaddele beorayyta, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, itrachim leela, veitrachim letatta, veachsin bechol yoma, yeruta dealma deate. hada hu dichtiv, lehanechil ohavay yesh. may yesh. da alma deate dela pasak memoy lealmin, venatal agar tav illaa, dela zache beh bar nash ochora, umay ihu. yesh. uvegine kach, ramiz lan shema deyissashochar deishtaddal beorayyta, yesh sachar. da hu agra deinun demishtaddele beorayyta, 310.

Ketiv, (Daniel 7:9) chaze havet ad di charsavavn remiv veattik yomin yetiv vegomer. chaze havet ad di charsavavn remiv, kad itcharav be makdesha, tere karsavavn naflu, tere leela, tere letatta. tere leela, begin deitrechikat tattaa meillaa, kurseyay deyaakov itrechikat mikkurseyay dedavid. vekurseyay dedavid naflat. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz. teri karsavavn letatta, yerushala 40, veinun mare deorayyta. vecharsavavn diltatta kegavvna decharsavavn dilela, marehon deorayyta hayeynu kurseyay deyaakov. yerushala 40 hayeynu kurseyay dedavid, veal da ketiv, ad di karsavavn, vela karseya. karsavavn saggiin naflu, vechullehu la naflu, ella meelbonah deorayyta.

Ta chaze, kad inun zakkae keshot mishtaddele beorayyta, kol inun tukefin dishar ammin, dishar chelin, vechol chelin dilhon, itkafyayn vela shalte bealma, veyisrael (nusach acher 316) izdamman alayyhu lesalka lon al kolla. vei la, chamor garma lon leyisrael lemehach begaluta, uleminpal bene ammemaya, ulemishlat alayyhu. vechol da ammay, begin, vayyar menucha ki tov, umittakna kammeh, veyachil lemirvavch beginah kamma tavin vechamma kissufin, vesata orcheh dela lemisbal ula deorayyta. vegin kach vayhi lemas oved.

Ketiv, (Shir hashshirim 6) haddudaim natnu reach veal petachenu kol megadim chadashim gam yeshanim vegomer. haddudaim natnu reach, (haddudaim) illen inun deashkach reuven. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 30:14) vayyimtza dudaim bassade, vela itchaddeshan mille deorayyta, ella al yedoy beyisrael, kema deat amer, (divre hayamim 1 12:33) umibbene yissashchar yode bina leittim vegomer.

Veal petachenu kol megadim, inun garmu lemeheve al petachenu, al pitche batte chenisiyyot uvatte midrashot, kol megadim. chadashim gam yeshanim, kamma mille chaddetan veattikin deorayyta, deitgalleyayn al yadayyhu, lekarva leyisrael laavuhon dilela. hada hu dichtiv, (divre hayamim 1 12:33) ladaat ma yaase yisrael.

(Shir hashshirim 7:14) dodi tzafanti lach. mehacha olifna, kol man deishtaddal beorayyta kedka yeut, veyada lemechede millin, ulechaddetute millin kedka yeut, inun millin salkin ad kurseyay demalka, ucheneset yisrael patach lon tarin, veganiz lon. uveshata deal kudesha berich hu leishtashea im tzaddikayyay beginta deeden, afikat lon kammeh, vekudesha berich hu mistakkel behu vechade, keden kudesha berich hu mitattar beitterin illain, vechade bematronita, hada hu dichtiv, chadashim gam yeshanim dodi tzafanti lach. umehahi shata, milloy ketivin besifra, hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:16) vayyikkatev sefer zikkarun lefanav.

Zakkaa chulakeh, man deishtaddal beorayyta kedka yeut, zakkaa hu behay alma, vezakkaa hu bealma deate. ad hacha shuletanuta dihuda, deroa deitkelil bechola, bechela dechol sitrin, telat kishrin didroa, leitgabbera al kolla:
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.
