Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Yadati veni yadati. shehu habbechor:
Gam hu yihye leam vegam hu yigdal. sheatid gidon latzet mimmennu, shehakkabba ose nes al yado:
Veulam achiv hakkaton yigdal mimmennu. sheatid yehoshua latzet mimmennu, sheyyanchil et haaretz vilammed tora leyisrael:
Vezaro yihye melo haggoyim. kol haolam yitmalle betzet shamo ushemo kesheyyaamid chamma begivon veyareach beemek ayyalon:
ohc: Vaymaen aviv vayyomer yadati vegomer. amro vaymaen, letzad shehaya rotze lismoch yad aviv lehasir otah.

Vechafal lomar yadati veni yadati, nitkavven lahashivo lishne devarim sheamar kemo shepperashnu. keneged ma sheamarta "lo chen avi ki ze habbechor" velo kemo sheani choshev shessedurim behefech, "yadati beni", veramaz beamro "beni", perush, umin hassetam lo tachshiv yemincha lifne yemini velo tesadderem ella habbechor limini velo limincha. ucheneged ma shehoretani laasot mishpat habbechora beamrecha "sim yemincha al rosho", yadati gam ze, uvichlal yedia zo nichnesa gam yediat hammesubbav middavar ze baasot ken leyosef. veamar gam hu yigdal perush: lo tachshov shehu bemadrega shefela ella yigdal veyihye leam, veulam vegomer perush, lo letzad birchati ella letzad ma sheyyetze mimmennu vezaro yihye melo haggoyim. laze hagam shebbizman ze ze habbechor, leatid yihye hakkatan yoter gadol, keamram zichronam livracha (tanchuma) shezze yetze mimmennu gidon veze yetze mimmennu yehoshua, umin hassetam shalshelet zo hayta beshoresh nishmat hashshevet mibbeli birkat yaakov, vaasher al ken ani makdimo labbechor.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: yadati kol taanotecha, uma sheramazta ki ze gorem – lo ze gorem, ella beni, perush, beni hu sheggaram lechol haover bachalomotecha udevarecha. veamro yadati paam sheniyya nimshechet im lematta mimmenna "gam hu vegomer veulam" vegomer, perush: sheyyada binvua shehakkatan yigdal mehaggadol veeno yachol laasot hefech mehachizzayon asher dimma beyado haadon baruch hu.

rashi: Veish tevunot yacharish. keshemmevazzehu hechaser lev; kemo shaul, dichtiv "vayyivzuhu velo heviu lo mincha vayhi kemacharish" (Shmuel 1 10:27):
targum: Deshat lechavreh chasir rayana hu vegavra demitbayen shatek:

ohc: Vayyishshak lo. perush, lo nashak, aval en nachon laasot ken lemet acher, ki hammet gadush betuma vetumato bokaat veola ad larakia, vetippagem hannefesh hannosheket. ella lo, leyaakov, ki chay hu, ella dormita keraato keyashen venirdam.

rashi: Shefifon. hu nachash; veomer ani shekkaruy ken al shem shehu noshef, kemo veatta teshufennu akev (Bereshit 3):

Hannoshech ikkeve sus. kach darko shel nachash, vedimmahu lenachash hannoshech ikkeve sus, vayyippol rochvo achor – shello naga bo. vedugmato matzinu beshimshon: vayyilpot shimshon et shene ammude hattavech vegomer (Shoftim 16) – vesheal haggag metu; veunkelos tirgem kechivve chureman, shem min nachash, sheen refua linshichato, vehu tzifoni, vekaruy chureman al shem sheose hakkol cherem; uchefitna – kemo feten, yichmon – yeerov:
Lishuatcha kivviti Adonai. nitnabbe sheyyenakkeru pelishtim et enav, vesofo lomar zachreni na vechazzekeni na ach happaam vegomer (Shoftim 16):
Vayyelchu gam echav. musaf al hashshelichut:

ohc: Vayyomer yisrael vegomer vehaya elohim vegomer. kavvanat amro anochi met vegomer perush shello yachshevu ki bemot yaakov tistallek hashshechina mibbenehem, ella afillu yamut – yihye elohim immahem. veamro veheshiv vegomer hodio sheyyihyu nifkadim lashuv shevutam been safek baddavar. vedikdek lomar eretz avotechem ki haaretz laavot nittena vehem zachu vah lo leyotze mitzrayim, umeatta yesh beyadi latet lecha shechem achad vegomer ki baze tutzdak hannetina mimmennu elav, vehu amro vaani natatti lecha vegomer. vegam ledivre razal (Bereshit Rabba 97:6) ki shechem zo kemashmaah shebbau bene yaakov al chalaleha, af al pi chen zulat zechut avot baaretz lo yizke bah yaakov velo banav.

rashi: Lo yasur shevet mihuda. middavid vaelach, ellu rashe galuyyot shebbevavel, sherodim et haam bashshevet shemmemunnim al pi hammalchut (Bereshit Rabba):
Umechokek mibben raglav. hattalmidim, ellu nesie eretz yisrael:
Ad ki yavo shilo. melech hammashiach shehammelucha shello, vechen tirgemo unkelos. umidrash aggada shilo – shay lo, shenneemar, yovilu shay lammora (Tehillim 76):

Velo yikkehat ammim. asefat haammim, shehayyod ikkar hi baysod, kemo yifatecha (Yechezkel 28), ufeamim shennofelet mimmennu, vechamma otiyyot meshammeshot belashon ze, vehem nikraim ikkar nofel; kegon nun shel nogef veshel noshech, vealef shebbivachavati beaznechem (Iyov 13), veshebbeivchat charev (Yechezkel 21), veasuch shamen (Melachim 2 4), af ze yikkehat ammim asefat ammim, shenneemar elav goyim yidroshu (Yeshayahu 11). vedome lo ayin tilag leav vetavuz likkehat em (Mishlei 30), lekibbutz kematim shebbefaneha mippene ziknatah; uvattalmud deyatve umakhu akhata beshuke dinhardea bemassechet yevamot; veyachol haya lomar, kehiyyat ammim:
Ayyala shelucha. zo vikat ginosar shehi kalla levashshel peroteha keayyala zo shehi kalla larutz. ayyala shelucha – ayyala meshullachat larutz:

Hannoten imre shafer. ketargumo. davar acher al milchemet sisra nitnabbe – velakachta immecha aseret alafim ish mibbene naftali vegomer (Shoftim 4), vehalchu sham bizrizut, vechen neemar sham leshon shilluach baemek shullach beraglav:

Hannoten imre shafer. al yadam sharu devora uvarak shira. verabbotenu derashuhu al yom kevurat yaakov kesheirer esav al hammeara, bemassechet sota (daf 13); vetargumo yitreme adve – yippol chevlo, vehu yode al chelko amarim naim veshevach:
Vayyar yisrael et bene yosef. bikkesh levarcham venistalleka shechina mimmennu, lefi sheatid yaravam veachav latzet meefrayim veyehu uvanav mimmenashshe:
Vayyomer mi elle. mehechan yatzu ellu, sheenan reuyin livracha:
ohc: Vayyar yisrael vegomer. kashe, vahalo sheva esore shana hayu yoshvim lefanav lilmod tora, veech shoel alehem? verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (tanchuma) ki raa bahem reiyya sichliyyit sheatid latzet mehem reshaim, veze derech derash. vetzarich lefaresh hakkatuv kefi peshuto, vehu ki gilla lanu hakkatuv sheyyaakov kavdu enav mizzoken shello haya yachol lirot ulehakkir, uletzad ze hagam sheraa shene bene adam omdim lefanav levad yosef sheimmo haya medabber vehikkiro letzad shehodiuhu sheamru lo (Bereshit 48:2) "hinne bincha yosef" kaamur lemala, vehabbanim lo hikkiram, laze shaol shaal alehem "mi elle"?

Od efshar shennitkavven yaakov leorer ahavat haav al habben kodem sheyyevarchem, kede shettihye habberacha betigboret haahava vehachibba. velaze shaal mi elle, kede sheyyishma mippi beno hechaviv etzlo lomar "banay hem" veyehemu meav lahem, vehu sod (Yirmeyahu 31:20) "midde dabberi bo vegomer rachem arachamennu" vegomer:

rashi: Rasha ose feullat shaker. peullato shel rasha meshakkeret lo, kesavur shettitkayyem bo hatzelachato, vehakkol avad:
Vezorea tzedaka secher emet. vehazzorea tzedaka hi peulla shel emet, ki bevadday batuach hu sheyyekabbel poolo bassof:
Secher. keronial belaaz, keadam hassocher ammat hammayim kede lilkot dagim, uvatuach sheyyimtza sham dagim harebe. vedome lo "kol ose secher agme nafesh" (Yeshayahu 19:10):
targum: Rashia aved ovada deshikra udezarea letzidketa kusheteh hu agreh:

rashi: Osri laggefen iro. nitnabbe al eretz yehuda shettehe moshechet yayin kemayan; ish yehuda yeesor laggefen ayir echad veyitanennu miggefen achat, umissorek echad ben aton echad:
Soreka. zemora arukka, kaverayyrea belaaz:
Kibbes bayyayin. kol ze leshon ribbuy yayin:
Suto. leshon min beged hu, veen lo dimyon bammikra:

Osri. kemo oser, dugmat mekimi meafar dal (Tehillim 113), hayyoshvi bashshamayim (sham 123), vechen beni atono keinyan ze. veunkelos tirgem bemelech hammashiach: gefen – hem yisrael; iro – zo yerushalayim; soreka – yisrael, veanochi netatich sorek – (Yirmeyahu 2):

Beni atono. yivnun hechle, leshon shaar haiton besefer yechezkel (Yechezkel 40). veod tirgemu befanim acherim: gefen ellu tzaddikim; beni atono – avde orayta beulefan, al shem rochve atonot tzechorot:

Kibbes bayyayin. yehe argevan tav shetztzibbuo dome leyayin, vetzivonin hu leshon suto, shehaishsha lovashtan umesita bahen et hazzachar litten enav bah; veaf rabbotenu pershu vattalmud leshon hasatat shichrut bemassechet ketubbot (daf 111). veal hayyayin shemma tomar eno marve, talmud lomar suto:
ohc: Osri laggefen vegomer. hen rabbu mefarshe katuv ze, vechullan derech derash darshu. veulay sheyyechavven od lomar al biat melech hammashiach haamur besamuch "ad ki yavo shilo" vegomer. veamar "velo yikkehat ammim" sheelav ammim yidroshu. amar sheyyeesor bemaasar uvitfisa lifne haggefen, shehem yisrael shennimshelu legefen, dichtiv (Tehillim 80:9) "gefen mimmitzrayim tassia", yeesor lifnehem iro, perush kol haummot hannimshalim lachamor, dichtiv (Yechezkel 23:20) "asher besar chamorim besaram", vechen darshu zichronam livracha (kiddushin sach.) befasuk "im hachamor" – am hammeshulim lachamor. "velassoreka", perush, lifne anaf echad mehaggefen hannikra sorek, yeesor gam ken bene atono. vedikdek lomar ayir veaton letzad sheyyesh bivchinat hakkelippa shehi shoresh nafshot haummot bechinat zachar unekeva, velivchinat zachar yikkare ayir velivchinat nekeva yikkare aton. veamar keneged haggefen shehu kelalut yisrael "osri iro" shehu bechinat hazzachar shehu tokef haummot, ucheneged anaf echad miyyisrael amar "atono", lomar letzad bechinat hannekeva lo yitztarech lechol yisrael ella beemtzaut anaf echad day.

O yomar al ze hadderech shehakkatuv medabber bishte haggeullot hammefursamot: haachat hi shel mitzrayim, vehashsheniyya hi geulla haatida beezrat hashshem. keneged geulla harishona amar osri laggefen, al derech amro "gefen mimmitzrayim tassia" (tehillim 80:9), sheaz kafa Adonai lifnehem bechina achat hannikret ayir vehuchena lifne haggefen. ucheneged geulla hashsheniyya beezrat hashshem shettihye beyamenu amar velassoreka, perush beet asher yishrok Adonai dichtiv (Zecharya 10:8) "eshreka lahem vaakabbetzem", az "beni atono", amar leshon rabbim, lomar kol bechinat haummot, ki bitziat mitzrayim lo hichnia Adonai lifnehem ella rosh ummot shehem mitzrayim uchenaan shehem shiva amamin, shehem hayu rosh vetigboret lechol haummot, aval shivim ummot lo huchenu velo nittenu lahem, aval leatid lavo beezrat hashshem lo yanniach mehaummot umma gedola o ketanna shello tinnaten lahem, vehu amro beni atono, perush millevad iro ella gam bene atono.

Veulay nuchal lomar od al derech ma sheamru bazzohar (pinchas 231:) ki besitra ochora hannekeva hi yoter chazaka mehazzachar, ki hazzachar notel yoteret shellah venikra yoteret hakkaved (Vayikra 9:10, Vayikra 3:15), vechaddavar hazze. uvechizzayon heruni bachalom sheheevakti bemilchama im hazzachar vayhi nakel beenay lehachenio vehippalti oto bechochi, velannekeva nitammatzti bechol kochi kamma peamim veachar kamma terachot yacholti lehashelichah kamma maalot lematta laaretz, ach lo kevalah hazzachar. velaze amar keneged geulla haatida "velassoreka" – et asher yishrok Adonai vikabbetzem, "beni atono" – otam shebbaim mikkoach hannekeva, gam otam yeesor Adonai lifne bene yisrael.

Velo yikshe beenecha sheanu mechallekim divre hakkatuv, chelek bime moshe vechelek bime hammashiach, ki halo yadata divre hazzohar hakkadosh (chelek 2 120.) ki moshe hu haggoel asher gaal et avotenu, hu yigal otanu veyashiv banim ligvulam, dichtiv (Kohelet 1:9) "ma shehaya hu sheyyihye" rashe tevot moshe. velo yikshe beenecha davar ze beamrecha halo melech hammashiach mishshevet yehuda mizzaro shel david hammelech alav hashshalom, veyesh omrim (sanhedrin tzach:) david atzmo melech hammashiach, dichtiv (Yechezkel 37:24) "veavdi david melech alehem" kemashmao, veim ken heach anu omrim shehu moshe habba mishshevet levi?

Yesh lecha ladaat ki bechinat nishmat moshe, alav hashshalom, hi kelula mishshenem asar shivte yisrael, ki chol hashshishshim ribbo hayu anafeha alav hashshalom, vaanaf shivto shel david bemoshe hu. velaze timtzaennu beeretz midbar shehaya melech vechohen velevi venavi vechacham vegibbor, shehaya kolel kol haanafim shebbakkedushsha. uleatid lavo titgalle baolam shoresh hammalchut shebbemoshe, shehu atzmo melech hammashiach, vehu david, vehu yinnon veshilo.

Kibbes bayyayin vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (zohar chodesh parashat Bereshit) ki galut reviit shebbo yiggale haggoel heatzum tzarich shettihye beyad yisrael mitzvat esek hattora, vezulat ze yitakkev mibbo. velaze ramaz beamro kibbes vegomer, perush ki kocho shel hammelech hametzuppe shilo shemo hu bechinat esek hattora sheyyitasseku yisrael beyenah shel tora, veayyen ma sheppershu befasuk (Shir HaShirim Rabba 82) "heviani el bet hayyayin", veamar ki beemtzautah yihye levusho, shehu kinnuy lammalchut, nachon elav lelavsho.

Veamro uvedam anavim vegomer, nitkavven lomar ki im yaggia zeman haggeulla velo yimmatze yayin, perush sheen banu tora, tihye haggeulla beemtzaut ol vetokef haggalut asher yatzeru haummot leyisrael, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 97:) ki kesheyyaggia ketz hannechtam velo yihye beyisrael zechut legoolam, yaamid lahem melech kashe kehaman vechulei, vehu amro uvedam anavim, ki beemtzaut hayyissurin yizdakkechu hannefashot veyitbarru nitzotze hakkedushsha kederech sheyyitbarru beemtzaut bechinat hattora, ella shezzo melachto naa vezo melachto bilti naa.

Veamro anavim, ki beemtzaut hayyissurin tigmor hachanatah kigmar bishshul peri haggefen shehem haanavim. vegam ramaz ki lo yishletu haummot lishpoch dam lizmor ilan o anaf o eshkol, ella anavim, perush gargerin.

Veamar suto lirmoz madrega ketanna lematta mehakkesut, ki hassut yirtze leshon kissuy hahechrechi leshon masve, vehakkavvana baze ki hefresh gadol yihye ben im tihye haggeulla beemtzaut hattora vehammitzvot, az yiggale begilluy malchut elyon, letihye beemtzaut hannekama asher tihye beyisrael, yihye bivchinat ani verochev vegomer.

rashi: Hannoladim lecha, ad boi elecha. lifne boi elecha, kelomar, shennoldu mishshepperashta mimmenni ad shebbati etzlecha:
Li hem. becheshbon shear banay hem, littol chelek baaretz ish kenegdo:
ohc: Veatta shene vanecha vegomer. perush, atta sheraiti shello hayu li banim od mitztzad otah beracha, ani yodea lemafrea ki shene banecha hannoladim lecha vegomer li hem, sheamar li Adonai "mafrecha vehirbiticha", vehu sheamar lo Adonai bevet el (Bereshit 35:11) "pere ureve" – kiruven veshimon yihyu li. veayyen ma shekkatavti besamuch:

rashi: Kaasher hishbiecha. veim lo bishvil hashshevua lo hayiti mannichacha, aval yare lomar avor al hashshevua shello yomar im ken eevor al hashshevua shennishbati lecha, shello agalle al leshon hakkodesh sheani makkir odef al 70 lashon, veatta encha makkir bo, kidita bemassechet sota:

Gad gedud yegudennu. kullam leshon gedud hem, vechach chibbero menachem; veim tomar, en gedud belo shene daltin, yesh lomar gedud shem davar tzarich shene daltin, shekken derech teva bat shete otiyyot lichpol besofah, veen yesodah ella shete otiyyot, vechen amar katztzippor lanud (Mishlei 26), miggizrat savati nedudim (Iyov 7), sham nafal shadud (Shoftim Adonai), miggizrat yashud tzohorayim (tehillim 91), af yagud, yegudennu ugedud miggizra achat hem; ucheshehu medabber bilshon yifol eno chaful, kemo yagud, yanud, yarum, yashud, yashuv, ucheshehu mitpael o mafil acherim hu chaful, kemo yitgoded, yitromem, yitbolel, yitoded; uvilshon mafil, yatom vealmana yeoded (Tehillim 146), leshovev yaakov elav (yeshaya 49), meshovev netivot (sham 58), yegudennu haamur kan eno leshon sheyyifaluhu acherim, ella kemo yagud hemennu, kemo banay yetzauni (Yirmeyahu 10) – yatzu mimmenni. gad gedud yegudennu, gedudim yagoddu hemennu sheyyaavru hayyarden im achehem lammilchama kol chalutz ad shennichbesha haaretz:
Vehu yagud akev. kol gedudav yashuvu al akevam lenachalatam shellakchu beever hayyarden, velo yippaked mehem ish:
Akev. bedarkan uvimsillotam shehalchu, yashuvu, kemo veikkevotecha lo nodau (Tehillim 77), vechen beikve hatztzon (Shir 1), bilshon laaz taretzayam:
ohc: Gad gedud vegomer. mavlia birchato bishmo, uferush "gad" leshon gedud, perush machane, uleshon gediyya, uleshon meshicha, uleshon hekef, shekkullam bemashmaut "gad", veayyen bearuch beferush tevat "gad". veamar gad gedud oyvav yesovvuhu al gedotav, vehu yagud perush yichrot otam, "akev" perush ad kalle. od yirtze gedud perush leshon machane sheyyitrabbu gedudav veyihye machanehu mashuch veholech, vehu amro "yegudennu", veamro vehu yagud perush yakkif lechol machane yisrael veyillachem baadam. "akev" perush ad sheyyinchalu kol nachalatam (Bamidbar 32:32).

rashi: Birchot avicha gavru vegomer. habberachot shebberchani hakkabba gavru vehalchu al habberachot shebberach et horay:

Ad taavat givot olam. lefi shehabberachot shelli gavru ad sof gevule givot olam, shennatan li beracha ferutza beli metzarim, maggaat ad arba ketzot haolam, shenneemar ufaratzta yamma vakedma vegomer, ma shello amar leavraham avinu uleyitzchak; leavraham amar sa na enecha uree tzafona vegomer ki et kol haaretz asher atta roe lecha ettenenna, velo herahu ella eretz yisrael bilvad; leyitzchak amar lecha ulezaracha etten et kol haaratzot hael vahakimoti et hashshevua vegomer, vezehu sheamar yeshaya (Yeshayahu 58) vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, velo amar nachalat avraham:
Horay. leshon herayon, shehoruni bime immi, kemo hora gaver (Iyov 3):
Ad taavat. ad ketzot, kemo vehitavvitem lachem ligvul kedma (Bamidbar 34), tetau levo chamat (sham):
Taavat. shmvltz belaaz, kach chibbero menachem ben saruk. veunkelos tirgem taavat olam leshon taava vechemda, vegivot leshon metzuke eretz shechimmedattan immo vehizkikattu lekabbelam:
Tihyena. kullam lerosh yosef:
Nezir echav. perisha daachohi, shennivdal meechav, kemo veyinnazru mikkadshe vene yisrael (Vayikra 22), nazoru achor (Yeshayahu 1):
Vayyotze yosef otam. leachar shenneshakam hotziam yosef meim birkav, kede leyashshevam ze layyamin veze lassemol lismoch yadav alehem ulevarcham:
Vayyishtachu leappav. keshechazar laachorav millifne aviv:
Vayyimleu lo. hishlimu lo yeme chanitato ad shemmalu lo 40 yom:
Vayyivku oto mitzrayim shivim yom. 40 lachanita vel livchiyya, lefi shebbaa lahem beracha leraglo, shekkala haraav vehayu me nilus mitbarchin:
Lo fillalti. lo melaani libbi lachashov machashava sheere fanecha od. fillalti leshon machashava, kemo havii etza asu felila (Yeshayahu 16 3):
Vayyeesof raglav. hichnis raglav:
Vayyigva vayyeesof. umita lo neemra vo, veara yaakov avinu lo met:
ohc: Vaychal yaakov letzauot vegomer. ha lamadta shello al yaakov neemar (Kohelet 8:8) "veen shilton beyom hammavet", shehaya haddavar birtzono uvirshuto ad shekkilla letzauot levanav kirtzono, veaz vayyeesof raglav vegomer. vehu maamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha (taanit 5:) yaakov avinu lo met, sheillu shalat bo hammavet lo hayta lo shelita ad et yachpotz leesof raglav, vetze ulemad ma sheamru zichronam livracha beferush pasuk (Kohelet 8:8) "veen shilton" sheen mi sheyyitle unekloma vechulei:

rashi: Sikkel et yadav. ketargumo, achkiminun – behasekel vechachma hiskil et yadav lechach umiddaat, ki yodea haya ki menashshe habbechor veaappi chen lo shat yemino alav:
ohc: Sikkel et yadav ki vegomer. amar tevat "ki" vehu taam lehefech, yesh sheppershu al ze hadderech "ki menashshe habbechor" veaf al pi chen vegomer.

Vehannachon beenay hu lefi ma shekkadam hakkatuv lehodia ki ene yisrael kavdu mizzoken, lo yuchal hakker mi hu habbechor umi hu hatztzair. laze kesheratza levarech dan bedato ki hamesadder yesadderem bederech musari laasot habbechor limino shel hamevarech, uvaze yada mekom kol echad mehem veasa ma sheala al machshavto asot, veze hu shiur hakkatuv "sikkel et yadav". veim tomar minnayin yada vehikkir mekomo shel kol echad? laze amar "ki menashshe habbechor", umizze yada ki oto yihye leyamin, velaze sikkel yadav.

rashi: Gomel nafsho. gomel tova likrovav. ish chased ish shehu chasid:
Veocher sheero achzari. vehaachzari hu ocher et kerovav:
targum: Parea tavta lenafsheh gavra chasida udemoved gushemeh nachzeraya:

rashi: Sa na lefesha avde elohe avicha. im avicha met, elohav kayyam, vehem avadav:

Vayyomer leyosef. echad min hammaggidim, vahare ze mikra katzar; veyeo, efrayim haya ragil lifne yaakov betalmud, ucheshechala yaakov beeretz goshen, halach efrayim etzel aviv lemitzrayim lehaggid lo:
Vayyikkach et shene vanav immo. kede sheyyevarchem yaakov lifne moto:
ohc: Shene vanav immo et vegomer. taam shello hispik beamro "shene vanav" vaani yodea ki hem menashshe veefrayim, o lomar "menashshe veefrayim" vaani yodea ki hem banav harshumim befarashat mikketz, gam hifsik ben hazekarat habbanim vehodaat shemam betevat "immo", gam amro "et" shete peamim.

Ulay ki yodia hakkatuv taam yosef bilkichatam, shehayta lakachat kol echad birchato bifne atzmo millevad ma sheyyaggia otam bevirkat avihem, vehu amro et shene vanav immo – ze ma shennogea lachelek sheyyihye nogea lahem bevirchato, gam et menashshe sheyyevorach bifne atzmo, veet efrayim vegomer:

O yirtze ki reuyim hem livracha mishshene tzedadin: letzad shehem banav, uletzad shekkol echad mehem rauy livracha mitztzad atzmo. velaze amar banav immo, gam letzad heyotam menashshe veefrayim tzaddikim. veamar "immo" lehafesik shello tavin shemmefaresh mi hem habbanim, veamar "et" veet" lomar shekkol echad chashuv bifne atzmo:

rashi: Kaasher tzivvam. mahu asher tzivvam?

Besodam al tavo nafshi. ze maase zimri, keshennitkabbetzu shivto shel shimon lehavi et hammidyanit lifne moshe veamru lo, zo asura o mutteret? im tomar asura, bat yitro mi hittirah lach? – al yizzacher shemi baddavar, zimri ben salu nesi vet av lashshimoni velo katav ben yaakov:
Bikhalam. kesheyyakhil korach, shehu mishshivto shel levi, et kol haeda al moshe veal aharon,

Al techad kevodi. sham, al yityached immahem shemi, shenneemar korach ben yitzhar ben kehat ben levi, velo neemar ben yaakov; aval bedivre hayyamim, keshennityachasu bene korach al hadduchan, neemar ben korach ben yitzhar ben kehat ben levi ben yisrael (divrei hayamim 1 6):
Al techad kevodi. kavod leshon zachar hu, veal karchacha atta tzarich lefaresh kimdabber el hakkavod veomer atta, chevodi al tityached immahem kemo lo techad ittam bikvura (yeshaya 14):

Ki veappam hargu ish. ellu chamor veanshe shechem, veenan chashuvin kullam ella cheish echad; vechen hu omer begidon, vehikkita et midyan keish echad (Shoftim 6) vechen bemitzrayim sus verochvo rama vayyam, zehu midrasho. ufeshuto, anashim harebe kore ish – kol echad leatzmo, beappam hargu chol ish shekkaasu alav, vechen vayyilmad litraf teref adam achol (Yechezkel 19):
Uvirtzonam ikkeru shor. ratzu laakor et yosef shennikra shor, shenneemar bechor shoro hadar lo (Devarim 33). ikkeru asheraytayr belaaz, leshon et susehem teakker (Yehoshua 11):
ohc: Besodam vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat hakkatuv. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sanhedrin kat:) "besodam" ze maase zimri, "bikhalam" ze maase korach, "ki veappam" vegomer ze chamor veanshe shechem, "uvirtzonam" vegomer ze yosef vechulei (targum yerushalmi), ad kan. vedivrehem zichronam livracha derech derash, uchefi happeshat kashe lamma yakdim hameuchar viacher maase shechem veyosef shehayu rishonim. od ech yutzdak lomar tevat ki al inyan bifne atzmo sheen lo shayyachut im lemala mimmennu. od lamma meyaches avon zimri gam lelevi, vehu adrabba hannoten nekamot. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro uvirtzonam lamma hizkir haratzon baze?

Achen peshat hakkatuv hu ki chol hakkatuv yedabber bemaase yosef, veamar besodam perush, meet shehitchilu lisnooto vehaya haddavar benehem besod kesheyyaarimu sod al tavo nafshi, perush, lo hiskima nefesh shezzarati bahem lihyot immahem behivvasdam yachad. vehakkavvana baze ki lo mikkocho ba hara hahu kemo shekkatavnu lemala.

Od yirtze ki lo yeanesh al haddavar letzad sheasu banav kacha, o letzad shehu garam kinatam beshannoto et beno ben habbanim. bikhalam keshennikhalu alav lehargo dichtiv (Bereshit 37:20) "lechu venahargehu" vegomer, al techad kevodi – lo yikkaru al shemi bene yaakov kol ikkar beotah shaa.

Od yirtze al techad leshon chedva. kan ramaz layyegonot sheavaruhu vesilluk hashshechina mealav, shehu bechinat hakkavod, keamram zichronam livracha (tanchuma vayyeshev) shemmeet shenneevad mimmennu yosef lo sharta alav shechina mitztzad haetzev vehayyagon. veamro ki veappam vegomer, perush, taam haddavar sheani omer "al tavo veal techad" vegomer, ki behivvasdam yachad lakachat nefesh zamamu, vehu amro hargu ish, vahagam shemmatzinu shello haraguhu, hare hiskimu al harigato vehittiluhu el bor male nechashim vegomer lamut sham bechamma mine mitot.

Uvirtzonam vegomer. perush, afilu beet shennach appam, achar shehishlichuhu babbor veyashvu leechol lechem vedibber lahem yehuda divre ritztzuy venachat ruach, af al pi chen asu raa sheakruhu lashshor shehu yosef, sheamru zichronam livracha (sota lo:) shebbeemtzaut yeridat mitzrayim umikre ra shel eshet potifar neekru miyyosef asara shevatim, shehaya rauy leled shenem asar velo nisharu ella shenayim:

rashi: Tzaddik mitztzara nechelatz. bemot rasha, velammikra haelyon (Mishlei 11:7) ze mechubbar:
targum: Tzadika min akta ishtezev veal bish techotohi:

rashi: Chachlili. leshon odem, ketargumo, vechen lemi chachlilut enayim (Mishlei 23), shekken derech shote yayin enehem madimin:

Mechalav. merov chalav, sheyyehe beartzo mire tov leedre tzon; vechen perush hammikra: adom enayim yehe merov yayin uleven shinnayim yehe merov chalav. ulefi targumo enayim leshon harim, shemmishsham tzofim lemerachok, veod tirgemo befanim acherim, leshon mayanot vekilluach hayekavim, naavohi – yekavim shello, velashon arammi hu bemassechet aza (daf 74), naava artecho yechavveran bikate – targum shinnayim, leshon shinne hasselaim:
ohc: Chachlili enayim vegomer. yechavven al derech amro (Tehillim 68:7) "motzi asirim bakkosharot", vedarshu zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 83) bechi veshirot – bechi lemitzrayim veshirot leyisrael. vehu amro chachlili enayim leshon admimut shehu inyan haddinim, shekkol haadmimut yore al otzem hammishpat ki damim bedamim nagau. veamar miyyayin perush mimmekor haddin shehu hayyayin. o yirmoz sibbat hannekama hi miyyayin, perush mitztzad ma shechavlu ufashu bene tora millilmod, libbi libbi al davar ze, meay meay al asher manu bene avla otanu measok betorat el chay, veal ze yinkom nakom behitorrut tigboret haddinim. uvazzeman atzmo uleven shinnayim mechalav yare lanu loven shinnayim mechalav, veulay sheyyirmoz beamro "uleven" al yisrael shekkerao Adonai ben, dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 31:20) "haven yakkir li". veamro mechalav hu bechinat hachesed veharachamim asher yeorer alenu avinu hazzeman atzmo shehu nokem nakam, vehu amro (Micha 7:15) "kime tzetcha" vegomer, keshem sheaz haya bechi veshirot kemo chen yihye bimhera beyamenu amen.

rashi: Meel avicha. hayta lecha zot vehu yazerekka:
Veet shadday. veim hakkabba haya libbecha keshello shamata ledivre adonatcha, vehu yevarchekka:

Birchot shadayim varacham. birchata deabba udeimma, kelomar, yitbarchu hammolidim vehayyoldot, sheyyihyu hazzecharim mazriin tippa haruya leherayon, vehannekevot lo yeshakkelu et rechem shellahen lehappil ubbarehen:
Shadayim. yaro yiyyare metargeminan ishtedaa yishtedi, af shadayim kan al shem shehazzera yore kachetz:
ohc: Meel avicha vegomer. perush ki meelohe aviv hu shehissig hammussag elav, veramaz ki bizchut aviv haya haddavar. vehitpallel shekkemo chen tamid yihye beezro, vehu amro veyazerekka. veamro veet shadday perush gam shem shadday shehu hashshem shebbesaad bechinat nefesh yosef kayyadua limvine sode hattora, gam ze haya beezro lehatztzilo mibbat el nechar uvercho bo.

Od yirtze beamro veyazerekka vivarchekka al ze hadderech, shehagam sheel azaro veshadday siggevo lehinnatzel min hachet, af al pi chen machzikim lo tova al haddavar, vehem beezro umevarchin oto keillu mimmennu haya haddavar. velech na ree ma shepperashti (Tehillim 37:33) befasuk "Adonai lo yaazvennu beyado velo yarshiennu behishshafto".

Uvederech remez yirmoz hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 10.) hattole bizchut acherim tolin lo bizchut atzmo, vehu amro meel avicha talita hahatava hammusseget lecha shehi mizzechut avicha, baze "veyazerekka", perush yitkanne haezer lecha bizchutecha.

Od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava batra noach:) en osin nes ella lemi sheatid laamod betzidko, vehu amro meel avicha haya lecha davar ze, umeatta veyazerekka leval tikkashel bidvar kiur lehaamid nisso bemakom neeman.

rashi: Vayyitmoch yad aviv. herimah meal rosh beno utemachah beyado:
Vayyishtachu yisrael. taala beiddaneh segid leh:

Al rosh hammitta. hafach atzmo letzad hashshechina. mikkan amru shehashshechina lemala meraashotav shel chole (shabbat 12, nedarim 40); davar acher al rosh hammitta – al shehayta mittato shelema velo haya vah resha, shehare yosef melech hu, veod shennishba leven haggoyim, vahare hu omed betzidko:
ohc: Vayyomer hishshava li. hutzrach lomar lo paam sheniyya "hishshava", velo hispik bema sheanahu laasot kidvarav, lefi ma shepperashnu befasuk "anochi eese" vegomer. yavo al nachon ki meshivo lema sheamar sheeno tzarich shevua ki matzdik hu devarav, ella laasot retzono hu mevakkesh mimmennu lishshava, vehu amro hishshava li perush, lehafis dati, o letaam hakkamus immi. vehakkavvana choshesh lezulat sheyyihye monea oto, uchemo shekken haya sheamar lo paro sheyyattir shevuato keamram zichronam livracha (sota lod:), velaze techef nishba lo.
O yomar hishshava li – ledati, kede shello yevattel hashshevua belibbo veikkar hashshevua ballev, veasa yaakov ken levittachon lechol tzidde hassafek sheyyihyu baddavar.

rashi: Veshachavti im avotay. vav zo mechubbar lemala litchillat hammikra – sim na yadcha tachat yerechi vehishshava li – vaani sofi lishkav im avotay, veatta tissaeni mimmitzrayim. veen lomar, veshachavti im avotay – hashekiveni im avotay bammeara, shehare ketiv acharav, unesatani mimmitzrayim ukevartani bikvuratam; veod, matzinu bechol makom leshon shechiva im avotav hi haggevia velo hakkevura, kemo: vayyishkav david im avotav, veachar kach vayyikkaver beir david (Melachim 1 2):
ohc: Vayyomer anochi eese vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar lo ken, vehaya lo laasot hammaase befoal vezot hi teshuvato, uchemo shemmatzinu gam ken leeliezer eved avraham kesheamar lo avraham (Bereshit 24:2) "sim na yadcha" vegomer hatteshuva hayta "vayyasem haeved et yado" vegomer:
Achen hakkavvana hi sheamar lo teshuva sheeno tzarich lishshava lo, vehinne hu muchan laasot kidvarav.

O yirtze shekkefi haddin hu mechuyyav laasot kidvarav, o letzad shehu beno, vehu amro anochi eese, o letzad shehu metzavve mechamat mita (choshen mishpat 252:2), vehu amro chidvarecha veeno tzarich shevua, uvaze hodia yosef alav hashshalom tzidkato ki chafetz chesed hu laasot devar mitzva mertzono happashut:

rashi: Et efrayim bimino missemol yisrael. habba likrat chavero, yemino keneged semol chavero, vechevan shehu habbechor, meyumman livracha:
Pachaz kammayim. happachaz vehabbehala asher mihareta lehareot kaascha kammayim hallalu hamemaharim limrutzatam, lechach
Al totar. al tarbe littol kol hayeterot hallalu shehayu reuyot lecha, umahu happachaz asher pachazta? ki alita mishkeve avicha:
Az chillalta. oto sheala al yetzui – vehi shechina shehaya darkah lihyot ola al yetzui:
Pachaz shem davar hu, lefichach taamo lemala, vechullo nakud pattach, veillu haya leshon avar, haya nakud chetzyo kamatz vechetzyo pattach vetamo lematta:
Yetzui. leshon mishkav, al shem shemmatztziim oto al yede levadin usedinin; veharebe domim lo im eele al eres yetzuay (Tehillim 132); im zecharticha al yetzuay (sham 63):
ohc: Pachaz kammayim vegomer. perush, atta pachazta levalbel yetzui velo kavashta yitzrecha, ella shemmiharta keish happochez velo ikkavta atzmecha lenatztzeach nitzotz hara shennishrash becha, laze lo yihye lecha yitron mikkol hashshelosha yitronot venaasa pashut.

Od ramaz beamro al totar shehappechizut shennahag laasot davar bilti hagun lo nahag laasoto bedavar sheyyesh bo yitron, ki leinyan teshuva lo kadam hu laasot teshuva, keamram zichronam livracha (bava kamma tzav.) mi garam liruven sheyyode – yehuda. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha veze leshonam: lo haya adam sheppatach bitshuva ad shebba reuven vechulei, ad kan, im kol ze vidduy lo amar ad shebba yehuda veamar "tzadka mimmenni", beotah shaa kafatz reuven veamar "ani bilbalti mittat avi", kach huva bammidrash (tanchuma) shekkach kabbala beyadam. uledivrehem ellu yesh lanu lomar ki letaam ze nittena malchuto shel reuven lihuda bead gemar hahodaa asher garmu liruven lehodot. vehakkehunna shennittena lelevi nire ki lo zacha bah ella beemtzaut maasav achar kach, keamro (Devarim 33:8) "leish chasidecha asher nissito bemassa" vegomer, veaz hu shennittena lelevi hakkehunna. veal kol panim mime yaakov nittelu kol hammaalot meruven keamro al totar, venatan yaakov shete maalot: achat leyosef veachat lihuda, vehashshelishit teluya veomedet ad shennetanah hakkadosh baruch hu larauy lah asher nissahu vegomer

Ucheneged ma shennogea lemaase binyan sharsho amar ki alita vegomer, perush, taam asotcha ken hu ki beet shezzerao veala beveten immo haya bilbul baaliyyato, ki ala bishne mishkavot, lea verachel, echad bemaase veechad bemachshava, ki bemaase hayta lea uvemachshava chashav yaakov ki hi rachel, vehu amro mishkeve avicha, veze haya sibba sheaz chillalta yetzui ala, ki bechinat hara tolid bidmutah, keshem sheala bevilbul kemo chen bilbel yetzue aviv, velaze dikdek lomar az lirmoz ki lo al zeman sheala mishkeve aviv hu omer shechillel yetzui, ki hem shene zemannim, shezzeman sheala mishkav hu zeman sheala beveten immo uzeman shechillel hu achare chen.

Veattem chashavtem vegomer elohim chashavah letova. vahare ze dome lemitkavven lehashekot chavero kos mavet vehishkahu kos yayin, sheeno mitchayyev kelum, vahare hem peturim vezakkaim gam bedine shamayim.
Chassalat parashat vaychi:
Salik sefer Bereshit

rashi: Vayyisu oto vanav. velo vene vanav, shekkach tzivvam, al yisu mittati lo ish mitzri velo echad mibbenechem, shehem mibbenot kenaan, ella attem, vekava lahem makom 3 lammizrach, vechen led ruchot, uchesidran lemassa machane shel degalim nikveu chan; levi lo yissa, shehu atid laset et haaron, veyosef lo yissa, lefi shehu melech, menashshe veefrayim yihyu tachtehem, vezehu ish al diglo veotot – beot shemmasar lahem avihem lissa mittato:
Tummat yesharim tanchem. tanhalem:
Veselef bogdim yeshaddem. yeshaddem:
targum: Temimuta ditritze tadber inun unetaltelun bazoze venidchinun:

ohc: Mikne hassade vegomer. achar sheramaz lahem hakenaat zechut hammeara lo levaddo, chazar al perat echad sheyyeshno beirur al hammeara, vehem bene chet sheyyecholin learer middina devar mitzra veyotzienna miyyadam.

Vahagam shekkefi haddin en din hammetzer belokeach min haggoy, ze davka im hamearer yisrael, vehattaam kemo sheamru bashshas (bava metzia kach:) deamar leh: arya avrachi lach mimmetzrach, aval bammetziut shellefanenu en taam ze tzodek, vehaggoyim yitanu din hammetzer lehotzi miyyad bene yaakov.

Uleerech taanat metzer lo yaspik ma shekkavar avraham vesara veyitzchak verivka vechulei, uchemo shekkatav rambam beferek 13 mehilchot shechenim shebben bana ben chafar vekilkel hare hu keshaliach, umenakke lo im kilkel.
Laze amar mikne hassade meet bene chet, beofen sheen lahem din bar mitzra, veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat chayye sara (Bereshit 23:9).

Vetaam shello sidder hakkatuv perat ze samuch lakkeniyya meefron, ki en keniyyato mibbene chet begeder veshiur keniyyato meefron, ki efron hu bealim harishonim shekkana miyyado avraham, uvene chet enan ella kat sheyyesh bahem mechush irur middin bar metzra, laze ba divrehem baacharona.

rashi: Vaani bevoi mippaddan vegomer. veaappi sheani matriach alecha leholicheni lehikkaver beeretz kenaan, velo chach asiti leimmecha, shehare meta samuch levet lechem:

Kivrat eretz. middat eretz, vehem alpayim amma kemiddat techum shabbat, kedivre rabbi moshe haddarshan – velo tomar sheikkevu alay geshamim milleholichah ulekavrah bechevron, et haggarid haya, shehaaretz chalula umenukkevet kichvara:

Akebareh sham. velo holachtiha afillu levet lechem lehachenisah laaretz, veyadati sheyyesh belibbecha alay; aval da lecha sheal pi haddibbur kevartiha sham, shettehe leezra levaneha kesheyyagle otam nevuzaradan, vehayu ovrim derech sham, yotzet rachel al kivrah uvocha umevakkeshet alehem rachamim, shenneemar kol berama nishma vegomer vehakkabba meshivah yesh sachar lifullatech neum Adonai veshavu vanim ligvulam (Yirmeyahu 31). veunkelos tirgem keruv ara – kede shiur charishat yom; veomer ani, shehaya lahem ketzev shehayu korin oto kede macharesha achat, 331 belaaz, kidamrinan karev vetane; kema demassik taala mibbe karba:
ohc: Vaani bevoi mippaddan vegomer. katuv ze en lo kesher im ma shellemala mimmennu. gam en yadua kavvanat hodaa zo. uma sheppershu zichronam livracha (Rashi lakach tov) ki kavvanato hi "af al pi shehitrachticha leholicheni likkaver beeretz kenaan velo kach asiti" vechulei ad kan. lefi divrehem lo kan hiv mekom haddevarim ella lemala (Bereshit 47:30) kesheamar lo "unesatani mimmitzrayim ukevartani" vegomer, samuch laze haya lo lomar "vaani bevoi" vegomer. od, ma kavvanato beamro tevat alay?

Achen lefi ma shepperashti ki modio shehabbanim hammuvtach bahem sheyyetzu mimmennu hem ellu, nitkavven beamro vaani bevoi vegomer, ki hiv sibba shello yatzu mimmennu mammash letzad shehu garam shettamut rachel, vehu amro meta alay, perush, al sibbati, keamram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba perek 37) sheshshiha nidro, o letzad hakkelala shekkillel keamro "im asher timtza et elohecha lo yichye", veillu hayta kayyemet rachel hayu yotzim mimmennu, veachshav yatzu miyyosef shehu bechinat yaakov gam bechinat rachel.

Efshar shennitkavven yaakov leratztzot et yosef al asher sibbev mitat immo kodem zemannah, veamar ki taam asher hechshiv shene banav kiruven veshimon, letzad ki meta alav rachel vekerav mitatah. vetaam ma sheheerich lomar od beod kivrat eretz vegomer, nitkavven lomar ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha shennitkavven lomar af al pi shello chen asa leimmo vechulei:

rashi: Vaychi yaakov. lamma parasha zo setuma? lefi shekkevan shenniftar yaakov avinu nistemu enehem velibbam shel yisrael mitztzarat hashshibud, shehitchilu leshabedam; davar acher: shebbikkesh legallot et hakketz levanav, venistam mimmennu. bivra:
ohc: Vaychi yaakov. taam keriat shemo yaakov achar asher amar elav Adonai (Bereshit 35:10) "lo yikkare" vegomer, "lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha", kevar katavti befarashat vayyishlach beferush pasuk "lo yikkare" vegomer, ki letzad shem nafsho hakkevua bo asher shemah yaakov, kayyadua middivrehem (berachot 7:) sheppershu bappasuk (Tehillim 46:9) "asher sam shammot baaretz", uletzad sheodenna beibbo laze lo yeaker shemah ushene shemot yikkaru lo.

Ella sheyyesh lanu lachkor zot bamme yivchar Adonai lizmannim yikra lo yaakov velizmannim yisrael, hen emet ki baadat yisrael matzinu sheyyishtanne lahem hashshem kefi maasehem, kesheosim retzono shel makom beshem yisrael yechanne otam ulehefech yikra shemam yaakov, vechen hu ramuz bedivrehem (zohar balak 210:), vetaam ze lo yutzdak beyaakov ki yashar poolo bitmidut.

Achen leheyot sheanaf hammusekol asher nitatztzem yaakov lehassigo, shebbeemtzauto beshem yisrael yitkanne, hu bechinat kedushsha elyona, vetimtza ki hammin hammeushshar hahu yimas livchinat haddeaga vehaitztzavon vehashshiflut, ki mimmekom hassimcha vehammenucha vehaggedulla baa. vehaya leot ben enecha yom shabbat limnucha asher tzivva Adonai et bene yisrael, vehu letaam neshama yetera. uletzad shemmimmakom elyon baa, yetzav Adonai leharechik hayyagon vehakkaas velikro lashshabbat oneg. vehen haddevarim atzmam neemarim beyaakov behassagato shem elyon, hashshem yaggid ki tzivva Adonai itto et hanneshama haelyona baalat shem ze shel yisrael umishkanah bo, hu kol zeman sheen sham itztzavon veanaf hannegdi ketzat lassimcha velashshelemut hakkedushsha vehattohora. uveheader ken – "vayyinnafash", yotza mimmennu kitziat neshama yetera shel yom shabbat, uveoto zeman lo yikkare lo yisrael, ki baalat hashshem halcha lah veenenna az, veyikkare shemo yaakov. vetashuv od hanneshama hahi beemtzaut hachanat vehatztzaat hammuchan, kahashavat neshama yetera bechol shabbat veshabbat beemtzaut hachanat yom hamekuddash. uvaze telech lavetach lehasekil taam bechol makom asher beshem yaakov yitkanne, hu lesibba asher yeera sham davar mibbechinat haetzev vehayyagon.

Veershom lecha ketzat mehammekomot lehair lecha, veze yatza rishona. techillat dibber tov Adonai befarashat vayyishlach amar elav "shimcha yaakov", perush az yihye shemo yaakov letzad shehaya az baavelut immo, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba parasha 82) sheamru ki amro "vayvarech oto" yechavven al birkat avelim, uletzad ze yikkare shemo yaakov. velaze timtza shebbechol otah parasha kara Adonai shemo yaakov, vegam bizman mitat rachel nikra shemo yaakov dichtiv (Bereshit 35:20) "vayyatztzev yaakov matztzeva al kevuratah". veachar sheshshalmu yeme haetzev kara Adonai shemo yisrael, dichtiv (sham 21) "vayyissa yisrael", "bishkon yisrael". vahagam sheamar sham "vayyihyu vene yaakov", yesh lecha ladaat ki kesheyyihyu habbanim bemadrega pechuta letzad maasehem, hagam shehaav yitkanne beshem yisrael hem yitkannu beshem yaakov. uvema shellefanenu letzad maase shehaya sheasa reuven, kara lahem shem "bene yaakov". uma sheamar od sham (Bereshit 35:27) "vayyavo yaakov el yitzchak aviv", letzad shehaya lifne yitzchak aviv lo nahag bo hakkatuv hasserara vehaggedulla hannirmezet beshem yisrael. vechen timtza sheamru bemidrash tehillim (yalkut shemauni 875) veze leshono: illu haya avraham kayyam, heach haya yitzchak manhig serara, vechen kol haavot vehatztzaddikim vechulei, ad kan. hinnecha roe ki tistallek hasserara lifne aviv, uletaam ze kara shemo yaakov. vechen ma shekkara lo shem yaakov befarashat vayyeshev, yodia hakkatuv ki chol zeman shehaya yaakov az beeretz kenaan haya beyagon vaanacha uvemadregat shem yaakov, zulati bizmannim muatim asher rasham hakkatuv bahem shem yisrael, keamro (Bereshit 37:3) "veyisrael ahav" vegomer, az haya sameach vehuchan beli etzev likrot lo shem yisrael. vetimtza ki mishshennimkar yosef lo nikra shemo yisrael zulat shalosh peamim: (Bereshit 43:6) "vayyomer yisrael lamma hareotem" vegomer, "vayyomer yehuda el yisrael aviv", (Bereshit 43:8) "vayyomer alehem yisrael avihem" (Bereshit 43:11), utzerichin lehiddaresh ki dibber alehem derech serara letzad hahechreach sheraa shello chashu letzaaro venistarer alehem, veramaz ki lo yimchol lahem letzad shehu avihem, gam sheyyekabbelu devarav. umeet hitbassero beyosef "vattechi ruach yaakov" (Bereshit 45:27) venacha alav ruach Adonai, vetechef amar hakkatuv "vayyomer yisrael" (Bereshit 45:28), "vayyissa yisrael", "vayyomer elohim leyisrael" (Bereshit 46), ad shennitbasser baggalut vekibbel alav hashshever chazar likkare yaakov, zulat beet asher nigla elav yosef lerov hassimcha haggedola kinna Adonai oto beshem yisrael, dichtiv (Bereshit 46:29) "vayyaal likrat yisrael aviv", "vayyomer yisrael amuta happaam" (Bereshit 46:30), umishsham veelach lo nikra od shem yisrael kol yeme heyoto beeretz mitzrayim ad yom shehiggia et lechto leolamo. uma sheamar (Bereshit 47) "vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim" yechavven el kelalut banav sheyyityaches alehem shem yisrael kesheyyihyu bederech yosher, vegadol koach habbanim mikkoach avihem ki habbanim kol asher yetivu darkam yikkare lahem shem yisrael leheyotam rabbim, ma sheen ken yaakov yedakdek bikriat shemo lirmoz bikriato zeman matztzavo, velo nikra beshem yisrael kol zeman heyoto beeretz mitzrayim ad et shekkarvu yamav lamut az nikra shemo yisrael letzad tosef rucham, vehu sod hagedalat nefesh adam beet mitato (zohar chelek 1 218:), laze amar "vayyikrevu yeme yisrael", "vayyishtachu yisrael". vechallech lederech ze lehasekil bechol makom asher yikkare lo shem hu shemo lesibba asher taskil shamma. veayyen bedivre hazzohar (zohar chelek 1 211:) vetimtza saad lidvarenu. vechol ze hu derech peshat, veyesh devarim bego kefi ruchaniyyut haddevarim, vehammaskil yavin.

Vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ma shechaya beeretz mitzrayim. veod kashe, lo haya tzarich lomar ella "vayhi yeme yaakov vegomer 147" vegomer, vaani yodea lefi hacheshbon ki sheva esre shana chaya beeretz mitzrayim, lema shekkadam bahodaa befarashat vayyiggash, dichtiv (Bereshit 47:9) "shene meguray sheloshim umeat shana". od lamma hutzrach lomar shene chayyav velo hispik lomar "vayhi yeme yaakov"?

Veulay ki letzad shekkol yeme yaakov lo nach velo shakat, ki mishshennolad nolad sitno, vaadayin lo shaka shimsho amad lavan veelle mosif lera lo, veacharav hukam al tzaarah shel dina, veod lo vayyavo rogez avedat yosef. hu sheamar hakkatuv "vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim sheva esre shana" – ellu hayu chayyav velo kodem, vesamach laze amro vayhi yeme yaakov shene chayyav lirmoz shehen henna hayu yamav shehaya lo bahem chayyut, vehu amro "vayhi yeme yaakov" perush otam sheva esre shana shene chayyav, perush shehaya lo bahem chayyim. venimshechet "yeme yaakov" im ma shellematta mimmenna "yeme yaakov vegomer sheva" vegomer:

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (451 deve eliyyahu Rabba 5) kol mi shessof yamav betova keillu kol yamav betova, vehu taam (Iyov 8:7) "vehaya reshitcha vegomer veacharitcha yisge meod", gam amro (Kohelet 7:8) "tov acharit davar" vegomer, vehu amro vaychi yaakov chayyim shel shalva beeretz mitzrayim, baze haya beenav shehayu yeme yaakov shene chayyav, perush, shanim shel chayyim kol yamav shehem sheva shanim vegomer. vetaam amro vayhi leshon tzaar, yechavven lomar shehagam shehayu yamav betzaar, af al pi chen chazru beenav lihyot kullam shel chayyim.

Veyesh lanu lachkor zot, lamma shinna hakkatuv seder mispar shenotav shel yaakov misseder hallakuach bemispar shene hatztzaddikim, shemmakdim mispar gadol lemispar katan: beavraham ketiv (Bereshit 25:7) "meat shana veshivim shana" vegomer, beyitzchak ketiv (Bereshit 35:28) "meat shana ushemonim shana", besara ketiv (Bereshit 23:1) "mea shana veesrim" vegomer. veulay ki hikdim minyan hammuat shehu haacharon shebbo haya beshalva vechayyim tovim.

Od yechavven hakkatuv beofen acher, ki yamim shehaya yaakov libbo nachon umaavav shelemim bechol chayyav hem yamim sheva vearbaim shana, vehattaam hu keamram zichronam livracha ki et rachel ahav vehi bat zugo asher bachar yaakov bah uvevaneha asher tolid, keamro (Bereshit 37:3) "ahav et yosef mikkol" vegomer, veyesh baze gam ken sod attik. vehaya lecha leot ki chol zeman shello haya yosef vayyasem sak al matnav, velichshettetzaref minyan hayyamim shehaya bechevrat rachel gam shanim shehaya yosef immo timtza arbaim veachat shanim, ki esrim shana asa bevet lavan, tze mehem sheva ad shennasa rachel nisharu shelosh esre, uvahem nivleu mishshene yosef shesh shanim, ki keshennolad hitchil yaakov laavod betzono shel lavan dichtiv (Bereshit 31:41) "veshesh shanim betzonecha", ucheshemmecharuhu haya ben sheva esre shana. tze mehem shesh nisharu achat esre ushelosh esre hare esrim vearba, usheva esre bemitzrayim hare arbaim veachat, veshesh shanim shehaya yaakov befaotot shehem yamim shehallev sameach verekam miyyagon hare arbaim vesheva, vehu amro vayhi yeme yaakov shene chayyav shehayu lo chayyim sheva shanim vearbaim, velaze bachar lehakedim perat hammuat lehodia ze.

Vetaam amro vayhi lederech ze, yechavven lehodia ki lo hishlim yaakov avinu kol yeme chayyav hacharutzim, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 74:9) ki letzad sheamar "lo yichye" vehichrit chayye rachel, nechseru lo yamav mimminyan shene yitzchak shehayu mea ushemonim, sheloshim veshalosh shana keminyan "yichye", laze ramza hattora tzaar chesron shene hatztzaddik betevat "vayhi":

Venishar latet taam hakkatuv lamma yimne cheshbon shene yaakov kodem shehiggia zemanno lippater, ki hinnecha roe ki achar shemmana hakkatuv "vayhi yeme yaakov" amar acharav maase hashebaat yosef, veachar kach amar "vayhi achare haddevarim vayyomer leyosef" vegomer, umin harauy lo haya lehazekir sikkum yamav ad yom moto. veulay ki nitkavven lehodia davar shemmimmennu hirgish yaakov shekkarvu yamav lamut, shemmitztzad ze kara livno leyosef vegomer. veamar vayhi yeme yaakov shene chayyav vegomer, perush, letzad ma shekkadam elav midiat chayye yitzchak shehayu mea ushemonim shana, gam shehirgish hatztzaddik beshiggato asher shagag bakkelala "lo yichye", veyada beansho ki haavot neviim hayu veruach hakkodesh lovashtam, velaze kesheasa cheshbon shene aviv vehotzi mehem sheloshim veshalosh, chash leviat yomo shekkarev vayyikra livno vegomer:

Uvederech remez yitbaer hakkatuv lema shehodia elohim bivchinat yosef ki hu hammashbir, vehu shezzan vehecheya am rav, kemaamaro (Bereshit 50:20) "lehachayot am rav", uvechina zo tishlol heyotah baalat chov lezulatah bivchinat hahashpaa lah. velamadnu sheyyaakov zan ufirnes et yosef sheva esre shana, dichtiv (Bereshit 37:2) "ben sheva esre" vegomer, laze shillem habbechina hallazo vehishpia hu leyaakov bemiddat tashlume kefel kamma middot merubbot sheva esre shana, vehu sheramaz vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim sheva esre shana. vezulat ze efshar shehayu shelemim yamav kodem lachen, ella leshallem yosef tovat chesed shekkibbel mimmennu, velaze tovim hashshenayim mehaechad, ki chol echad hetiv mispar tov shanim venachon leshallem ze laze. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (zohar vayyeshev 182:) ki yosef hu bivchinat vav milluy vav kayyadua leyode nistarot laAdonai elohenu.

rashi: Ki hatachat elohim ani. shemma bimkomo ani? bitmiha, im hayiti rotze lehara lachem, kelum ani yachol? vahalo attem kullechem chashavtem alay raa, vehakkadosh baruch hu chashavah letova veheach ani levaddi yachol lehara lachem?
ohc: Ki hatachat elohim vegomer. perush, im attem chayyavim onesh al haddavar, elohim shofet velo ekkom velo ettor. vetaam shello machal lahem, efshar letzad shebbene noach en haddavar taluy bimchilatam ki yecheta adam lachavero, kemo shettomar gezalo umachal hannigzal eno patur haggazlan mimmita, o afillu yisrael im ganav yisrael umecharo en beyad hannignav lefatro laggannav mimmavet. veamar od lahem ki yesh ladun lahem mishpat zechut.

rashi: Arur appam ki az. afillu bishat tochecha lo killel ella appam, vezehu sheamar bilam ma ekkov lo kabbo el (Bamidbar 23):

Achallekem beyaakov. afridem ze mizze shello yehe levi beminyan hashshevatim, vahare hem chalukim. davar acher en lecha aniyyim vesofrim umelammede tinokot ella mishshimon, kede sheyyihyu nefotzim, veshivto shel levi asao mechazzer al haggeranot latterumot velammaasrot, natan lo tefutzato derech kavod:
ohc: Arur appam ki az vegomer. perush, lachelek hamerubbe bahem yoter mishshiur haragil hu mekallel, veyishshaer bahem chelek haragil bechol adam kede lekabbel sachar laolam habba al kefiyyato laavodat Adonai, sheim lo chen yushlal mehem bivchinato osher hammussag lanetzach. veraa ki tikkun lekarer oz harticha hu lechallekem vegomer, veamar "achallekem" vegomer.

rashi: Unetatticha likhal ammim. bisserani sheatidim latzet mimmenni od kahal veammim, veaf al pi sheamar li goy ukehal goyim, goy amar li al binyamin; kehal goyim – hare shenayim levad mibbinyamin, veshuv lo nolad li ben, limmedani sheatid echad mishshevatay lehechalek, veatta otah mattana ani noten lecha:
ohc: Hinni mafrecha vegomer. kafal lomar "mafrecha vehirbiticha" keneged shene banim sheyyihyu lo od, kemo shepperesh haddevarim yaakov beamro "veatta" (Bereshit 35:11). veamro unetatticha likhal ammim, perush sheyyihyu shene habbanim kol echad lekahal veam:

rashi: Tzidkat yesharim tatztzilem uvehavvat bogdim yillachedu. bahauot shehem osim hem nilkadim. vehammikra mesoras hu, kelomar: uvogdim behavvat yillachedu:
targum: Tzidketa ditritze tiftze inun uvazoze veshilumehon mitachadin:

rashi: Vereshit oni. hi tippa rishona, shello raa keri miyyamav (Bereshit Rabba):
Oni. kochi, kemo matzati on li (Hoshea 12), merov onim, uleen onim (Yeshayahu 40):
Yeter seet. rauy hayita lihyot yeter al achecha vichhunna, leshon nesiut kappayim:
Veyeter az. bemalchut, kemo: veyitten oz lemalko (Shmuel 1 2), umi garam lecha lehafesid kol elle?
ohc: Reuven bechori atta vegomer. yesh lehair ma chiddush modia yaakov liruven ki hu habbechor. od amro kochi vereshit oni ma hu dato baze, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bereshit Rabba 98:4) ki hodio baze ki hu tippa rishona, vaadayin tzarich ladaat ma hi kavvanat hodaa zo liruven. od lamma kafal lomar "kochi" velo hispik lomar "reshit oni". od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro yeter seet veyeter az. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (sham) amru "seet" ze kehunna "az" ze malchut vechulei, vetzarich ladaat lamma lo amar chelek pi shenayim achar sheyyarad lefaret perate hammussag leven bechor. veuneklos hosif lehazekirah betargumo veamar telat chulakin vechulei. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro pachaz kammayim al totar. verashi zichrono livracha perush al asher pachazta kammayim, laze "al totar", lo yihye lecha hayyeterot uma hu happachaz, "ki alita mishkeve" vegomer. vaadayin tzerichin anu lemodai lamma lo hispik lomar al totar ki alita, achar shehappachazut hu kinnuy leavon haya lo lehazekir heavon levad, uma li asao bechippazon o shello bechippazon. od lamma hifsik baonesh beemtza hodaat heavon, shehaya lo lomar al ze hadderech: al totar pachaz kammayim ki alita, o al ze hadderech: pachaz kammayim ki alita vegomer al totar. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro alita mishkeve avicha leshon rabbim. od ma kavvanat amro az chillalta ki mashma sheasa shene devarim bizmannim mechullakim, velaze amar az vegomer perush ki letzad shehachillul haya bizman nifrad mizzeman sheala yetzue aviv laze amar az chillalta. vetzarich ladaat ma hi hachillul sheasa zulat alita mishkeve vegomer, veim hakkavvana hi shebbeemtzaut aliyyato chillel vegomer haya lo lomar alita vegomer, chillalta vegomer. vehaddavar muvan sheaz baaloto chillel yetzui velo haya tzarich lomar az.

Vekodem lavo leveur hakketuvim yesh lanu lachkor chakira achat, vehi ech asa yaakov hefech ma shekkatuv battora (Devarim 21:16) "lo yuchal levakker et ben haahuva al pene ven hassenua habbechor", vehu bikker yosef ben rachel haahuva etzlo al pene reuven ben lea hassenua. vekodem tzarich latet lev im haavot haya alehem chiyyuv kiyyum kol hattora, ki halo matzinu sheyyaakov nasa shete achayot, veavraham lo mal ad shehaya zaken vechen kamma peratim. umeatta ma makom lekushya zo shebbikker ben haahuva, tihye zo kaarla shel avraham kodem shennitztavva vechinsiat shete achayot leyaakov. veraiti laramban (Bereshit 26:5) shennatan taam leyaakov shennasa shete achayot ki lo haya baaretz, ad kan, veen devarav chazakim besamochot, ki mi gilla lo sod ze shello haya shomer tora ella baaretz, achar sheen hefresh ben haaretz lechutz laaretz beotan perate hammitzvot shello shemarum haavot.

Vehannachon beenay hu ki haavot kibbelu hattora mishshem shekkibbel minnoach shekkibbel mechanoch shekkibbel meadam harishon, asher lemadah mippi haggevura, dichtiv: "az raah vegomer vayyomer laadam" (Iyov 28:27), (zohar chelek 1 199:), veshebbeemtzautah tzivvahu laavod gan eden, uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 2:15) "leavdah uleshamrah". ach lo nitztavva ella al sheva mitzvot sheim yaavor alehem yehareg, aval shear hattora karov lesachar im yaase verachok min hahefsed im lo yekayyem, uchederech sheyyesh lanu gam achar netinat hattora, sheyyesh mitzvot sheim yaase otam haadam yittol sachar veim lav en lo onesh alehem, kemo chen haya miyyom bero elohim adam bechol hattora chutz mishsheva mitzvot.

Vehaavot letzad chavivutam baAdonai vecheshkam beosher elyon kiyyemu hakkol, keamro (Bereshit 26:5) "ekev asher shama" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (yoma koach:) kiyyem avraham avinu afillu eruve tavshilin, veet banav hekim tachtav lehareviach toelet hammitzvot veesek hattora. aval bemakom shehayu roim toelet devar hahatzlacha lahem, kemo shettomar yaakov keshehirgish behatzelachato benissue shete haachayot, heelim ayin merevach hannimshach mikkiyyum hammitzva hahi, kevan sheen lo onesh im lo yekayyemenna kol od shello nittena tora. uma gam im nomar shehayu osim al pi haddibbur, ki haavot neviim hayu vaAdonai amar lahem laasot ken. vedavar ze dome lema shekkatav rambam behilchot yesode hattora (perek 9) ki navi sheamar laavor al issur meissure hattora lefi shaa shomin lo keeliyyahu behar hakkarmel vegomer. gam yeamen yaakov sheasa maase al pi nevuato sheyyachol lissa shete achayot lefi shaa, lo sheyyeaker issur shete achayot. uma gam bizman shello haya lahem onesh al haddavar ella hakeravat hattoelet im yekayyemu kannizkar. gam yehuda al yede malach huresha lakachat tamar, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 84) lema shennimshach mimmenna mehaatzalat neshamot hakkedoshot.

Ulefi ze nomar, ki yaakov nira beenav lehaanish reuven al asher chillel yetzuo venatal mimmennu habbechora, o shekken neemar lo binvua, uchemo shekken amar hakkatuv bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 5:1): "reuven bechor yisrael ki hu habbechor, uvechallelo yetzue aviv nittena bechorato livne yosef".

Vaadayin en haddavar maspik, ki lamma lo nittena ella leyosef velo lihuda o lishar achim haggedolim. uvesefer hazzohar parashat vayyishlach daf 176 katav taam haddavar veze leshono: beshaata deal legabbah delea, kol hahu lelya reuteh velibbeh hava berachel dechashiv derachel ihi vechulei, ahdar ovada leatreh vechulei, bechorateh ahderat leyosef" vechulei ad kan. hinne taam ze maspik lintilat bechora meruven vetaamod beyosef, ki hu kefi haemet sheala bemachshava rishona bevia rishona keshehetil zaro yaakov chashav beimmo.

Ella kashe, lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lomar "uvechallelo yetzue aviv" vegomer, halo afillu im lo haya reuven mechallel yetzue aviv, habbechora leyosef nogaat kannizkar. uleyashshev hainyan, davar yadua hi ki kol ruchaniyyut shebbaolam mitchallek leshalosh bechinot: echad kedushsha, veechad chol, veechad chelek ra, vechol achat mehashshelosha totzi anafeha vehattaava livchinatah. chelek hakkedushsha yafriach anfe hattov vehaosher hannitzchi vetitavve lammuskalot, chelek hachol yitavve leechol hearev lappe vehannechmad laayin veyivne batte avanim veafar vichonen malbushim vahachanot nidmim, chelek hara yitavve lechol tiuv veyaase kol asher sane Adonai, veyivchar ligzol ulerammot uleshakker veleechol chelek hattame nevelot uterefot shekatzim vechulei, veyeerav lenafsho lechabbek basar tame nidda goya eshet ish vezachar hammeruchakim mibbechinat hakkedushsha, umishshelosha elle yeshno kol hove vechol nimtza ben mechelke hattov vehattohora, ben bechelke hammemutztza, vehu sheanu korim chol, ben bechelke hara vehattuma.

Vetzivva Adonai leam yisrael ki letzad shehem bechinat hakkedushsha, leval yitamu mechelek hara lo bemaachol velo bemishte velo bedibbur velo bemachshava velo biriyya velo bishmia velo bereach. maachol – leval yochal baale chayyim temeim uterefot unevelot ushekatzim vechulei, velo yishte yen nesech veyen arla vechaddome. dibbur – shello yedabber sheker urechilut venivlut happe velashon hara vechaddome. machshava – leval yachshov baavoda zara velo biznut velo yitgae bedato velo yacharosh aven. reiyya – leval yabbit beyofi ishsha haasura, keamro "al tifnu el haelilim" vegomer (zohar kedoshim fag:) velo yabbit bidvarim haasurim lirot. shemia – shello yishma devarim hameshakketzim velo kol ishsha haasura vechaddome. reach – shello yariach reach devarim haasurim. ucheneged kol bechina uvechina yesh chelek hachol vechelek hakkedushsha, vegazar Adonai sheyyihye chelek hakkedushsha mitzva laasot ken vechelek hachol reshut, uveet asher yidbak haadam bivchina achat mehem, kemo chen tidbak nafsho bashshoresh hahu, im letov im lehefko.

Umeatta, hagam shettihye nefesh adam tehora zakka uvara, beemtzaut asher yachnis lifnimiyyuto mechelek hara tihye hannefesh hahi meorevet mishshete bechinot tov vara, veze yesovev lannefesh hahi teimat hammar lehityasser o guf vanefesh baolam hazze o nefesh levad leachar moto, vehu sod hakkevisa sheamru beshilhe shabbat (152:) yinnatnu lechoves. veyesh lecha ladaat ki kefi bechinat haraa shennidbeka bannefesh mehara kemo chen titavve nafsho, kemo shettomar im nafsho nechlea mittumat hanniuf titavve nafsho livchina zo kefi ma shehikdamnu ki kol bechina titavve lechayyotze bah, vechi yarbe haadam lehaleit nafsho mechelke hara tigdal bah cheshek hara veyibbadel veyitrachek mibbechinat hattov. tikkach kelal ze beyadcha ki en lecha devar maase baolam velo nidnud davar sheen lo yesod baruchaniyyut, vechol devar issur shehodia Adonai ki hu ze asur kol hannidbak bo hare hu moshech lenafsho chelek ra, vetze ulemad ma shekkatav besefer hayyashar (sear 9) shechibber rabbenu tam behavechanat hannefesh ladaat adam nafsho ma tivah. vetimtza sheyyesh adam sheen nafsho mesichato asot niuf veyesh nefesh adam shemmesichato al haddavar, vedavar ze gorem im hu davek benafsho mibbechinat hara, otah bechina enah yechola lehappech tivah hara lisno kayyotze bo, vehu gam ken sod amram zichronam livracha (sukka nov:) evar katan yesh baadam, masbio raev marivo savea.

Gam yesh legallot havechana achat baze, ki yesh adam ki yivvaled yihye tivo lahut achar asot ra veyagdel asot resha, veyesh adam tivo belo shum torach yechdal mibbechinat hara uvenakel yachzor leachor im yachpotz. davar ze yimmashech mehaharkava bishat zeria, im nefesh adam hazzoraat choshevet becheshek hammaase letzad hammaase ki yeerav lo, veen tzarich lomar im yitten eno bechos acher o yachshov bemachshavot shello bemino hattahor. vetze ulemad mibbene chizkiyya alav hashshalom (ayin yaakov berachot 10:) sheyyatzu shenehem ovde avoda zara letzad machshevet hammolid baamamim, ki hammachshava beoto matztzav bona habbinyan bannolad. veze lecha ikkar gadol ki hammazriim hem habbonim lenefesh hannolad, veim tizzara benikkayon vetohar – kaddish mishshemayya nachit, veim tivvaled bo kol shehu mechelek hara, derech sham tikkanes bechinat hara vetaal tzachanato uvasho. ze hakkelal: lo yitavve livchinat hara ella mino, vechol sheen bo min ra kol ikkar lo titavve laddavar. veim lekachacha adam lomar vahare adam meshullal mechelek hara haya, veech chata veavar al divre Adonai, emor lo shogeg haya, gam lo bechinat hara gamur haya etz haddaat, veharaya ki natua began elohim makom sheen ra. gam amru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 21) sheim haya mamtin ad erev shabbat kodesh haya mekaddesh al gefen leman deamar (sanhedrin 70.) gefen haya, ha lamadta shello haya bechinat hara ella kidvar chol beerech kodesh, vehu sod.

Veim tomar ech avraham yalad yishmael veyitzchak esav. yesh lecha ladaat ki hem chelke hara shezzara bahem haav terach avi avraham oved avoda zara haya, uchesheyyatzta nefesh avraham yatza devuka mibbechinat hara, ella sheggavar alav chesed avraham vechafa bechinat hara ad shehifridah umesarah beyishmael, vaadayin hayu nitzotze hara devekim ad shebba yitzchak vehifridam birtichat hakkedushsha, vehu amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 63:8) ki yaakov yatza naki uvar vechulei.

Umeatta nashkif bemaase yaakov, ki beet hazeraat reuven hayta machshavto lo shelema bivchinat hattov, bifrat ze shello asa maase bimkom hammachshava, uvechina zo enah bemadregat hattov. uchemo shettimtza shechashvu zichronam livracha (nedarim 20:) bedome laze bene temura. vahagam ki yishtanne maase yaakov letzad ki machshavto vidiato shelema, perush, ki haya choshev berachel, gam haya bedato uvidiato ki hi zot rachel, lo shehaya yodea shehi lea vechashav berachel shellaze yikkare bene temura, af al pi chen haddavar hu kol shehu mibbechinat lo tahor. vetze ulemad ma sheyyatza mizze, ki yatza reuven uvilbel yetzue aviv, hare sheasa peullato maase habbilti tahor ma shello asa chen echad mikkol hashshevatim, vaafillu al yede nissayon shel yosef. vahagam sheamru rabbanan (shabbat noah:) kol haomer reuven chata eno ella toe, im kol ze hakkatuv heela alav hachet, o letzad sheasao o letzad sherauy likkare alav.

Uma shettimtza sheyyehuda shachav im tamar, shete teshuvot baddavar: haachat ki lo yedaah, vegam malach anaso, keamram zichronam livracha (makkot 23:) befasuk "tzadka mimmenni" (Bereshit 38:26) sheyyatzta bat kol veamra "mimmenni yatzu haddevarim", ma sheen ken reuven deadrabba hattora heida ki asa maase bilti hagun.

Uma sheraiti leharav hammufla 215 rozanis 233 (parashat derachim davar acher) shehelitz baado ki bilha hayta mefuttat aviv, vediyyek tevat "pilegesh" sheenah bekiddushin vechulei 380, en devarav nirim, ki vadday shebbekiddushin hayu uchemo shepperashti sham bimkomo (Bereshit 30:3) uchemo shekkatuv bekunetres harayot. uma sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 35:22) "pilegesh", ulay shehi sevarat reuven shebbah shagag. o ramaz hakkatuv taam bilbule yetzue aviv sheamar: lo day zilzul immo bifne rachel haggevira, ella od titzalzel bifne happilegesh, uleolam eshet yaakov hayta vehakkatuv heela alav sheshshachav immah.

Umeatta taskil ladaat ki divre hazzohar sheamar shettaam habbechora hu ki hammachshava bimkomah amda beyosef, uma sheamar hakkatuv bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 5:1) "uvechallelo yetzue aviv" vegomer, hu inyan echad, ki hachillul yatza meemtzaut hammachshava shello hayta belea ella berachel, veim hayta machshavto belea lo haya reuven mechallel yetzue aviv.

Uvaze navo leveur hakketuvim kaftor vaferach, ki yaakov techillat devaro hattov kesheratza lehasir habbechora meruven amad lenes lefanav ma shehikdamnu ki toldot hara babbanim hatechalatah tihye mehammolid, laze chash yaakov sheyyomar reuven belibbo ki yaakov hu hassovev lammaase hahu kefi ma shehikdamnu, ki hammolid yolid sharashim benefesh habben im letov im lera, uletzad shechet reuven haya bivchinat hashshechiva ba lehasir chashad mimmennu veamar reuven bechori atta vegomer, hinne yesh beovre avera bivchinat hanniuf shalosh haderagot: 1) shennoafim veyoldim banim shello kahogen. 2) mazriim beissur veeno molid ben meotah hahazraa, veyesh begeder ze kamma haderagot o shebba al eshet ish velo yalad mimmenna mamzer, o sheshshichet bezachar, o sheshshichet artza, o bechezyonot layla bemikre. 3) shemmitchammem haadam vekashto ninar beemtzaut machshavot raot vechaddome. vechol shalosh elle hem madregat hattiuv hassanouy beene hakkadosh baruch hu, laze amar keneged shelashtam bechori vechochi vereshit oni. bechori atta shello yaladti ben kodem lecha shello bederech ketubba vekiddushin ki ze gam ken mehabbilti nachon, kochi shello yatza mimmenni zera kodem lecha, reshit oni shello ninara kashti, ha lamadta ki yaakov meshullal mibbechina zo shel niuf behechlet.

Gam ramaz beamro kochi vereshit oni shennotzar mittippa rishona sheyyatza miyyaakov, umizze atta lamed ki lo baal al habbetulim, sheim ken lo hayta mitabberet mibbia rishona, ella hotzi betulim baetzba kede shello tippased hattippa. ha lamadta ki gam bishat maase lo higbir taava haggufiyyit umaasehu haya letachlit devar kedushsha, umeatta en makom lachshod beyaakov mimmaase reuven ki hu hassovev, vezo hi tachlit kavvanato velo leshabbeach atzmo nitkavven.

Veamro yeter seet vegomer, perush ki netilat pi shenayim ramaz hu beamro bechori atta, usetam bechor notel pi shenayim. ella haggedulla vehakkehunna hi mehilchot derech eretz, velifamim tithappech hammaala lemi sherauy lah, hagam sheyyihye katan lifne bechor. laze amar veyesh lecha yitron od littol hakkehunna vehammalchut:
O yirtze ki lo nae littol beyitron bechinat hakkehunna uveyitron bechinat hammalchut yoter mikkol habbechorot, ki kol habbechorot lo yishvu livchinat bechorato shel reuven mehatteamim sheamar yaakov.

Vead atta hare hechzik atzmo bemushelal mibbechinat hara vehechzik habbechora ki lo liruven nae velo yae, veachar kach ba latet taam lishne devarim, ben lema shennogea laggedulla shehusera mimmennu ben lema shennogea livchinat maase bilti hagun mibbeten mi yatza hakkerach, veamar keneged ma shennogea labbechora ugedulloteha amar:
Vayyomer yosef vegomer lo chen avi. taam sheheerich kol elle haddevarim "lo chen avi ki ze habbechor", vechazar od lomar "sim yemincha" vegomer:

Hinne nistappek yosef beechad mishshene derachim: haechad hu shechashav yaakov ki habbanim hayu lekuchim beyad yosef bishat beracha, veyadua haddavar ki yikkach bimino habbechor uvismolo hatztzair, uchefi ze yihyu lifne yaakov habbechor lismolo vehatztzair limino, vaasher al ken sikkel et yadav ki menashshe habbechor veoto yasim aviv beyad yemino. vederech sheni shebbechavvanat hamechuvvan sikkel et yadav lasum yemino al rosh hatztzair, laze amar lo battechilla im kavvanato hi lechashvo ki lekacham avihem beyado habbechor limino shel yosef amar lo chen avi kemo sheatta choshev ki ze habbechor, veim atta yodea ki sedurim habbechor limincha vegomer ella sheatta monea yemincha mehabbechor laze amar sim yemincha al rosho, perush lamma timna hattova mibbealeha, uchevar yadata ma sheggaram davar ze.

Shamma kavru vegomer. leheyot shehammeara baalah harishon haya efron, laze amar "shamma kavru et avraham veet sara", hare nitmaatu bealeha harishonim veamdu yorshe avraham shehem yitzchak veyishmael. shamma kavru et yitzchak vegomer nitkavven lemaet chelek yishmael, veamda leyorshe yitzchak shehem yaakov veesav, shamma kavarti et lea ba lemaet esav, vehaed "bekivri asher kariti li" (Bereshit 50:5) vedarshu zichronam livracha (sota 13:) vechulei:

rashi: Vezot asher dibber lahem avihem vayvarech otam. vahalo yesh mehem shello bercham ella kinteran? ella chach perusho: vezot asher dibber lahem avihem ma sheneemar bainyan; yachol shello verach liruven, shimon velevi, talo vayvarech otam – kullam bemashma:
Ish asher kevirchato. beracha haatida lavo al kol echad veechad:

Berach otam. lo haya lo lomar ella ish asher kevirchato berach oto, ma talmud lomar berach otam? lefi shennatan lihuda gevurat ari ulevinyamin chatifato shel zeev ulenaftali kalluto shel ayyal, yachol shello chelalan kullam bechol habberachot, talmud lomar berach otam:
ohc: Kol elle shivte vegomer. tzarich ladaat minyan ze shel shenem asar, im levi bichlal, im ken en hakkatuv mone leyosef ella beechad, veyaakov amar elav (Bereshit 48:5) "efrayim umenashshe kiruven veshimon". veim en levi bichlal, kemo shemmatzinu shehakkatuv lo menao bechumash happekudim becheshbon shenem asar shevatim shebbaddegalim shelosha bechol degel, kashe lamma yiggara levi mibbirkat aviv? veim letzad shello matzinu lo ella kintur velo amar ella hamevorachim, im ken lo yavo bamminyan gam reuven veshimon.

Veulay ki lo hitchil hakkatuv limnot efrayim umenashshe beminyan shenayim ad achar yetziat mitzrayim, vechan mana hakkatuv yosef, veze dochak. vehannire lomar baze hu ki letzad sheamar hakkatuv "ish asher kevirchato berach" vegomer, umatzinu sheyyaakov kalal shimon velevi bichlal echad, laze mana shenehem beechad:
