Asher dibber vegomer vayvarech vegomer. hagam sherainu shello berach reuven velo shimon velo levi, yaggid hakkatuv ki dibburo hakkashe lahem hi birchatam, vehu amro asher dibber vegomer vayvarech vegomer. uma sheamar liruven divre kintur sham tzivva et habberacha, al derech amram (sifre behaalotcha) atida avoda shettachzor labbechorot, uchefi ze kevan shekkava lo shem habbechora atid hu laamod lesharet leatid lavo, vetimtza shehatztzaddikim tzofim umabbitim al heatid. uletaam ze hishtaddel yaakov liknot habbechora meesav leval yihye lo chelek baavoda leatid lavo. vahagam shennittena haavoda lalviyyim shekulim hem veyavou shenehem laavod avodat hakkodesh ki maalin bakkodesh velo moridin. vegam shimon velevi bercham bema sheamar "arur appam" – zo hi birchatam shekkillel letigboret hamekalkel umeria, gam ma shechillekam vehefitzam hu lehassagat tachlit haosher gam ken.

Asher kevirchato. perush harauy lo kefi bechinat nishmato uchefi maasav, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki hannefashot kol achat yesh lah bechinat hammaala: yesh shemmaalatah kehunna, veyesh malchut, veyesh keter tora, veyesh gevura, veyesh osher, veyesh hatzelacha. venitkavven yaakov binvua levarech kol echad kefi birchato harauy lah: hammelech bemalchut vehakkohen bichhunna, vechen al ze hadderech, velo hafach hammesillot.

Berach otam vegomer. amar otam leshon rabbim, leheyot ki birkat kol echad veechad toil leatzmo ulechol echav, kemo shettomar kesheyyevarech lammelech sheyyado beoref oyvav, hinne maggia hattov lechol echav. vechen kesheyyarbe maalat echad veshifo vehaderagato, lechol echav yaggia gam ken miktzat davar, laze amar ish asher kevirchato berach otam.

rashi: Nezem zahav beaf chazir. shemmelachlech otah baashpot, ken talmid chacham hassar min hadderech hattova:
Vesarat taam. poresh min hattora:
targum: Kadashe dedahava binchire dachazirta hechna itteta deshappire vesare taama:

rashi: Shimon velevi achim. beetza achat al shechem veal yosef; vayyomru ish el achiv, veatta lechu venahargehu, mi hem? itto reuven o yehuda, hare lo hiskimu baharigato; itto bene hashshefachot, hare lo hayta sinatan shelema, shenneemar vehu naar et bene vilha veet bene zilpa vegomer, yissashchar uzevulun lo hayu medabberim bifne achehem haggedolim mehem; al karchacha shimon velevi hem shekkeraam avihem achim:
Kele chamas. ummanut zo shel retzicha, chamas hu videhem – mibbirkat esav hi zo, ummanut shello hi – veattem chamastem otah hemennu:

Mecherotehem. leshon kele zayin, hassayif bilshon yevani 270, tanchuma. davar acher mecherotehem – beeretz meguratam nahagu atzman bichle chamas, kemo mechorotayich umoldotayich (Yechezkel 16), vezehu targum shel unkelos:
ohc: Shimon velevi vegomer. amro achim ki yeshnam beachva betivam vedaat achat shava kedaat achim, vedavar ze lo yishve bechol achim. o yirtze latet taam lemaasehem asher asu bemaase shechem uvemaase yosef, veamar shettivam betigboret yesod haesh. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (yoma 22:) shaul beachat vealta lo hammelucha mimmennu, vedavid bechamma velo alta lo. vehattaam hu letzad ki shaul tivo mazug vedavid tivo cham, keamro (Shmuel 1 16:12) "vehu admoni". vaAdonai dan et haadam kefi harekavato, ki mi sheggover bo yesod haesh, im heyot sheyyitatztzem bechol otzem hazzerizut baavodat hashshem, lo yimmalet mehashshiggayon. uvechelek muat mehitatztzemuto sheyyaase adam mazug yarviach atzmo mishshegiot. veamar ki shimon velevi achim leshon chom, velaze killel leappam veevratam ki kashata, veyadua hu ki haaf vehaevra tigdal misod haesh kesheyyitrabbe.

Veamar ki letzad shehem betigboret hachom, laze kele chamas mecherotehem. vedimma maasehem lichle chamas, lomar ki lo yarshu kelehem mishshoresh nefesh hammolid, ella kele chamas hem devarim hammukkarim lahem. uferush mecherotehem leshon hakkara, shello paal bah lahem meavihem ella hagebarat haesh, aval hem meemtzaut davar ze asu maasim bilti nechonim kemaase yosef.

Od yirtze beamro kele chamas vegomer, perush hammecher shemmachru et yosef chamas mecharuhu al ma shello nitchayyev lahem baddin. vahagam shekkol haachim mecharuhu, keshettaskil tire shehem hayu haikkar, mittechilla bevoo amru ish el achiv vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 99,6) shehem shimon velevi vehem sheyyaatzu alav hariga, vehakkol haya mehem, vechen hu bedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha.

rashi: Yehuda atta yoducha achecha. lefi shehochiach et harishonim bekinturim, hitchil yehuda nasog laachorav, (shello yochichennu al maase tamar) ukerao yaakov bedivre ritztzuy, yehuda lo atta chemotam (Bereshit Rabba):
Yadcha beoref oyvecha. bime david – veoyvay tatta li oref (Shmuel 2 22):
Bene avicha. al shem shehayu minnashim harebe, lo amar bene immecha kederech sheamar yitzchak:
ohc: Yehuda atta vegomer – tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar atta, kevan sheimmo haya medabber, uma ba lemaet? od, lamma lo amar "veyadcha" vegomer veyishtachavu" vegomer, kevan shehem devarim nosafim?

Venire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: atta yoducha perush, en hasserara matchelet leatid kederech shear berachot haamurim lishar haachim shehem lizmannim rechokim lichsheyyikkansu laaretz, ella atta beatzmecha yoducha achecha, vechen hu omer bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 5:2) "yehuda gavar beechav", uchesheyyavo zeman sheyyadcha beoref oyvecha vetitgabber al haoyvim, azay yishtachavu lecha vegomer veyamlichucha alehem, veze haya bime shaul kesheasa david hannitztzachon haggadol beoref oyvav himlichuhu yisrael alehem:

rashi: Titmoch kavod. keneset yisrael tekarev tamid lichvod hakkadosh baruch hu vetorato:
Vearitzim yitmechu osher. bene edom mitkarvim etzel genevot mamon vegazel:
targum: Itteta chasidta falga aykara vaashine rahatin batar utera:

rashi: Goren haatad. mukkaf atadin haya, verabbotenu darshu (sota 13), al shem hammeora, shebbau kol malche chenaan unesye yishmael lammilchama, vechevan sherau chitro shel yosef taluy baarono shel yaakov amdu chullan vetalu vo chitrehem vehikkifuhu ketarim kegoren hammukkaf seyag shel kotzim:
Yesh mefazzer. memono, kegon litzdaka, venosaf od:
Vechosech. atzmo miyyosher, ach lemachsor yihye lo:
targum: It defared umosif tuv vechasech min teritzuta chuserana leh:

rashi: Vayyiru ache yosef ki met avihem. mahu vayyiru? hikkiru bemitato etzel yosef, shehayu regilim lisod al shulchano shel yosef vehaya mekarvan bishvil kevod aviv, umishshemmet yaakov lo kervan (Bereshit Rabba):

Lo yistemenu. shemma yistemenu; lu mitchallek leinyanim harebe; yesh lu meshammesh bilshon bakkasha uleshon halevay, kegon lu yehi chidvarecha, lu shemaeni, velu hoalnu, lu matnu, veyesh lu meshammesh bilshon im veulay, kegon lu chachmu (Devarim 32), lu hikshavta lemitzvotay (Yeshayahu 48), velu anochi shokel al kappay (Shmuel 2 18); veyesh lu meshamesh bilshon shemma, lu yistemenu, veen lo od dome vammikra, vehu leshon ulay, kemo ulay lo telech haishsha acharay, leshon shemma hu; veyesh ulay leshon bakkasha, kegon ulay yire Adonai beeni (Shmuel 2 16), ulay Adonai oti (Yehoshua 14), hare hu kemo lu yehi chidvarecha, veyesh ulay leshon im, ulay yesh 50 tzaddikim:
ohc: Lu yistemenu vegomer. perush, dilma, ella sheen chaver lah bechol hattora, vetzarich ladaat lamma yedabber hakkatuv lashon ze shemmashmauto haragil hu hefech hakkavvana, vahagam sheen makom litot lehavin bo zulat "dilma", af al pi chen haya lo lomar lashon tzodek "pen" o "ulay".

Venire ki hakkatuv divre atzmo kaamar "lu", vehakkavvana baze shehem yaru al davar shehalevay sheyyihye chen sheyyihye meshiv lahem, vehu amro yashiv lanu et kol haraa, vehayu mitztaarim hashshevatim keshiur shennitztaer yosef mitztziddam. uvaze lo hayu mitchayyevim levassof mehaggaluyyot umehatztzarot bead chet ze, keamram zichronam livracha (shabbat 10:) galut mitzrayim vegam baggalut haacharon, vetze ulemad ma haya laasara ammude olam:

rashi: Hu veechav vechol haolim itto. bachazaratan hikdim echav lammitzrim haolim itto, uvahalichatan hikdim mitzrayim leechav, shenneemar vayyaalu itto kol avde faro vegomer, veachar kach kol bet yosef veechav, ella lefi sherau chavod sheasu malche chenaan shettalu chitrehem vaarono shel yaakov nahagu vahem kavod:
ohc: Vechol haolim vegomer achare kavro vegomer. amro "kol haolim" lomar shello nedar mehem ish mikkol hammachane hakkaved, gam rechev gam parashim, venatan hattaam ki kullam halchu lidvar mitzva likbor et aviv, velo chazar echad mehem ad shekkavar yosef et aviv, vehu amro vayyashav vegomer vechol haolim vegomer kullam shavu, vehattaam "achare kavro" shekkullam hayta halichatam lidvar mitzva usheluche mitzva en nizzokim lo bahalichatam velo bachazaratam (fesachim 8:).

O yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyashav yosef vegomer vechol haolim, veteda beeze olim ani merabbe hakkol shello nedar mehem ish – otam shehayta kavvanat aliyyatam likbor et aviv. uvamme yihyu nikkarim ellu meellu? laze gamar omer: achare kavro et aviv – ellu shennitakkevu ad achare kavro vegomer, machashavtam nikkeret mittoch maasehem ki leshem mitzva bau, veotam lo met ad echad. aval haolim lesibba acheret enam bichlal haddavar.

rashi: Befe chanef. chanef hammesit chavero bederech ra, mashchito befiv:
Uvedaat tzaddikim yechaletzu. vehatztzaddik nechelatz mimmennu bedaat hattora, shehizhira alav "lo tove lo vegomer" (Devarim 13:9):
targum: Nichla befumeh mechabbel chavreh vetzadike bidiathon mishtezvin:

rashi: Binyamin zeev yitraf. zeev hu asher yitraf; nibba al sheyyihyu atidin lihyot chatfanin, vachataftem lachem ish ishto befilegesh begiva (Shoftim 21), venibba al shaul shehaya notzeach beoyvav saviv, shenneemar veshaul lachad hammelucha vayyillachem bemoav vegomer uveedom vegomer uvechol asher yifne yarshia (Shmuel 1 14):

Babboker yochal ad. leshon bizza veshalal, hameturgam adaa, veod yesh lo dome bilshon ivrit az chullak ad shalal (Yeshayahu 33), veal shaul hu omer sheamad bitchillat perichatan uzerichatan shel yisrael:

Velaerev yechallek shalal. af mishshettishka shimshan shel yisrael al yede nevuchadnetztzar, sheyyaglem levavel, yechallek shalal, mardechay veester shehem mibbinyamin yechalleku et shelal haman, shenneemar hinne vet haman natatti leester. veunkelos tirgem al shelal hakkohanim bekadshe hammikdash:
ohc: Binyamin zeev yitraf. nitkavven el shaul sheasa maase zeev shettoref bimhirut, ki minhag hazzeev hu sheeno mitakkev bitrefato, ella kol kach hu memaher vetoref. kemo chen asa hu velo himtin lazzeman shekkava lo shemuel, ella miher (Shmuel 1 13:8) litrof, umizze haya sibba shello achal ella babboker venifseka malchuto.

Veamro velaerev perush, leet erev malchuto yechalek, sheyyomru (Shmuel 1 18:7) "hikka shaul vegomer vedavid berivvotav". o yirmoz shebbeemtzaut sibbato titchallek malchut bet david, al derech amram zichronam livracha (yoma 22:) kesheamar david "atta vetziva tachleku hassade" yatzta bat kol veamra: "rechavam veyaravam yachleku hammalchut", umeaz heeriv shimshan shel yisrael baavonot:

rashi: Umoladtecha vegomer. im tolid od, lo yihyu beminyan banay, ella betoch shivte efrayim umenashshe yihyu nichlalim, velo yehe lahem shem bashshevatim leinyan hannachala; veaf al pi shennechleka haaretz leminyan gulgelotam, kedichtiv larav tarbe nachalato (Bamidbar 26), vechol ish veish natal beshave chutz min habbechorot, mikkol makom lo nikreu shevatim ella ellu, (lehattil goral haaretz leminyan shemot hashshevatim venasi lechol shevet vashevet udegalim laze velaze):
ohc: Umoladtecha asher vegomer. perush shello yimmane yosef bimkom shelosha shevatim ella bimkom shenayim. uchefi ze lo yikkare od shevet yosef beminyan hashshevatim zulat shevet efrayim veshevet menashshe, uchemo chen matzinu shekken hu.

Veyesh lanu lachakor zot, lamma hotzi yaakov et yosef mimminyan hashshevatim, kemo shemmatzinu shello nimna bichlal hashshevatim ki im efrayim umenashshe, velamma lo yimmane hu gam ken veyihyu arbaa asar shevatim im levi, ki Adonai amar elav (Bereshit 35:11) sheyyihyu mimmennu shene shevatim nosafim, lo sheyyeaker shem yosef. gam tzarich ladaat mi amar leyaakov ki shene haggoyim sheamar lo Adonai sheyyihyu mimmennu hem bene yosef velo bene shear banav, veyoter haya lo litlot velomar shehem peretz vazerach shehem beyoter meullim kefi haemet shehem shalshelet hammelucha.

Veulay ki bene yehuda nirmezu bema sheamar lo od sham "umelachim mechalatzecha yetzeu" (Bereshit 35:11). ella mi yomar shekkavvanat Adonai beamro "umelachim mechalatzecha" vegomer hi zot veod acheret, dilma hem hem "goy ukehal goyim" hem hem hammelachim. veod mi yomar sheen haddevarim neemarim al bene shear haachim?

Achen bema shennaskil al devar habbore sheamar elav binvua "goy ukehal goyim yihye mimmekka umelachim mechalatzecha yetzeu" (Bereshit 35:11), peshat haddevarim yaggid sheal yaakov hu omer shemmimmennu yetzu, lo mibbanav.

Ella yesh ladaat maamaram zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 1 180) ki yosef hu bechinat nefesh yaakov, vehu sheramaz hakkatuv beamro (Bereshit 37:2) "elle toldot yaakov yosef", vehu amro (Tehillim 77:16) "bene yaakov veyosef", veramzu chachme emet ki hu bechinat milluy havvav, shehammilluy kaot atzmo. veal pi hakedama zo yityashshevu kol haddikdukim, ki yosef hu bechinat yaakov uvemadregat av lashshevatim yikkare, karashum gam ken beamro "bene yaakov veyosef", uchefi ze kesheamar Adonai leyaakov sheyyetzu mimmennu od banim – ze yaakov ze yosef, velaze lo hilbish hannevua bishar banav, velaze dikdek lomar "shene vanecha vegomer li hem", perush, bemadregat bene yaakov lo bemadregat bene vanav, velaze hosif levaer veamar "kiruven veshimon", umeatta hare yosef bemadregat av keyaakov veen haav nimne im habbanim begeder echad kemo sheen yaakov nimne im hashshevatim.

rashi: Vaymarruhu varobbu. vaymarruhu echav, vaymarruhu potifar veishto, leasro; leshon vaymarru et chayyehem:

Varobbu. naasu lo echav anshe riv. veen hallashon hazze leshon paalu, sheim ken haya lo linnaked "varavu", kemo hemma me meriva asher ravu vegomer (Bamidbar 20), veaf im leshon reviyyat chitztzim hu kach haya lo linnaked; eno ella leshon poalu, kemo shommu shamayim (Yirmeyahu 2), shehu leshon hushammu; vechen rommu meat, shehu leshon huremu, ella shelleshon huremu vehushammu al yede acherim, uleshon shommu, rommu, robbu meelehem hu – meshommim et atzmam, nitrommu meatzmam, naasu anshe riv, vechen dommu yoshve i, kemo nidmu, vechen tirgem unkelos, venakmohi:
Baale chitztzim. shelleshonam kachetz, vetargumo leshon vattehi hammechetza, otan shehayu reuyim lachalok immo nachala:
ohc: Vaymarruhu varobbu vegomer. perush, mittechilla chashvu lehargo, dichtiv (Bereshit 37:20) "lechu venahargehu", o al derech amram zichronam livracha (sefer hayyashar parashat vayyeshev) ki kodem shehishlichuhu labbor keshehifshituhu chavlu bo kamma chavalot vehetzeru lo, ucheneged ze amar vaymarruhu, veachar kach nityaatzu alav lehashelicho labbor ulemachro lenachrim, ucheneged chalukot ellu amar varobbu, perush, hirbu lehatzer.
Vayyistemuhu baale chitztzim. hi eshet potifar vechavroteha hamesubbot bimsibbatah, shebbikshu mimmennu chitztzav, shehu zera hayyore kachetz.

O ulay yechavven kol hakkatuv al perat ze – vaymarruhu hem bechinat hara hamefatte laasot ra, veze haya lo sibba sheyyafozu zeroe yadav, letzad shennichnas begufo hayyetzer hara, uchemaase rav amram chasida (kiddushin 81.), vehinne bechinat hakkelippa yityaches lah shem mara, laze amar "vaymarruhu" kochot hara.

Varobbu – al yede sheravu kochot hara alav vaanasuhu al haavera, veravu al hammonea, "vayyistemuhu baale chitztzim" – hem hakkelippot asher machtiim et haadam lehotzi zera levattala hayyore kachetz. veamar leshon mastema ki kochot hara yachshevu leraa, kemastimim lakkedushsha lehashechit chemda. veaf al pi chen nitgabber kaari velo yara chitztzo, ella "vayyafozzu zeroe yadav".
Veamro mide avir yaakov, perush ki Adonai azaro, al derech amro (Tehillim 37:33) "Adonai lo yaazvennu beyado", venatan lo avirut kenegdam, ki Adonai hu haozer neged hammesit vehammaddiach.

Veamro mishsham roe even yisrael – kan ramaz (Tehillim 118:22) "even maasu habbonim", veyosef beemtzaut tzidko asher shamar berit kodesh zacha beeven harosha. vehu sod (Mishlei 10:25) "tzaddik yesod olam" shennikra roe even yisrael, vehaven, umishshelo natnu lo.

rashi: Vayyar menucha ki tov. raa lechelko eretz mevorechet vetova lehotzi ferot:
Vayyet shichmo lisbol ol tora:
Vayhi. lechol echav yisrael:

Lemas oved. lifsok lahem horaot shel tora vesidre ibburin, shenneemar umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim ladaat ma yaase yisrael rashehem matayim (divrei hayamim 1 12), matayim rashe sanhedraot heemid vechol achehem al pihem:

Vayyet shichmo. hishpil shichmo, kemo vayyet shamayim (Shmuel 2 22), hattu aznechem (Tehillim 78). veunkelos tirgemo befanim acherim, vayyet shichmo lisbol milchamot velichbosh mechozot, shehem yoshvim al hassefar, vayhi haoyev kavush tachtav lemas oved:
Vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut. kol mi shenneemra bo keriva lamut, lo higgia lime avotav (yitzchak chaya 180, veyaakov 147, bedavid neemar keriva, aviv chaya 80 shanim vehu chaya 70):
Vayyikra livno leyosef. lemi shehaya yecholet beyado laasot:
Sim na yadcha. vehishshava:
Chesed veemet. chesed sheosin im hammetim hu chesed shel emet, sheeno metzappe letashlum gemul:
Al na tikbereni bemitzrayim. sofah lihyot afarah kinnim, umerachashin tachat gufi, vesheen mete chutza laaretz chayyim ella betzaar gilgul mechillot, veshello yaasuni mitzrayim avoda zara:
ohc: Vayyikrevu yeme vegomer. kevar katavti besamuch minnayin yada, veramban katav sheyyada meharegashat afisat kochotav. veen devarav zichrono livracha nirim, ki kamma yamim yichye adam achar sheyyatchil lehechalesh.

Od yesh lomar ki hirgish mehaddevarim asher yeeru laadam kodem moto, al derech amram zichronam livracha besefer hazzohar (chelek 1 217:) ki sheloshim yom kodem moto maavirin mimmennu hatztzelem, umaase huva sham sheraa rabbi shimon bar yochay rabbi yitzchak sheavar tzalmo mimmennu. vahagam ki yedia zo meshullelet mibbene adam, hatztzaddikim margishim veyodim kol davar ruchani. od yitbaer hainyan bedikduk od amro vayyikrevu yeme, vechi bayyamim shayyach lomar leshon keriva?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu al pi ma shekkatav ish elohim kadosh, halo hu harav rabbi yitzchak lureya zecher tzaddik vekadosh livracha, umatzata ki tidreshennu besefer kehillat yaakov, veze leshono: veamnam yadata mehitchallekut hanneshamot lechamma nitzotzot, uvechol gilgul vegilgul baim ketzat mehem, uchefi mispar hannitzotzot shel hatztzelem kach mispar yeme chayyav, vehayyamim sheose bahem hammitzvot nitkan nitzotz echad shel hatztzelem hahu keneged hayyom hahu, vehayyom sheen ose bo mitzva nishar pagum nitzotz hahu shel hatztzelem hahu keneged hayyom hahu, vechen al ze hadderech vechulei, ad kan.

Uma meod heira hakedama zo ene maskil bechamma perate hachakirot. haechad heira enenu besod hashshena ki hi laalot nitzotz shekkeneged hayyom hahu, vehu sod amram ki hashshena echad mishshishshim mehammita (berachot 57:), veen yetziat hannitzotz behechlet muchrachat mehanneshama, ella shennifrad mehakkol veodennu nisrach venisbach bannefesh, veze mechesed el shekkol nitzotz shezzacha beyomo hinne hu rachok mehahefsed hagam sheyyarshia adam acharav, venitzotz asher yaale pagum hinne hu yachol lehittakken al yede teshuva, yashuv hannitzotz veyittakken, gam ze mechasde hammitchassed hu elohenu yitalle shemo.

Gam heir lemul enenu teshuvat taromet gam bene adam gam bene ish: ma zot asa lanu elohim? ma nishtannu dorotenu middorot harishonim asher savu chayyim tesha meot shana usheloshim leadam, vechen banav uvene vanav shemone meot usheva meot, vaanachnu hammafli bachayyim lo yaggia lemea shana? veal pi hahakdama hallaz nacha daat kol adam. vehammashal baze lemelech shechalak avanim tovot habbaim mehammachtzav leummanim letakkenam betachlit hayyofi vehahachana, velaasot lahem mishbetzot zahav kederech segullot hammelachim. vegazar omer ki haish hazzariz vehammishtaddel laasot hattikkun bechol hahishtaddelut uvechol hattikkun vehayyofi kaasher tzivva hammelech, vehayu lo haavanim hattovot lo lechelko venachalato lehishtaashea ulehitnaot bahem. venatan haavanim bemispar harebe meod lechol ish vaish, leechad natan shelosh meot elef uleechad shelosh meot vachamishshim elef, hen chaser hen yater. vekava lahem hazzeman asher yaspik lammelacha, yom echad lechol even vaeven, uvimlot hayyamim yishlach hammelech lakachat haavanim hattovot. vayhi ki shalmu yeme hammelacha, pakad hammelech ummanav haosim bimlechet haavanim, vehinne yachad ussefu vehimtziu lifne hammelech pikdono. velo day shello asu vahem melechet hattikkun vehayyofi, ella od lahem kilkelu otam velichlechu otam vehechezirum keshehem mekulkalim. vechaas hammelech al haddavar vehitztzit esh bechol haavadim hahemma, veet benehem hekim tachtam vayyarem et asher paratz baavotam peretz al ze hadderech, vaytzavvem vayazzerem leval asot kemaase avot. vayyimmalech levilti harebot lahem hammelacha vehekel mealehem haddavar, vayyitten lahem sheloshim elef ad arbaim elef, veze haya livchirat hahatava laavadav, ulay yuchelu hachin, gam letzad emtzaut heyot pekuddat hammelech kerova yittenu lev.

Hen henna haddevarim hanneemarim bemelech yisrael elohe olam baruch hu, asher chalak avanim tovot, hem hanneshamot hannikraim avanim yekarot, vehu sod amro (Bereshit 49:24) "mishsham roe even yisrael", shebbeemtzaut hakkelim vehahachana asher hechin beyadenu, hi hattora umitzvotav yitbarach, lehair otam velaasotam battikkun asher yeot asot, al derech amram zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 1 82) ki beemtzaut hitatztzemut haadam baasot tov verichuk hara al pi hattora yaase lenishmato maala elyona veyair orah meor tora veyachin lah kisse, vehu bechinat hammishbetzot asher katavnu bammashal, gam yikne lah keter malchut.

Velarishonim hitchil Adonai leharebot lahem hammelacha, venatan lahem neshamot gedolot shebbechol achat yesh bah chalakim rabbim, vehigbil lechol chelek melachto yom echad. vehu sod (Shemot 16:4) "devar yom beyomo", ki heanaf yikkare yom, venatan lahem yamim rabbim keneged chalakim asher benafshotam. leadam natan yoter mishshelosh meot elef chalakim shehem mispar yamav 930, vechashshiur ze hen chaser hen yater laddorot hahemma. ucheshekkilkelu ufaratz Adonai bahem peretz veet benehem hekim tachtam noach uvanav, mishsham vahala hekel Adonai mittet rov hattorach hahu kede shettihye happekida kerova veyitchalchelu haanashim meet happekida. uchesheraa ki lo yachlu laamod haya mechasser veholech lehakel, vehen hayyom baavonotenu yeme shenotenu bahem shivim shana shehem bekeruv chamishsha veesrim elef yom, verabbim mibbene ammenu lo amdu baavoda kalla kazo.

Gam baze hirvachnu ma sheanu roim, ki kesheyyazkin haadam titmaet havanato, vaafilu ish chacham lo yuchal latzet velavo bemilchamtah shel tora veyitmaatu haregashotav. hagam sheamru zichronam livracha (kaynaym 83 46) zikne tora datam mityashshevet alehem, dikdeku lomar "mityashshevet" lishlol datam shel zikne am haaretz shemmittarefet, uleolam koach hassichli vehattevuni yeafes. ulefi hahakdama heir Adonai ayin bedavar ze, ki letzad shennistalleku kol chelke hannefesh en koach bammuat hannishar laasot keshiur hakkol, gam lo taamid hagguf veyichbad ketzato al ketzato letzad miut hammenik vehazzan shehi hannefesh, veyashuv kedaat katan.

Gam behakedama zo hirvachnu kavvanat maamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 62:2) sheamru: "ma ben mitat zekenim lemitat nearim? mitat zekenim vechulei yafe lanner veyafe lappetila" vechulei ad kan. himshilu mitat hazzaken lanner, ucheshem shehanner holech umitmaet, gam hazzaken kevar halchu lahem chelke hannefesh, vechelek haacharon shennishar bo bitziato yihye nidme lo keadam hayyashen shello yargish bitziat hachelek mimmennu, vehaven.

Gam baze hirvachnu perush ma sheamar hakkatuv (Tehillim 104:29) "tosef rucham yigvaun", sheen kavvanat hakkatuv yedua, gam lo amar "tosef berucham". uchefi hahakdama yair or hakkatuv keor hashshemesh, sheyyitkavven lomar ki kesheyyaggia ketz haadam pekuddat nafsho, yittosfu bo kol chelke hannefesh shennadu vehalchu midde layla velayla, vehu amro "tosef rucham" – perush haruach atzmah shellahem. uchevar amarnu shehagam sheholechet enah neekeret behechlet, ella hare hi kitziat hanneshama ballayla beet shena, shemmeir orah bagguf lematta vehi lemala. veze lecha haot: behair adam et hayyashen, yargish chelek hammitorer veyargish gam chelek asher ala, vehaven.

Gam hirvachnu daat ki otam chelke hanneshama nikraim yamim. uvaze heir mashmaut hakkatuv shebbanu alav sheamar vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut, perush, chelke hanneshama shealu mimmennu devar yom beyomo hen atta karvu, kemaamar hakkatuv (tehillim 104:29) "tosef rucham", vehu amro "lamut". vehirgish yaakov avinu battosefet hammerubba ki bau yeme hashshillum, "vayyikra livno leyosef" vegomer:

Vayyikra livno leyosef vegomer. taam shello kara ella leyosef, yesh taam pashut baddavar, lefi sheyyesh beyado yecholet. ella tzarich ladaat taam amro livno velo hispik lomar leyosef veen lanu yosef acher litot. gam hosif tevat lamed leyosef velo hispik lomar livno yosef.

Nire ki ba hakkatuv latet taam lakkeria, ech yikra hedyot lemelech? vahalo matzinu shekkevod malchut adif mikkevod rabbo, shennistappeku bemassechet kiddushin (33:) bevaya beno vehu rabbo, veamar sham hashshas kesheratza lifshot memrat rabbi yehoshua ben levi sheamar: ani eni keday laamod bifne beni ella mishshum kevod be nesia. uchevar heerachti besugeya zo keyad Adonai hattova alay bechibbur sheni (rishon letziyyon) shechibbarti al yore dea besiman 240 seif 7 yeuyyan sham devaray. veal kol panim middivre hattalmud muchach beferush ki gadol chiyyuv kevod be nesia al aviv, vaafillu lo haya beno atzmo nasi ella chatneh deve nesia. veim ken ech yaase yaakov haddavar lishloach likro lammelech lavo etzlo? velaze amar hakkatuv shene teamim baddavar: haechad heyoto beno, vehashsheni heyoto yosef. uveechad mehenna lo yaspik likroto – im lo haya beno, hagam sheyyihye tzaddik vechaviv vechovev oto, en koach beyaakov laasot kaddavar hazze mishshum kevod melech, veim haya beno velo haya tzaddik gam ken lo haya kore oto. ella letzad heyoto beno, vehu amro livno, gam leheyoto yosef hayyadua betzidkut, hayyadua behafelagat ahavat haav lo vehu leaviv, letaam ze hu sheshshalach likro lo sheyyada sheyyimchol al kevodo. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (kiddushin lev:) melech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul, davka melech yisrael shennimshach umalach al yisrael, aval melech kaze bimtziut ze yachol limchol al kevodo laasot retzon aviv, gam bimtziut sheen aviv yachol haloch elav.

Im na matzati chen. amro na titparesh leshon bakkasha uleshon atta, leshon bakkasha lishlol hammetziut chen sheenah letzad ma shekkadam elav mehachiyyuv mimmennu. uleshon atta nitkavven lirmoz lo ki kevar yada yaakov ki matza chen beene yosef, veze lecha haot (Bereshit 47:12) "vaychalkel yosef et aviv" vegomer, umeatta im haya omer elav yaakov "im matzati chen" ze yaggid ki lo hukkar etzlo davar ze shemmatza chen beenav, laze amar atta perush ma shemmevakkesh mimmennu metziut chen hu al ma sheatta.
O yirtze, letzad shehiggia heerev shimsho, hare ze kala tzorech hachesed haragil ad atta miyyosef elav. laze amar elav: im atta adayin rotze lehatemid behanehagat metziut chen, sim vegomer.

Od bederech remez nitkavven lirmoz lo, lihyot shekkol hachesed sheasa immo ad atta haya dan bo shene tzedadin: haechad, sheose letzad shemmatza yaakov chen beenav lo letachlit sibba, veze yihye mitztzad haahava hannechona umityacheset limtziut chen. vehashsheni, ki asa letzad hachiyyuv shehu mechuyyav lazun aviv kederech kol haaretz, vecherpa hi lo lehattil aviv veechav al hazzulat velirotam chasre lechem umazon. laze amar elav ki haddavar shehu besafek ma hayta kavvanato, yitbarer hassafek bema sheshshoel mimmennu atta. im atta yaase lo cheftzo uretzono, noda haddavar lemafrea ki ma sheasa immo mehattovot hu letzad shemmatza chen beenav beahava uretzon hallev, ki davar sheshshoel mimmennu happaam hazzot eno davar sheyyitztarech laasoto zulat im ahavato nechona ushelema veyachpotz lehetivo, veze hu gilluy al heavar ki "matzati chen beenecha". veim lav, yitbarer haddavar ki taam hachesed haover hu latztzad hashsheni shekkatavnu, uvaze yeduyyak amro matzati leshon avar.

Sim na. titparesh leshon zeman uleshon bakkasha. leshon bakkasha, millevad ma sheamar leshon bakkasha besamuch al hammaase, chazar lomar bakkasha paam sheniyya, ki millevad sheyyaskim al hachesed veyomar lo laasot ken, od mefayyeso lehishshava lo al hachesed lekayyemo. vetitparesh leshon atta, shennitkavven lishlol mimmennu teshuvat "od hayyom" shebbo yaase davar ze, ki lo haya zeman hammavet, kemo shettimtza sheamar achar ze "vayhi achare haddevarim haelle" vegomer. ha lamadta shello haya az beferek hannesia. laze amar elav "sim atta" mibbeli taanat ad et bo devar melech shilton. gam chash yaakov limsirat modaa al haddavar, veyakdim shevua levattel shevua zo veyishshava lo shevua sheen bah semichut daat. uma gam ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (tanchuma) sheamar lo yaakov im lo yishshava lo hare hu met middeaga, uremuza beamro "veshachavti im" vegomer. im ken yosef letzad hechreach haddevarim yishshava achar sheyyakdim shevua lishvuato, laze amar elav sim na perush atta techef umiyyad, umana mimmennu hazzeman shebbo yimsor modaa levattel shevua zo.
Veasita immadi chesed veemet. amar veasita betosefet vav, letzad shekkadam bakkashat maase hashshevua amar "veasita" betosefet vav.

Veamro chesed veemet, razal amru (Bereshit Rabba 96:5) ki chesed heasuy im hammetim karuy chesed shel emet. vekashe li, halo matzinu lo leyaakov sheshshillem lo chesed ze, shenneemar (Bereshit 48:22) "vaani natatti lecha shechem achad" vegomer uferesh Rashi: atta toreach bishvil kevurati vaani natatti vegomer. gam meamro "natatti" leshon avar yaggid ki hodio haddavar bishat maase keshekkibbel alav hattorach, vahagam shello neemar ken, yaakov miha haya bedato lehetivo sechar tarcho velo haya lo lomar "veemet".

Veulay ki nitkavven ki yosef yaase haddavar kederech ze. o efshar ki beerech hammaase lo yukkar happeraon shettinnaten lo shechem echad. o letzad shebbikkesh mimmennu shene devarim: haachat shello yikberennu bemitzrayim veyishtaddel behotzaato meir gillulim, vehav sheyyaale hu veyikberehu beeretz kenaan, veamar chesed shel emet al bechinat haaliyya meeretz mitzrayim, vehu sheamar samuch leamro chesed veemet al na tikbereni bemitzrayim. vehinne meharauy lo lehakedim hashshechiva veachar kach hakkevura, vechan hikdim lehazekir hakkevura kodem amro "veshachavti", ella hare ze mare beetzba ki al perat ze hi hahashbaa, vedavar ze en lo peraon lo atta velo achar zeman. uma shennatan lo shechem echad hu al hattorach sheyyaale immo meeretz mitzrayim leeretz kenaan veyikberehu sham.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: veasita vegomer – perush, ma shekkevar asita immadi yihye shel emet, perush chesed haggamul, ki ma shennoten lo shechem hu lema sheatid laasot litroach bikvurato, lo letagmul haover. uvaze yeduyyak gam ken tevat "veasita" betosefet vav, gam leshon avar, tosefet vav sheyyosif lehetiv immo bema sheyyachshov hachesed shekkevar asa shehu shel emet velo yekabbel hatava mimmennu baado, uvaze tihye hahatava habbaa mushlemet mehammashbia, vehu nishba al daat chavero bishvil tova sheasa lo sheen lo hattara (250 nedarim 65). venitchakkem yaakov leval yattir yosef hashshevua achar moto. vahagam shello matzinu shehizkir yaakov hahatava shel shechem echad az, hakkatuv gilla bemakom acher shehizkirah lo kevar dichtiv "natatti lecha", umin hassetam mekom zichronah hu kesheamar lo "hishshava li" lechazzek hashshevua leval yattir natan lo shechem echad. vezulat ze bamme yismoch dato shel yaakov bishvua zo kevan sheyyachol lehattir achar kach, uchemo sheheerachnu bifrat ze befarashat toldot (Bereshit 26:26) bishvuat yitzchak laavimelech. uma sheamru zichronam livracha (sota lo:) sheamar yosef lefaro "im ani mattir shevuat avi attir gam ken shevuatcha" – en setira mizze, o letzad shellidvarav shel paro heshivo, o gam shevuato lefaro hayta bishvil tova sheasa lo sheen tova kemotah gedulla vechavod veosher.

Al na tikbereni vegomer. perush "al na" leshon zeman, sheafilu lefi shaa lo yikberuhu al semach sheyyishtaddel achar kach lehaaloto, ella techef umiyyad yaalehu, vehu amro besamuch veshachavti vegomer unesatani vegomer. vetaam hakedamat "al na tikbereni bemitzrayim" leamro "veshachavti" perashti befasuk "veasita immadi" vegomer leechad mehadderachim sheyyishshavti hakkatuv. velishar hadderachim yitbaer lefi ma shekkadam lanu (zohar vayyeshev 182) ki yaakov veyosef hayu bechinat nefesh achat, vehu sod vav melea sheyyesh lah shene vavin velo yitpardu, vaasher al ken chash yaakov sheachar sheyyeasef lo yitratztze yosef lehippared mimmennu gam bemoto, uma gam ledivrehem zichronam livracha (taanit 5:) sheamru yaakov avinu lo met vehu bachayyim, laze shalal davar ze middato vehodio ki kesheyyishkav, perush kesheyyippater, hinne hu nifrad behechreach mimmennu veyissamech im avotav, velaze "unesatani" vegomer "ukevartani" vegomer:

rashi: Hammalach haggoel oti. malach haragil lehishtalleach elay betzarati; kainyan shenneemar vayyomer elay malach haelohim bachalom yaakov vegomer anochi hael bet el (Bereshit 31):
Yevarech et hannearim. menashshe veefrayim:
Veyidgu. kaddagim hallalu shepparim veravim veen ayin hara sholetet bahem:
ohc: Hammalach haggoel vegomer. perush, maamar Adonai asher yetzav Adonai et yedidav elav yikkare shem malach, ki kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh (tehillim 29:7). vehu kavvanato beamro "hammalach" vegomer, perush sheyyihye memra da besaadam vivarech otam.

Veyikkare vahem shemi vegomer. perush, sheyyihyu behaderagat shelosha avot, ucheshem sheen adam baolam yachol lenattek o lekalkel beechad mishshelosha avot, veen tzarich lomar bechullan yachad, kemo chen hem.

Od yirtze leshon yekar ugedulla, perush sheyyaggia beemtzautam yekar leshem avot, vehu al derech amro (Mishlei 23:24) "gil yagil avi tzaddik", vechen hu omer (Mishlei 17:6) "ateret zekenim bene vanim", veze yihye beemtzaut hachanatam hahaguna vedarkam hayyashar ad sheyyaggia yekar laavot avotam:

Od yirmoz ki yihye lahem chibbuv hazekarat shemam lifne Adonai kechibbuv hazekarat shem avraham yitzchak veyaakov. uchemo chen timtza sheamar hannavi (Yirmeyahu 31:20) "haven yakkir li efrayim vegomer ki midde dabberi bo" vegomer, hare ki shemo shel efrayim nityakker beene Adonai umazkiro becheshek vechibba yetera:

Veyidgu larov vegomer. hakkavvana al derech ma shepperashti befarashat bereshit befasuk (Bereshit 1:22) "vayvarech otam" vegomer haamur baddagim, ki hutzrach Adonai levarcham letzad shemmekom diratam hu negdiyyi bakkatze haacharon livchinat halleda, laze higdil bahem koach hammolid leholid afillu bammayim, vechan amar yaakov sheyyidgu kaddagim beribbuy halleda veyihye lahem geder ze baaretz, uchefi ze tihye birchatam gedola mibbirkat haddagim leheyotam bammayim, vehaven.

Vedikdek lomar bekerev, remez sheyyihyu nechbaim bifnim, al derech ma sheamar lahem yehoshua (sota lo:) bizman shennitkayyema birkat yaakov bahem: "lechu hachebiu atzmechem bayyearim", ki yehoshua peresh hakkatuv keferushenu. veyesh derasha baze (berachot noah:) shehimshilam ledagim sheen ayin hara sholetet bahem, uchefi ze amro bekerev haaretz perush, hagam sheyyihyu bekerev haaretz, uvaze hem begader elyon mehaddagim.

rashi: Yad leyad. kelomar: miyyad hakkadosh baruch hu leyado tavo lo sechar peullato, vlo yinnake min haraa asher asa (sota 4:):
targum: Demoshit ayda al chavreh la mizdakke min bishta vezara detzadike mitperek:

rashi: Been tachbulot. keshehatztzara baa al yisrael, veenan notnin lev lehavin lehitannot velaasot teshuva, yippal am:
targum: Beatra delet medabbera nafel ama ufurekana yete vesugea demilketanuta:

rashi: Vaydabber al libbam. devarim hammitkabbelim al hallev – ad shello yeradtem lechan hayu merannenim alay sheani eved, al yedechem noda sheani ven chorin, veim ani horeg etchem, ma habberiot omrot? kat shel bachurim raa venishtabbeach bahem veamar achay hem, ulevassof harag otam; yesh lecha ach shehoreg et echav? davar acher, asara nerot lo yachlu lechabbot ner e vechulei:
Ken tzedaka lechayyim. amitto shel tzedaka sofah lechayyim, kemo "ken benot tzelafchad dovrot" (Bamidbar 27:7):
targum: Hechna man deaved tzidketa lechaye netir uderadef bishta netir lemota:

ohc: El bet paro lemor. perush, sheggam seder dibbero alehem yomru el paro, ki hu chilla fenehem beseder ze vayyet baze chinno beene paro. o yomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (yoma 4.) minnayin laomer lachavero davar shehu beval tomar ad sheyyomar lo emor, dichtiv "vaydabber Adonai" vegomer "lemor" (Vayikra 1:1), kemo chen bema shellefanenu haroshem sheyyomru seder haddibbur asher dibber lahem bederech ze levet paro.
Im na matzati. perush, "na" leshon bakkasha uzeman, ki en metziut lehareot leyosef chibba vachaninut ki im baet uvaona hazzot, ki lo haya tzarich lahem leshum davar.
Dabberu na. perush, atta techef umiyyad, ki haya yare leacher kiyyum hashshevua.
Beazne faro lemor. taam amro lemor, nitkavven shehem yomru gam ken meatzmam leratztzot paro al haddavar laasoto.

rashi: Bemot adam rasha tovad tikva. tikvat kol habbotchim bo:
Vetochelet onim avada. tochelet banav, shehem ono, avda, ki bizchuto lo tavo lahem tova. aval bemot tzaddikim yesh livnehem mivtach betzidkatam:
targum: Kad mit gavra rashia yovid sivreh vesibburehon deilen deavdin ata yevad:

rashi: Measher shemena lachmo. maachol habba mechelko shel asher yehe shamen, sheyyihyu zetim merubbim bechelko vehu moshech shemen kemayan; vechen bercho moshe vetovel bashshemen raglo, kemo sheshshaninu vimnachot (daf 85) paam achat hutzrechu anshe ludekiyya leshemen vechulei:
ohc: Measher shemena vegomer. ulay sheyyechavven lomar ki hassaga zo meemtzauto hissig otah, vehu amro "measher" vegomer, perush, mitztziddo o mitztzad zechuto o mitztzad hishtaddeluto.

rashi: Becha yevarech yisrael. habba levarech et banav yevarchem bevirchatam veyomar ish livno yesimcha elohim keefrayim vechimnashshe:
Vayyasem et efrayim. bevirchato lifne menashshe, lehakedimo bidgalim uvachanukkat hannesiim:
ohc: Vayvarchem bayyom hahu lemor vegomer. perush, berech otam kol kach berachot ad geder sheen beracha lemala mimmenna, ad shehakkol omrim becha rauy levarech yisrael.

Veamro vayyasem et efrayim vegomer, perush, beemtzaut dibbur ze kava makom lemala latztzair kodem limnashshe, ki mi hu ze mibbene yisrael asher yeshanne mitteva yaakov avinu veyomar livno "yesimcha elohim kimnashshe ucheefrayim", vehaya maamar ze leot ki efrayim kodem menashshe lechol davar.

rashi: Neesaf el ammi. al shem shemmachnisin hannefashot el mekom genizatan, sheyyesh asifa belashon ivri shehi leshon hachenasa, kegon veen ish meassef oti habbayta (Shoftim 19), vaasafto el toch betecha (Devarim 22), beaspechem et tevuat haaretz (Vayikra 23), hachenasatam labbayit mippene haggeshamim, beaspecha et maasecha (Shemot 23), vechol asifa haamura vemita af hi leshon hachenasa:
El avotay. im avotay:
ohc: Vaytzav otam vegomer. leheyot shemmikkodem kara livno leyosef vehishbio lehittappel bikvurato, shello yachshevu shello chiyyev ella yosef bilvad velo lahem, laze tzivva lechullam yachad ki kullan yitasseku bo. velo hutzrach lehashebiam ki hem yaasu kidvarav, kemo shepperashti bedivre yosef sheamar leyaakov (Bereshit 47:30) "anochi eese chidvarecha".

Vayvarech et yosef. lo rainu beracha leyosef kan. veramban peresh ki birkat habbanim hi birkat yosef vechulei. veen haddaat nocha baze, ki lamma lo yitbarech yosef atzmo bidvarim hannogim elav bifratut. vehannachon beenay ki betevat "vayvarech" rasham hakkatuv ki berech leyosef sheyyihye tamid mevorach.

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem sheamru (Bereshit Rabba 39:11) shemmafteach habberachot haya beyad avraham umesaro leyitzchak, veyitzchak mesaro leyaakov (Bereshit Rabba 61), veyaakov mesaro leyosef, vehu amro vayvarech vegomer, perush, masar beyado mafteach habberachot.

Vayyomer haelohim vegomer. hitchil leorer haahava shel hakkadmonim keseder tefillat shemone esre shemmitpallelin, shemmatchilin bezichron avot, veamar "haelohim asher vegomer avraham veyitzchak", vehizkir gam ken zechuto behatzenea veamar "haelohim haroe oti", vechan ramaz zechuto al ze hadderech, ki hu yaakov haya mithallech lirtzono yitbarach kese lifne roe haroe otah, veachar shessidder zechut avot hitchil lehitpallel "hammalach" vegomer.

rashi: Ba zadon vayyavo kalon veet tzenuim chachma. tavo chachma:
targum: Hech deela zedonta alel tzaara uleilen ditzniin chachmeta:

rashi: Vayyagged. hammaggid leyaakov, velo peresh mi; veharebe mikraot kitzre lashon:

Vayyitchazzek yisrael. amar, af al pi shehu beni, melech hu, echelok lo kavod; mikkan shecholkin kavod lammalchut, vechen moshe chalak kavod lammalchut – veyardu chol avadecha elle elay (Shemot 11); vechen eliyyahu, vayshannes matnav vegomer (Melachim 1 18):

Vaani natatti lecha. lefi sheatta toreach lehitassek bikvurati, vegam ani natatti lecha nachala shettikkaver bah, vee zo? zo shechem, shenneemar, veet atzmot yosef asher heelu mimmitzrayim kavru vishchem (Yehoshua 24):
Shechem achad al achecha. shechem mammash, hi tihye lecha chelek echad yetera al achecha:

Becharbi uvekashti. keshehargu shimon velevi et anshe shechem nitkannesu kol sevivotehem lehizdavveg lahem, vechagar yaakov kele milchama kenegdan; davar acher shechem achad hu habbechora, sheyyittelu vanav shene chalakim, ushechem leshon chelek hu, veharebe yesh lo domim bammikra ki teshitemo shechem (Tehillim 21) – tashit sonay lefanay lachalakim; achalleka shechem (sham 60), derech yeratztzechu shechma (Hoshea 6) – ish chelko; leavdo shechem echad (Tzefanya 3):
Asher lakachti miyyad haemori. miyyad esav, sheasa maase emori. davar acher shehaya tzad aviv beimre fiv:
Becharbi uvekashti. hi chachmato utefillato:
Yissashchar chamor garem. chamor baal atzamot, sovel ol tora, kachamor chazak shemmatinin oto massooy chaved:
Rovetz ben hammishpetayim. kachamor hamehallech bayyom uvallayla, veen lo lina babbayit, ucheshehu rotze lanuach, rovetz ben hattechumin, bitchume haayarot shemmolich sham perakmatya:
ohc: Yissashchar vegomer. amro chamor garem perush, yetziat immo al yede shennaar hachamor (nidda lo.), ze haya sibba sheyyissashochar rovetz ben hammishpetayim veeno meyushshav tamid bimkomo, vehu taam shebbene tora shehem anfe yissashchar yesovvu meir leir, ki hammaase habbilti nachon yolid anafav, vehi lea asta davar shehu lemarit haayin chutz midderech hammusar, gam hayyotze mimmenna yimtzaehu kederech ze, veaf al pi chen chafetzim baamalah shel tora benoam.

Vayyar menucha ki tov. perush menucha haelyona, "ki tov", perush, behabbit uvehitbonen haadam bechol hanaot haolam hazze hannirgashot, kemo shettomar taavat hammaachol vehammishte, en haarevut shel oto davar tzodek mitztzad atzmo ella mitztzad hagguf asher hu keli rekam sheomed lemalleot, shekken hitbia bo hayyotzer shello yuchal lehitakkev rekam kelal. velaze kaasher yihye haadam savea, lo millevad shello yikkach arevut lammaachol hahu asher nichsefa vegam kalta nafsho elav beotah shaa atzmah kodem shemmille kereso, ella shemmoes bo kemoes bara. vezehu sheamar hakkatuv (Mishlei 23:8): "pittecha achalta tekienna" – perush, happat shel haolam hazze im achalta oto, achar kach tekiennu, ki timas mehacheniso letoch picha. gam bedavar asher yachshok bo haadam lemarit haayin veyitav livriyya neima, kaasher yachkor betiv hachakira yire sheoto yofi uneimut eno ella mare hiyyuli, ki behitbonen haadam babbasar uvaor asher mehem banuy kol yofi vetoar baadam, yire veyaskil behitbonen bahem ki en bahem neimut, veyitmaes bivsar adam miggeshet elav, veen hakkol ella dimyon. aval hattov haamitti vehanneimut hatztzodek hu shel olam haelyon. velaze amar vayyar menucha ki tov – perush, haolam shennikra menucha shehi tova, lishlol hattov hannidme baolam hazze kannizkar, veet haaretz ki naema kefi haemet.

Vayyet shichmo lisbol tzaar haolam hazze, vayhi lemas perush shehaya hu atzmo mas oved, perush sheppinna atzmo laavod Adonai, veasa atzmo kemas hannittan, ken natan atzmo lihyot oved avodat hakkodesh haareva vehanneima.

Od yirmoz beamro vayhi lemas oved, shekkol hannivraim yaalu lo mas lefarnasato veyaavduhu leven tora, uchemo shemmatzinu leyissashochar atzmo shehaya zevulun oved oto, vechen bechol dor vador (Bereshit 49:13).

rashi: Baze. hera lo shetar erusin ushetar ketubba, uvikkesh yosef rachamim al haddavar, venacha alav ruach hakkodesh:
Vayyomer kachem na elay vaavarchem. zehu sheamar hakkatuv veanochi tirgalti leefrayim kacham al zerootav (Hoshea 11) – tirgalti ruchi beyaakov bishvil efrayim ad shellekachan al zerootav:
ohc: Asher natan li vegomer. derech hatztzaddikim keshezzochrim hattov asher higgiam cholkim kavod laAdonai, ki hu hannoten, keamro (Bereshit 33:5) "hayeladim asher chanan elohim" vegomer:

Veamro baze – kefi happeshat, ki afillu bime galuto beeretz nachriyya chanano Adonai. gam ramaz lemaamaram zichronam livracha (sota lo:) ki atid haya yosef leholid shenem asar shevatim, veal yede maase eshet potifar nirzevu mibben tzipparne yadav eser tippot velo nisharu ella shetayim, vehu sheramaz beamro baze – "ze" begimatriyya shenem asar, bimkom shenem asar natan lo elohim shenayim. vedikdek lomar elohim sheyyore al hammishpat.

rashi: Lechof yammim. al chof yammim tihye artzo (yevamot 45); chof, ketargumo sefar, 341 belaaz, vehu yihye matzuy tadir al chof oniyyot bimkom hannamel, sheoniyyot meviot sham perakmatya, shehaya zevulun osek bifrakmatya umamtzi mazon leshevet yissashchar, vehem oskim battora. hu sheamar moshe semach zevulun betzetecha veyissashochar beohalecha (Devarim 33), zevulun yotze bifrakmatya, veyissashochar osek battora beohalim:
Veyarchato al tzidon. sof gevulo yehe samuch letzidon: yrekatev. sofo, kemo uleyarkete hammishkan:
Vatteshev beetan kashto. nityashsheva bechozek:
Kashto. chazko:

Vayyafozzu zeroe yadav. zo hi netinat tabbaat al yado, leshon zahav mufaz, zot hayta lo mide hakkabba shehu avir yaakov, umishsham ala lihyot roe even yisrael – ikkaran shel yisrael, leshon haeven harosha, leshon malchut; veunkelos af hu chach tirgemo vatteshev – vetavat behon neviute, hachalomot asher chalam lahem – al dekayyem orayta besitra, tosefet hu, velo millashon ivri shebbammikra, – veshavvi tukefa rochatzane targum shel beetan kashto, vechach leshon hattargum al haivri: vatteshev nevuato bishvil sheetano shel hakkabba hayta lo lekeshet ulemivtach, bechen yitrema dehav al deraohi – lechach vayyafozzu zeroe yadav, leshon paz:
Even yisrael. leshon notarikon av uven, avahan uvenin – yaakov uvanav. verabbotenu darshu vatteshev beetan kashto al kevishat yitzro beeshet adonav, vekoro keshet, al shem shehazzera yore kachetz:
Vayyafozzu zeroe yadav. kemo vayyafotzu, sheyyatza hazzera mibben etzbeot yadav:
Mide avir yaakov. shenirata lo demut deyokno shel aviv vechulei, kidita besota (daf 36, 2):
Veaggida lachem. bikkesh legallot et hakketz venistalleka mimmennu shechina vehitchil omer devarim acherim:

Vaytzauu el yosef. kemo vaytzavvem el bene yisrael – tzivva lemoshe uleaharon lihyot sheluchim el bene yisrael, af ze vaytzauu el shelucham, lihyot shaliach el yosef lomar lo chen. veet mi tziuu? et bene vilha, shehayu regilin etzlo, shenneemar vehu naar et bene vilha:
Avicha tzivva. shinnu vaddavar mippene hashshalom, ki lo tzivva yaakov ken, shello necheshad yosef beenav (Bereshit Rabba, yevamot 65):
ohc: Vaytzauu el yosef vegomer. tzarich ladaat taam amro lemor, veim hakkavvana lemor leyosef, haya lo lomar "lemor el yosef". veulay shennitkavvenu shello yomar lo haomer ki haachim shelachuhu al haddavar, ella yomar shehu shama meaviv metzavve lehaachim lomar elav haddevarim haamurim. veze hu amro paam sheniyya lemor, vehaven:

rashi: Tarum karet. titkayyem tikrat habbayit begavhah millippol. beod shehayu malche yehuda yesharim, heemida tefillatam et bet hammikdash:
targum: Bevirkathon detzadike titromam medinta uvefumehon derashie titakar:

rashi: Ra yeroa. harasha yitrotzetz, asher arav libbo laavodat gillulim:
Vesone tokim. tokim kaf laasot ra velalechet baatzatam, verabbotenu derashuhu (yevamot kat:) bearvut mamon:
targum: Bisha mavesh betzadika metul dehu arav chilonay vesane leilen desaymin sivrehon belaha:

rashi: Al birke yosef. ketargumo giddelan ben birkav:
Tikvat reshaim evra. betuchim umekavvim legehinnom:
targum: Rigta detzadike betavta vesibbura derashie verugeza:

rashi: Ben porat. ben chen, vehu leshon arammi, appiryan namteye lerabbi shimon, besof bava metzia (daf 119):
Ben porat ale ayin. chinno natuy al haayin haroa oto:
Benat tzaada ale shor. benot mitzrayim hayu tzoadot (al hachoma) lehistakkel beyafyo, banot harebe, tzaada kol achat veachat, bemakom shettuchal liroto mishsham:
Ale shor. al reiyyato, kemo ashurennu velo karov (Bamidbar 24), umia yesh rabbim, veze note leyishshuv hammikra. porat tav shebbo hu tikkun hallashon, kemo al divrat bene haadam (Kohelet 3):
Shor. kemo lashur:

Ale shor. bishvil lashur, vetargum shel unkelos, banot tzaada ale shur teren shivtin yippekun mibbenohi vechulei vechatav banot al shem benot menashshe, benot tzelafchad, shennatlu chelek bishne evre hayyarden, beri deyisge yosef, porat leshon pirya ureviyya; veyesh mia bo hammityashshevim al hallashon, beshaa shebba esav likrat yaakov, bechullan kadmu haimmahot lalechet lifne benehem lehishtachavot, uverachel ketiv niggash yosef verachel vayyishtachavu, amar yosef rasha hazze eno rama, shemma yitten enav beimmi, yatza lefaneha veshirbev komato lechassotah, vehu shebbercho aviv ben porat – higdalta atzmecha yosef ale ayin shel esav, lefichach zachita ligdulla:

Banot tzaada ale shor. lehistakkel becha betzetcha al mitzrayim, veod derashuhu leinyan shello yishlot bezaro ayin hara; veaf keshebberech menashshe veefrayim bercham kaddagim, sheen ayin hara sholetet bahem:
ohc: Ben porat yosef. taam hakkefel hu lomar ki lishne tzedadin rauy hu lifrot: haechad letzad ma shehu yosef, keamram zichronam livracha (sota lo:) rauy haya yosef lehaamid shenem asar shevatim, vehashsheni "ben porat ale ayin" al asher lo zana achare enav.

Veamro banot tzaada yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma) sheeshet potifar kara kol neshe hassarim vehaggedolim vehichnisa yosef lesharet lifnehem, vekibbutzam vehekkefam haya keetzada zo, ale shur kede lehabbit bo. af al pi chen ruach hakkodesh meida alav shello hibbit aven, ucheshem shehu lo histakkel bahem kemo chen lo tishlot ayin hara bo.

rashi: Dan yadin ammo. yinkom nikmat ammo mippelishtim kemo ki yadin Adonai ammo (Devarim 32):

Keachad shivte yisrael. kol yisrael yihyu keechad immo, veet kullam yadin, veal shimshon nibba nevua zo; veod yesh lefaresh keachad shivte yisrael, kamyuchad shebbashshevatim, hu david, shebba mihuda:
ohc: Dan yadin vegomer. ulay ki letzad sheamar shimshon (Shoftim 16:30) "tamot nafshi im pelishtim", laze amar yaakov ki yeshno begeder im shofte yisrael hameyuchadim lemala been hefresh, velo yigra mitztzaddik eno. vehu amro keachad shivte yisrael, perush, keechad hameyuchad shebbechol shevet vashevet miyyisrael, ki chol hashshevatim hayu vahem shoftim leyisrael:

rashi: Gur arye. al david nitnabbe – battechilla gur bihyot shaul melech alenu atta hayita hammotzi vehammevi et yisrael (Shmuel 2 Adonai) – ulevassof arye, keshehimlichuhu alehem, vezehu shettirgem unkelos shilton yehe besheruya – bitchillato:
Mitteref. mimma shechashadticha betarof toraf yosef chayya raa achalathu – vezehu yehuda shennimshal learye –
Beni alita. sillakta et atzmecha veamarta ma betza vegomer, vechen baharigat tamar shehoda, tzadka mimmenni, lefichach kara ravatz vegomer, bime shelomo ish tachat gafno vegomer (Melachim 1 Adonai):
ohc: Gur arye vegomer. razal (zohar chelek 1 237:) amru mittechilla gur veachar kach arye, vetzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lehazekir zeman heyoto gur. od tzarich ladaat amro mitteref beni alita. verazal amru sheal amro tarof toraf hu omer lo "beni alita", perush sillakta atzmecha, uledivrehem zichrono livracha titparesh tevat "beni" lemala ulematta al ze hadderech: mitteref beni, perush, yosef, alita, gam al ze hadderech: mitteref shel yosef beni, perush, atta beni alita, veamar tevat "beni" leshon chibba vekeruv hallev. ella shetztzarich arev sheyyaakov chashado lihuda lomar atta alav sheala mehachashad, vehaddaat notenet ki meolam lo ala al daat yaakov sheachim yishlechu yad beyosef lachshod echad mehem, ella sheddivre razal hem divre kabbala. od tzarich ladaat amro kara ravatz vegomer mi yekimennu, ki millevad sheen mashmaut lefashtiyyut haddevarim, lamma dibber leshon nistar veshinna misseder shehitchil ledabber bo bederech nocheach, keamro "atta yoducha vegomer beni alita":

Achen yitbaaru hakketuvim al pi hakedama achat zakka uvara asher heira enenu bidvarim nechmadim meor toratenu, vehu ki adam harishon hu ilan shebbo hayu teluyim kol hanneshamot shel hakkedushsha sheyyatzu laolam miyyom heyot olam vaasher atidin latzet, ucheshechata adam shalat chelek hara vayyishb mimmennu shevi leen mispar, vedarshu meal sefer anshe emet me atzmu hashshevuyim mehakkedushsha bakkelippa, vehen am Adonai mishtaddelim miyyom heyotam levarer ulehotzi balo mippiv, veholchim umevarrim umotziim miyyado beemtzaut mekor hakkedushsha asher nata Adonai betochenu hi hattora vehammitzvot. gam lifamim beemtzaut devekut hannefesh hakkedosha benefesh hattuma leonsah totzi nefesh chayya leminah, vehu sod (Bereshit 33:3) "vattidbak nafsho bedina bat yaakov", sheshshaava nefesh dina hakkedushsha lenefesh kedosha minna shehayta netuna toch shechem, veamru zichronam livracha (Kohelet yaakov) ki hu nefesh rabbi chanina ben teradyon. vehu remez rachavat yadayim.

Velifamim tetze hannefesh meatzmah laolam letzad hasheratzat nafshot hakkelippa baolam tetze gam hi, uvetzetah tihye muvdelet meotzar hakkelippa tivah, uteavve lalechet bederech hattov, vehu sod nishmat haggerim hammitgayyerim meatzmam vechoshkim lehistofef betzel hakkedushsha. uvichlal davar ze gam ken beemtzaut davar megunne beyoter yivchar hashshabbay shehu adam beliyyaal lehotzi nefesh hakkedosha sheshshevuya beyado bimkom kelippa shehi bechinat heavon sheyyihye yoter megunne. veze lecha haot: rut hammoaviyya yatzta mizzenut av uvitto, venaama haammonit. vetavchin ladaat ki rut sheyyatzta mimmenna shalshelet malchut bet david hayta mimmoav, shehi baalat avera bachatzifut yoter umaaseha mochichot aleha, keamram zichronam livracha (bava kamma lach:), venaama yatzta meammon, shello haya heavon mezoham kaachotah. veyesh lecha ladaat ki im haya ose maase lot adam acher lo hayu yotzim beemtzauto shete peridot hattovot, ella letzad lot shehaya gadol bivchinato ki gam bechinat hara yesh bah haderagot gedolot zo lemala mizzo kefi bechinatah. vetze ulemad mehaummot shehem anfe hakkelippa sheyyesh bahem melachim gedolim umelachim ketanne haerech vesarim vegomer. vehu sod amram zichronam livracha (sota mat:) beikkevot meshicha, kavvanatam baze ki letzad sheanu mevarrim kol tefisat hakkelippa mehakkedushsha, kesheyyaggia habberur lesof davar shehu heakev, vechinnu hattachlit laakevayim ki hu sof evre haadam, velaze timtza ki bazzemannim harishonim hayu mitbarrim mehakkelippa nefashot gedolot, vetze ulemad haadam haggadol baanakim avinu vaateret roshenu hu avraham ger tzedek rishon shebbaggerim vesara immenu verut hammoaviyya, uvedorot acharonim shemaya veavtalyon uneklos hagger. vehen hayyom hagam shemmitgayyerim, lihyot shessafu tammu nitzotze hakkedushsha mittoch hakkelippa velo nisharu ki im baakevot, gam koach hamevarer babbechina atzmah ketanna, vehu sod amram zichronam livracha bazzohar (chelek 1 258.) denagu raglin beraglin, ki chol bechina tevarer bechinatah.

Veal pi hakedama zo taskil atzat Adonai asher yaatz al yehuda, veshalach malach vehichricho lavo el hakkedesha (Bereshit Rabba perek 84), ki beemtzaut heyot haddavar bilti hagun al pi hattora lishkav et kallato, uveemtzaut heyot yehuda anus al pi haddibbur, nelam devar issur mimmennu velo yada ki challato hi. uvaze hotzi mimmekor hattuma anaf mufla shebbakkedushsha – peretz vazerach, shehayu shevuyim bivchinat hara vehaya adam beliyyaal rovetz alehem letzad godel maalatam. vetze ulemad kamma tzaddikim yatzu mehem veshalshelet hammelucha shel bet david. vezulat yehuda shehu bechinat hammelucha lo haya adam yachol lehotziam miyyado. gam zulat dimyon maase hara ki yavo el kallato en metziut lehotziam, uveemtzaut dimyon hara hare ze nichnas limdor hara vehotzi shalal rav.

Vehen henna haddevarim sheamar hakkatuv gur arye yehuda, perush, mittechilla kodem maase tamar hu gur, veze hu sheramaz bitchillat devarav beamro "atta yoducha achecha", millevad ma shepperashti bimkomo. kefi ze yitbaer od al ze hadderech atta yoducha, perush, lo haya lecha ella gedullat atzmecha sheyyihyu achecha kefufim lecha, aval lo hayta midda zo noheget ledorot. vetze ulemad ma gedulla hayta levanav levad peretz vezerach shebbau mimmaase hareshet asher paras elohim, ulevassof arye shennitgabber venitalla. uferesh minnayin zacha laalot maala zo, veamar mitteref beni alita, perush, meoto teref adam shettaraf bechinat hara meadam harishon neshamot hammuflaot, uveemtzaut maase tamar hirvachta otam, mizze hayta aliyyatcha vekanita banim shemmalchutam malchut olamim, shezzulat ze lo haya beanfe nishmatcha gedulla ledorot ella lecha levaddecha.

Veamro kara ravatz vegomer, perush, ki oto hatteref shemmimmennu hayta aliyyato, kara ravatz alav oto shenneemar bo (Bereshit 4:7) "lappetach chattat rovetz", velo haya lo metziut lahakimo mealav ulehotzio mimmennu haeven yekara.

Veramaz beamro arye velavi, ki bechina shettakfa bannefesh, halo hi bechinat ari, velaze tzarich bechinat ari shebbakkedushsha shehu yehuda lahakimo ulehotziah mittachat yado. umeatta lo yasur shevet mihuda leolam, malchuto malchut kol olamim, ki kana yesod hammelucha ad ki yavo shilo sheelav anu mekavvim yom yom, tzippinu lishua.

Veene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma ketiv hodaa zo bemakom ze, uma kesher veshayyachut ledavar ze im hassamuch lo "vayyishshak lahem vaychabbek lahem". od tzarich ladaat amro lahem, shehaya lo lomar "vayyishshak otam". veulay sheshshene dikdukim ellu kol achat metaretzet chavertah, ki letzad shekkavdu enav mizzoken haya mechabbek shello bimkom hachibbuk umenashshek shello bimkom hannishshuk, velaze amar "lahem" velo amar "otam", vehaven:

rashi: Lachanot et aviv. inyan mirkachat besamim hu:
ohc: Vayyachantu harofim. asa chen yosef mishshum kevod aviv, ki ken mishpat hannichbadim umikkol shekken gedole hammalchut. o kede shello yitu bo keshello yachantuhu shello met o shemmet velo hisriach veyaasuhu eloah, ki hu pele baammim hammezohamim, vesovev levilti yaalehu leeretz kevurato. veim lo hayu teamim hannizkarim, haddavar pashut ki belo chanita lo haya masriach, vetze ulemad mimmaase rabbi elazar berabbi shimon bar yochay kaamur bashshas (bava metzia 84:).

O efshar lomar ki letzad sheyyisrael sheamdu al har sinay paska zohamatan (shabbat kamu.), velaze tzaddike yisrael meaz vahala lo hayu masrichin achar motam, vaafillu ippush hannishar babbeten yavesh veyihye leafar, ki zohamat hagguf hi hammasrachat ochel shebbammeayim, ma sheen ken kodem lachen. vahagam shennomar sheggufo shel yaakov lo yasriach ki lo met, aval al kol panim ippush hammaachol asher yishshaer beguf haadam kanus ki yirbu lo hayyamim yitappesh veyasriach, velaze chash yosef vetzivva lachanot.
O efshar ki yosef lo yada missod ze vetzivva lachanot.

rashi: Asher kariti li. kifshuto kemo ki yichre ish. umidrasho od mityashshev al hallashon, kemo asher kaniti, araa keshehalachti lichrakke hayyam hayu korin limchira kira, veod midrasho leshon keri dagur, shennatal yaakov kol kesef vezahav shehevi mibbet lavan veasa oto keri veamar leesav tol ze bishvil chelkecha bammeara:
ohc: Hishbiani lemor. rabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (sota lo:) veim tomar nattir shevua – gam shevuatcha hi behattara. uchefi happeshat, amro lemor ki lo hayta hashshevua bilshon atzmo haamur bedivre yosef lahem, ella kavvanat hashshevua, laze amar tevat "lemor" lomar shekkavvanat ma sheamar bishvua hi vegomer:

Uvederech derash efshar shennitkavven lishlol taanat paro ki yomar elav lamma lo nimlach immo kodem hashshevua veasa davar chutz mehamelachat hammelech, laze amar lo ki lo haya lo zeman lehimmalech ki amirat hashshevua hayta samuch lemitat aviv, vehu amro hishbiani lemor hinne anochi met, perush beshaa shehishbiani lo natan li zeman ella amar li "hinne anochi" vegomer, vechen haya kemo shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 47:29) "sim na yadcha" vegomer shello natan lo zeman aroch, veemet yehge chikko shel yosef.

targum: Mesachta denichla merachakteh delaha uvematkela teritza tzivyoneh:
Vaamarat bat sheva tav ana amalel alach kodam malka:
Vaamarat tityehav yat avishag demin shunem laadoniyahu achuch leittu:
Ana azel beorach kol ara vetitkef utehe ligvar dachel chetin:
Veyomaya di melach david al yisrael arbein shenin bechevron melach sheva shenin uvirushalem melach telatin utelat shenin:
Achel kurtza gale raza vedimheman berucheh mechase milta:
Vaata adoniyahu var chagit levat bat sheva imeh dishlomo vaamaratt hashelem metach vaamar shelam:
Tzidkathon ditmime tetaretz orchateh uverisheh nafel rashia:
Vaamar imri chean lishlomo malka are la yetiv yat appayich vihav li yat avishag demin shunem leittu:
Ushechiv david im avahatohi veitkevar bekarta dedavid:

Bedil di yekayem Adonai yat pitgamohi di malel alay lememar im yitrun benach yat archehon limhach kodamay bikshot bechol libbehon uvechol nafshehon lememar la yippesok lach gevar meal kurese malchuta deyisrael:
Ushelomo yatev al kurese malchuta dedavid avuhi veitkinat malchuteh lachada:
Vetabed kechuchematach vela tachet sivateh bishlama lishol:
Ukerivu yome david limmat ufaked yat shelomo bereh lememar:
Uchean la tezakkineh are gevar chakkim at vetida yat detabed leh vetachet yat sevateh biktala lishol:
Velivne varzilay giladaa tabed tivu vihon beochle fatorach are inun safiku tzarchay bemeerki min kodam avshalom achuch:
Vaamarat sheala chada zeera ana shaala minach la tetiv yat appay vaamar lah malka sheili imi are la ativ yat appayich:
Vaatat bat sheva lokodam malka shelomo lemalala imeh al adoniyahu vekam malka lokodamutah usegid lah vitev al kureseh veshavi kuresa leima demalka vitevat leyamineh:

Veha imach shimi var gera bar mishevet binyamin meulemat vehu levatani levatan meriran beyoma daazalit lemachanayim vehu nechat lokodamuti leyardena vekaymit leh bememra dayya lememar dela ektelinach becharba:
Uleevyatar kahana amar malka laanatot ezil lach lekirvach are gevar chayav ketol at ubbeyoma haden la ektelinach are netalt yat arona dayya elohim kodam david abba vaare itaneta bechol di itane abba:

Veaf at yedat yat daavad li yoav bar tzeruya daavad litren rabbane chelvata deyisrael leavner bar ner velaamasa var yeter dekatlinun bearmuteh udeme di yitchashev leh demehon alohi kedam tevire kerava vitev lehon bichmanat shelama vaashad dimhon beaspenike di vechartzeh vedash betalarita di veriglohi:
Vaatev malka shelomo vaamar leimeh ulema at shaala yat avishag demin shunem laadoniyahu veshaali leh yat malchuta are hu achi kashish mini hala veetza havo hu veevyatar kahana veyoav bar tzeruya:
Uchean kayam hu Adonai deatkenani veotivani al kurese malchuta dedavid abba udekayem li malchu kema demalel are yoma den yitketel adoniyahu:
Merachek elaha laakime libba vetzave beilen ditmimin:
Vaamar pitgam it li lemalala imach vaamarat malel:
Betavathon detzadike tedutz kiryathon ubbeyuvedana derashie chedvata:
La mahane shikra veyoma derugeza vetzidketa mefalta min mota visha:
Uchean sheala chada ana shael minich la tetivin yat appay vaamarat leh malel:
Ushelach malka shelomo beyad benayahu bar yehoyada veshalit beh vekatleh:

Vetitar yat matrat memra dayya elahach limhach beorchan detaknan kodamohi lemitar keyamohi pikudohi vedinohi vesahaduteh kema dichtiv beorayta demoshe bedil detatzlach yat kol detaved veyat kol atar detitpene letaman:
Vaamar at yedaat are dili havat malchuta vaalay shaviu chol yisrael appehon lemeheve malka veistecharat malchuta vahavat laachi are min kodam Adonai havat leh:
Vekayem malka shelomo vememra dayya lememar keden yabed li elohim ucheden yosif are venafsheh malel adoniyahu yat pitgama haden:

bart: Achilato vaachilat chavero. achal hu chatzi shiur veheechil et chavero chatzi shiur, o nehena hu chatzi shiur vehehena et chavero chatzi shiur, vechen hanaato vaachilat chavero, kegon sach hu chatzi shiur vachavero achal chatzi shiur, o ippecha, kol ellu mitztarfim lechayyevo asham meilot:

Vaafillu lizman merubbe. kegon sheachal chatzi shiur hayyom vachatzi shiur lemachar behelem echad, o sheachal o nehena chachatzi shiur hayyom veheechil o hehena et chavero chachatzi shiur lemachar, mitztarfim vaafillu lizman merubbe, uvilvad sheyyihyu vehelem echad, dichtiv (Vayikra 5) ki timol maal, mikkol makom shettimol nitchayyev beasham:
Haish megalleach al nezirut aviv veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha. vaafillu hi bat yoreshet. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala:

Amar rabbi yose hare ellu yippelu lindava vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi yose. ella ben shemmet aviv veamar hareni nazir al menat sheagallach al meot abba, ben shehayu hu veaviv nezirim umet aviv, megalleach al nezirut aviv. veim hayu banim rabbim vekadam echad mehen vegillach al nezirut aviv, zacha:
Shenehem lo maalu. baal habbayit lo maal shehare lo naaset shelichuto vifruta, vehashshaliach lo maal shello akar shelichuto shel baal habbayit bifruta, uvefachot mipperuta lekka chiyyuv meila:
Hashshaliach maal. sheikkar shelichuto shel baal habbayit ben biftilot ben benerot, veyesh bishnehen peruta:
Shelosha minin asurin bannazir. hattuma. dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) al kol nafshot met lo yavo:
Hattiglachat. dichtiv (sham) taar lo yaavor al rosho:
Vehayyotze min haggefen. dichtiv (sham) vaanavim lachim viveshim lo yochal:
Kol hayyotze min haggefen. kegon anavim lachim viveshim chartzannim vezaggim, mitztarfin lechazzayit lilkot alehen:

Veeno chayyav ad sheyyochal min haanavim kazzayit. vehu haddin leshiur shetiyya bechazzayit. dechevan dichtiv vaanavim lachim viveshim lo yochal, gamrinan minna ma achila bechazzayit af shetiyya bechazzayit:

Mishna rishona ad sheyyishte reviit yayin. aval mishna rishona ippecha shaminan la, degamrinan achila mishshetiyya, veshiur shetiyya bannazir reviit, degamrinan shechar shechar mimmikdash, uma shiur issur shetiyya birviit, af shiur issur achila birviit:

Afillu shara fitto veyayin veyesh bah kede letzaref kazzayit chayyav. disvira leh lerabbi akiva shiur issure nazir ben baachila ben bishtiyya bechazzayit, vehetter mitztaref leissur lehashelim lichshiur. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Dinar zahav. resha ashmoinan bemide dekadosh kedushshat hagguf, vehacha ashmoinan bemide dekadosh kedushshat damim:
Hammenachot moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. bikdushshat pe:
Veen moalin bashsheyarim. sheyyesh bahen hetter lakkohanim:
Aval moalin bakkometz. ad sheyyissaref kullo veyetze levet haddeshen kedin emure chattat veasham. uleachar ken en moalin bo, deha naaset mitzvato:
Hirtia laachorav. ze shebba kenegdan chazar laachorav velo noda mi hu:
Eno nazir. en echad mehem nazir, delo machet eynash nafsheh assefeka, vedato haya vishat hanneder sheim lo yavo haddavar lide berur shello yihye bidvarav kelum:

Rabbi shimon omer kulei. rabbi shimon letameh deamar sefek nezirut lehachemir. uma takkanatan, shehare i efshar lehavi karban missafek, ella tzerichim lehatenot kol echad velomar im eno chidvarav sheyyehe nezir nedava. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Chamishsha devarim baola mitztarfim ze im ze. lechazzayit, lechayyev mishshum maale vachutz, ulechayyev mishshum piggul venotar vetame, umishshum meila im nehena mikkullan beshave feruta:
Hassolet. hammincha habbaa im haola:
Vehayyayin. lannesachim. shehaola teuna mincha unesachim:

Veshishsha battoda. shehattoda teuna lechem musaf al chamishsha devarim shebbaola. vechullan mitztarfin lechazzayit, lefiggul venotar vetame, aval lo limila, shehattoda kadashim kallim veen bahen meila, keditnan beshilhe ferek kamma:
Hatteruma uterumat maaser. shehi echad mimmea shel chullin. vechen terumat maaser shel demay:
Vehachalla. sheaf hi keruya teruma, dichtiv (Bamidbar 15) reshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma:
Vehabbikkurim. keruyin teruma, deamar mar uterumat yadcha ellu vikkurim, dichtiv behu (Devarim 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha:
Mitztarfim ze im ze leesor. sheim nafal mikkullan seor kede lechammetz betoch issa shel chullin, neeseret:
Ulechayyev alehen et hachomesh. haochel mikkullan kazzayit bishgaga meshallem et hachomesh:
Luf shel erev sheviit. shennishlam meerev sheviit velo hosif tzemachim bashsheviit, sheim hosif tzemachim bashsheviit asur leakro mishshum hefsed peri:
Hakketzonim. yesh mefarshim shennizreu bakkayitz, veyesh mefarshim meyuchadot lakkayitz shehen yeveshot meod:
Pua shel iddit. haggedela besade shemena. pua, tzeva adom shekkorin 227 belaaz:
Bemaarufot shel etz. bemara shechofrim bo et hakkarka. shel etz velo shel barzel, shello yerae keoved et haaretz:
Bekardummot shel mattechet. velo chayshinan dilma mechaze kaavoda:

Befua shel tzelaot. kemo selaot besamech, pua haggedela ben hasselaim, kevan deen derech lizroa sham lo mechaze keoved et haaretz. perush acher tzelaot kemo uletzela hammishkan (Shemot 26), kelomar tzidde hassade sheen derech lizroa sham:

Nizrak aleha echad min haddamim eno yachol lehafer. dilachar shennizrak haddam hi yechola lishtot yayin velittame lemetim, veen kan yoter neder shel innuy nefesh: rabbi akiva omer afillu nishchata aleha achat mikkol habbehemot eno yachol lehafer. mishshum hefsed kadashim:
Tiglachat tuma yafer. shetztzerichim lachzor velimnot nezirut tohora, veyachol lomar i efshi beishsha menuvvelet, kelomar meunna umenua mishshetiyyat yayin:

Af betiglachat hattohora yafer. kede shello titztarech lehitnnavvel begilluach, degilluach beishsha niuul hu. vetanna kamma savar en haggilluach niuul, shehare yechola laasot pea nachrit. veen halacha lo cherabbi akiva velo cherabbi:
Beyad cheresh shote vekatan. sheenan bene shelichut. afillu hachi hoil venaaset shelichuto hameshalleach maal:
Hachenvani. shekkibbel hammaot miyyad cheresh shote vekatan, chayyav kesheyyotzi hammaot shel hekdesh bachafatzav:
Venizkar. baal habbayit kodem shehiggiu hammaot leyad chenvani, vechevan shennizkar shuv eno chayyav karban meila, sheen karban meila etzel mezid:

Hachenvani chayyav. vehu shennizkeru vaal habbayit vehashshaliach, dehashta en kan shogeg ella chenvani. aval im nizkar baal habbayit velo nizkar hashshaliach, hashshaliach maal shehu shagag techilla:
Ketzad yaase. kelomar im yada hachenvani vifruta zo shehi kodesh kodem sheyyotzienna venitarva chevar im shear perutot sheyyesh lo, ketzad yaase veyihye muttar lehishtammesh bifrutotav:
Uminchat nesachim. mincha habbaa im hazzevach sheen bah sheyarim. vechol hane chalil ninhu:
Mishshehukdeshu. kedushshat pe vealma:
Ufiggul en bahen. lefi sheen lahem mattirin, veen piggul noheg ella vedavar shekkarvu mattirav kedilkamman:

Kol sheyyesh lo mattirin. kegon shelamim vechattaot vaashamot, dedaman mattir emurim lammizbeach vehabbasar lakkohanim, o davar sheyyesh lo mattirin lammizbeach bilvad, kegon olat haof ufarim hannisrafim, sheddaman mattiran lammizbeach bilvad, uchegon shete hallechem dedaman shel kevasim havu mattirehen, velechem happanim divzichim havu mattirehen, uchegon menachot deyesh lahen hetter bekometz, kol hane en chayyavim alehem mishshum piggul venotar vetame ad sheyyikrevu mattirehen. dehachi chetiv gabbe figgul, lo yeratze, veamrinan keharetzaat kasher kach haretzaat pasul. venotar vetame yalef mippiggul bemassechet zevachim beferek kol hazzevachim:
Vechol davar sheen lo mattirin. ki hane hakkometz vehallevona dehen atzman mattirin hen veen mattir otam shum davar acher:

Chayyav aleha mishshum notar vetame. mishshum tame merabbinan lehu, middichtiv (Vayikra 22) kol ish asher yikrav mikkol zarachem el hakkodashim asher yakdishu vene yisrael laAdonai‏ vetumato alav venichreta, bechol hakkodashim hakkatuv medabber, lechayyev aleha mishshum tame. venotar yalef mittame:

Ad sheyyochal shene chartzannim vezaggin. dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) mechartzannim vead zag, umiut chartzannim shenayim, veyesh lahem zag echad. veen halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya, ella haochel min hachartzan vehazzag eno loke ad sheyyochal mehen kazzayit:
Rabbi yose omer shello tite. rabbi yose haya noten siman shello tite:
Zog shel behema. shehachitzon karuy zog:
Kol harauy lammizbeach. sheggufan rauy kaamar:
Bor male mayim. gufan rauy levedek habbayit levinyan, veen gufan rauy lammizbeach. sheen reuyin lenissuch hammayim ella mayim chayyim, velo hayu menassechim mayim bammikdash ella mimme hashshilloach:
Ashpa melea zevel. en gufah rauy lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit ella ledamim:
Shovach male yonim. rauy lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit:
Ilan male ferot. rauy lammikdash levikkurim velo levedek habbayit:
Sade melea asavim. enah reuya lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit:
Veen moalin bema shebbetochan. deen moalim bema shehishbiach leachar shehukdash:

Velad meusseret. im yatza nekeva asirit tachat hashshevet, vehaya lah ben kodem lachen, lo yinak shuv mimmenna, shebbenah chullin hu vehi maaser, venimtza nehene mechalev mukdashim, shemmasar behema kodesh hu:

Vaacherim mitnaddevim ken. kelomar, zo sheheevirah tachat hashshevet setam, lo yinak mimmenna, aval acherim shehitnaddevu kodem lachen, rashshaim lehatenot kodem shettitasser sheim tetze nekeva baasiri yehe chalavah chullin kede sheyyinak benah mimmenna vehetter, vechen nammi vivlad mukdashim lo hayu makdishim chalev imman. kach pershu rabbotay umegumgam hu. verambam peresh, vaacherim mitnaddevim, shemmi shellibbo nodvo haya mitnaddev chalav lehanik ben hameusseret uven hammukdashim, lefi sheasur labben linok mehen, deshavveyu rabbanan kegiza vaavoda daasurim bakkodashim, hilkach en lahen takkana ella sheacherim yitnaddevu chalav lahanikan, kevan shenneesru linok mechalev imman. veyashar hu:

Lo yochlu miggerogarot shel hekdesh. vaafillu hitnu sheyyaasu melacha vimzonotehen en ochlim miggerogarot shel hekdesh, ella haggizbar noten lahem deme mezonot mishshel hekdesh vehem konim min hashshuk:

Vechen para. sheddasha vecharshine hekdesh, chosem piha shello tochal mishshel hekdesh, dichtiv (Devarim 25) lo tachsom shor bedisho, bedayish sherauy lo lo tachsom, aval atta chosem bedayish shel hekdesh sheeno rauy lo, shehare hu asur leechol bahekdesh:
Mi shennadar benazir. bilshon shehaya dome lo shello haya nazir:
Venishal lechacham vaasaro. veamar lo sheyyesh belashon ze leshon nezirut, vehu lo nizhar millishtot yayin:
Mone mishshaa shennadar. velo kansinan leh al sheavar veshata yayin, af al gav demissafek asur haya lo lifrosh ad sheyyishal lechacham:
Nishal lechacham vehittiro. sheamar lo sheen belashon ze leshon nezirut:

Tetze vetire vaeder. dehafrasha vetaut havay vetetze lechullin. uveha modu bet shammay, dechevan deeno nazir, ki kaamar lekarbenot neziruto velo mide kaamar, keadam sheeno chayyav chattat veamar hare zo lechattati:
I attem modim baze shehu hekdesh taut. umay shena meresh pirkin deamrittu hekdesh betaut have hekdesh:
Amru lahem bet shammay. lo chashu lehashivam ikkar taamam, ella ledivrehem kaamri lehu, mitteshii veachad asar dekiddesho vetaut, dimrabbinan leh min vechol masar bakar vatzon (Vayikra 27):

Amru lahem bet hillel lo hashshevet kiddesho. bitmiah. kelomar gezerat hakkatuv hi ditshii veachad asar hassemuchim laasiri hashshevet mekaddeshan im kara lahem asiri, velo yalfinan minneh bealma dehekdesh betaut have hekdesh, deillu have tama mishshum hekdesh betaut im ken afillu shemini ushenem asar nammi, ella hakkatuv shekkiddesh asiri kulei, ugezerat hakkatuv hi velo yalfinan minna:
Hamezannev bigfanim. mekattea zanvot haggefanim kede sheyyeabbe haggeza veyigdal veyigbar kocho, vechen hakkotzetz kanim kede sheyyitabbu veyosif kochan:
Yarchik tefach. min hakkarka, veshuv lo mechaze kaavoda:
Shennifshach. nisdak, kemo (Eicha 3) vayfashshecheni:
Lo sheyyaale. sheyyitchabberu sedakav:
Ella shello yosif. lissadek:
Hareni nazir shezze ish peloni. im ze haholech lenegdi hu ish peloni hareni nazir, vehashsheni omer im en ze ish peloni hareni nazir:
Kullam nezirim. vaafillu otam shello nitkayyemu divrehem. dechi hechi dehekdesh betaut have hekdesh, hachi nammi nezirut betaut haveya nezirut:

Rabbi tarfon omer en echad mehem nazir. desavar rabbi tarfon en nezirut ella lehafelaa, kelomar sheyyehe barur veyadua lo bishat nidro sheyyehe nazir, vechol hane lo haya yadua lo bishat nidro sheyyihye chidvarav. veen halacha kerabbi tarfon:
Mishsheyyaase chayyotze vo. mimma shennizra bemotzae sheviit yesh giddul kayyotze vaze detalinan beh. i nammi mippene sherava hahetter al haissur venitbattel:
Habbakkir. makom shemmemaher levakker perotav yoter mishshear mekomot:
Huttar haafil. detalinan shemmimmekom habbakkir hevium:
Motzae sheviit miyyad. lefi shehayu meviim yarak michutza laaretz vehaya rave al yarak shebbeeretz yisrael. vaani shamati hattaam lefi shebbishnayim o shelosha yamim ose kayyotze vo:
Veim shellah. kegon shennatan lah acher bemattana al menat sheen levaalah reshut bahen. denichse melog venichse tzon barzel kullan meshubadim levaalah:
Chattat tamut. mamtinin lah ad shettamut:
Veneechalin leyom echad. keshalme nazir sheen neechalim ella leyom velayla:
Veen teunin lachem. shekkol shalme nazir teunim lechem, vezo hoil vehefer lah balah en shelamim hallalu teunin lechem:
Hayu lah maot setumim. shehifrishatan setam lekarbenot nazir, velo persha ellu hem lachattat veellu hem leola veellu hem lishlamim:
Yippelu lindava. lattevot shebbammikdash shemmashlichim bahem shear meot nedava vekonim mehen karbanot shekkullan olot:
Lo nehenin velo moalin. lechattechilla asur lehanot bahen, veim nehena eno chayyav lehavi karban meila haamur bechol mi shennehene min hahekdesh:
En kotztzin et hailan bashsheviit. mishshum dilachla amar rachamana velo lehefsed. vaani shamati kevan deafkerinhu rachamana lapperot, im yiktzetzem have gozel et harabbim:
Mishsheyyotzi. techillat healin bime nisan:
Mishsheyyeshalshelu. mishsheyyatchilu lehachebid velitlot keen shalshelet:
Mishsheyyegaru. mishsheyyaasu garinim. perush acher, habboser kesheyyagdilu haanavim venaasu kefol hallavan nikra garua:
Mishsheyyanetzu. mishsheyyigdal alehen hannetz, kemo hannitztzanim niru vaaretz (Shir HaShirim 2), kesheyyaggiu lashshiurim hallalu asur lekatztzan bashsheviit:

Muttar lekatztzo. veen kan mishshum hefsed happeri, o mishshum gazel leidach lishna, shekkevar happeri rauy laachila. umishshum kotzetz ilanot tovim lekka im hu meulle bedamim, sheddamav yekarim leetzim yoter milleilan:
Vechamma yehe vazzayit. lav ashsheviit kae, ella sheyyehe asur lekatztzo mishshum kotzetz ilanot tovim, kedichtiv (Devarim 20) ki mimmennu tochel veoto lo tichrot:
Rova. hakkav, mishshum dechashiv yoter mishshear ilanot, deillu bedekel muttar lekatztzo ad detain kabba:

Hayyotzer. umman haose kele cheres mocher afillu lechashud al hashsheviit chamesh kadde shemen vachamesh esre kadde yayin, velekka lemechash shemma rotze kullam leshemen o kullam leyayin, shennikkarim hen otam shel yayin meotam shel shemen, sheheafar sheosim mimmennu kadde yayin eno dome leafar sheosim mimmennu kadde shemen:
Veim hevi yoter mikkan muttar. velo chayshinan shemma min hameshummar dishviit hevi:
Umocher lenachrim baaretz. velo chayshinan shemma yachazor hannachri veyimkerem leyisrael hechashud:
Uleyisrael bechutza laaretz. velo chayshinan shemma yolichem baaretz, i nammi shemma yachnis letochan yayin veshemen shel sheviit shehevi meeretz yisrael, delo hechmiru chachamim kol kach:
Im tzerurin. keshurim kesher meshunne af al pi sheen alav chotam, o keshurim kishar kesharim vachatumin:
Lo yishtammesh bahen. degalle dateh delo nicha leh sheyyishtammesh bahen hannifkad, hoil ukesharan kesher meshunne o hittil alav chotam:
Muttarin. kare chol zeman sheen keshurim kesher meshunne ella kashur kishar kesharim veen alav chotam:

Lefichach im hotzi lo maal. dahave keillu amar lo hammafkid sheyyishtammesh bahen, kevan shello hayu tzerurin, vahare shelichuto asa, vehammafkid nammi lo maal deha lo amar lo beferush sheyyishtammesh bahen:
Hachenvani. shemmocher perot o besamim bachanut:
Kevaal habbayit. veim hifkidu etzlo maot, af al pi sheenan tzerurim, lo yishtammesh bahem, hilkach im hayu maot shel hekdesh venishtammesh bahen maal:
