Keshulchani. umuttar lehishtammesh bammaot shehifkidu etzlo kesheenan tzerurim, hilkach lo maal. vahalacha cherabbi yehuda:

Barishona. kederech shehu melakket mechavero et haggas haggas. hachi mefarsha matnitin bayrushalmi, barishona hayu omrim melakket adam betoch shello et haggas haggas kederech shemmelakket beshel chavero, ben gassin ben dakkin, veaf al gav deetzim vaasavim keshemmelakketim otan mittoch hassade metakken hassade lizria, keshemmelakket haggas kelomar haetzim vehaasavim haggassim umanniach et haddakkin, talinan detzarich laetzim hu velav letakken et hakkarka kaaved, kederech detalinan bimlakket bisde chavero ben dakkin uven gassin, delo aved inash letakken sede chavero umeda yedia delaetzim hu tzarich:
Mishsherabbu ovre avera. shehayu melakketin bisdotehen ben dakkim ben gassin vehen omrim baggassim likkatnu:
Shello vetova. sheen chavero machazik lo tova, dehashta vadday lo ate lemilkat haddakkin kevan sheen chavero machazik lo tova al ze:
Veen tzarich lomar sheyyekatztzetz lahem mezonot. sheyyomar lo lekot missadi hayyom veetten lecha mezonotecha, difshita deasur:

Shemen serefa. shemen shel teruma temea, mittoch shellisrefa omed kare leh shemen serefa, umaala asu lisrefa baaretz, kidashkechan bekadashim pesulim shehen nisrafim bimkoman, vechen perot sheviit tzerichim biur baaretz, dichtiv (Vayikra 25) beartzecha tihye chol tevuatah. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Shehu yachol leshachatah. uvechol dehu dematzinan lemitle talinan. uvet shammay savre deen derech kelal lishchot para haomedet lacharisha:
Afillu bishat hazzera. velo amrinan vadday lizria hu lokeach, detalinan laachila hu rotze:
Sheyyesh lo goren. velo chayshinan shemma moded lehachenis laotzar, deikka lemitle delitchina hu moded:
Uforet lo maot. machalif lo maot bifrutot:
Af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo poalim. venimtza mesayyea yede ovre avera, deamrinan shemma lishar tzerachav hu tzarich:
Vechullam. im peresh shelledavar asur rotze otam, asur:
Mishshehevi mayim. shessochato veyotze mimmennu mashke:
Mishshehivishu. mishsheyyikkaru basha, vehayenu kesheyyatchilu lehitbashshel venitbashshelu ad shehachartzannim shebbifnim nirim mibbachutz mittoch hakkelippa:

Haarla vechile hakkerem mitztarfin. sheim achal chatzi shiur mizze vachatzi shiur mizze, mitztarfin lilkot et haarbaim. i nammi, arla vechile hakkerem meoravim yachad shennaflu letoch hetter, mitztarfim leesor bayyavesh bematayim, uvallach benoten taam:
Enan mitztarfin. kevan dishne shemot ninhu. ella im yesh bakkedera levattel taam haarla vifne atzmah vetaam kile hakkerem bifne atzmo, hakkol muttar. veen halacha cherabbi shimon:
Habbeged. shehu mittamme shelosha al shelosha:
Vehassak. shehu mittamme arbaa al arbaa:
Vehaor. chamishsha al chamishsha:

Vehammappatz. shishsha al shishsha. habbeged mitztaref lassak shekkal hemennu, littamme vearbaa al arbaa. vechen kol echad mitztaref lakkal. vechullan mitztarfim ze im ze littamme cheshiur hattuma hakkalla, aval lo hakkal im hechamur:

Mippene shehen reuyim littamme moshav. kelomar af al gav daamaran leel dechol sheen shiuran shave enan mitztarfin, hacha mitztarfin af al pi sheen shiuran shave, hoil vehen shavin ledavar ze shekkol echad mehen rauy littamme bemoshav hazzav hilkach mitztarfin letumat moshav:
Bamme devarim amurim bekadshe mizbeach. hoil vechalav uvetzim enan reuyin lammizbeach, hilkach lo nehenin velo moalim:

Aval bekadshe vedek habbayit. hachi nammi demoalim bahen, hoil ukedushshat damim hen, reuyin hen levedek habbayit. uvaggemara mefaresh dematnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, bamme devarim amurim, keshehikdishan kedushshat hagguf lammizbeach, aval hikdishan kedushshat damim legabbe mizbeach kegon sheamar deme of ze o deme vehema zo hekdesh lehavi mehem ola, naasa chemi shehikdishan levedek habbayit devadday vikdushshat damim demizbeach it beh meila vabbetzim uvechalav:

Hareni nazir vaat veamra amen mefer et shellah. vedavka ki amar lah bilshon sheela, kelomar vaat ma tomri, tehevi nezira kamoni im lav, az yachol lehafer. aval im amar hareni nazir vaat, benichuta, veanta amen, eno yachol lehafer, shehare kiyyem lah:
Veeno mevi karban tuma. dechi ketiv karban tuma, benazir tahor shennitma hu dichtiv. umikkol makom im hitru bo chayyav malkot:

Yatza venichnas olin lo min hamminyan umevi karban tuma. ha matnitin mipparsha baggemara hachi, yatza mibbet hakkevarot vehizza shelishi ushevii vetaval vetahar mittumato vehitchil limnot yeme neziruto, af al pi shechazar venichnas achar kach levet hakkevarot, olin lo min hamminyan ellu hayyamim shemmana achar shettahar, hoil vehifsika tohora ben hayyamim harishonim shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot uven ellu hayyamim haacharonim. veaf al pi shechazar venichnas levet hakkevarot, tumat bet hakkevarot enah soteret minyan hayyamim shennimnu betohora, sheen soter bannazir ella shetem esre tumot haamurot bo. vehay dekaamar tu umevi karban tuma, hachi kaamar, im nitma shuv beachat min hattumot shehannazir megalleach, mevi karban tuma vesoter:

Rabbi eliezer omer lo vo vayyom. kelomar im bo vayyom shettaval vetahar bo vayyom nitma beachat min hattumot shehannazir megalleach, eno soter oto hayyom, dichtiv vehayyamim harishonim yippelu, en hattuma soteret ad sheyyihyu lo shene yamim shel nezirut menuyim. vehu haddin benazir bealma shennitma beyom rishon shel minyan neziruto, sheen hattuma soteret oto hayyom, ella mashlim alav minyan yeme neziruto. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kelal gadol. uledamav sheviit. im mecharan vekibbel haddamim shellahem, yesh bidmehen kedushshat sheviit:
Yesh lo biur. keshekkala lachayya chayyav levaer:

Ale luf shote. itztarich lemitne luf shote mishshum ditnan beferek batra deukketzim ale luf shote en mittamme tumat ochalim, salka datach amena hachi nammi lo lechol alayhu kedushshat sheviit, kamashma lan:
Haddandanna. baaravi 240 uvelaaz 116:

Haulshin. tere gavne ulshin hen, ulshe ginna veulshe sade, uvishar shanim dishchiche ulshe ginna, ulshe sade lo chashive ochel veen mittamme tumat ocholim, vehacha ka mashma lan devashsheviit deen ulshe ginna metzuyin, ulshe sade chashive umittammein tumat ocholim usheviit noheget bahen:
Uchereshin. nammi tere gavne ninhu, kereshe ginna uchereshe sade, uchereshe sade itztarich leashmuinan:
Hargila. hem chaloglogot uvelaaz 565:
Venetz hechalav. perachim levanim kechalav. perush acher esev hu keshennechtach yotze mimmennu chalav:
Hachochim vehaddardarim. mine kotzim hen:
Istis. hu shetztzovin bo kemin techelet, vekorim lo baaravi 90, vekotzrim oto vehu tzomeach vedome lesafiach, lechach korehu hattanna sefiche istis:
Vekotza. min mimmine hatztzevaim, yesh omrim shehu 477 baaravi:
Yesh lahen sheviit. kedushshat sheviit noheget bahen shello lehafesidam veshello laasot bahem sechora:
Veyesh lahem biur. kesheyyaggia zeman habbiur tzarich levaaram, ulekamman bifnim meforashim dine habbiur:

En meviin teruma michutza laaretz laaretz. lefi shehatteruma kohanim mechazzerin achareha levet haggeranot, chayshe rabbanan shemma yihyu hakkohanim meraddefim achareha veyetzu chutza laaretz lehavi et hatteruma. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kol happiggulim. meola mechattat umeasham umishshelamim:
Mitztarfin ze im ze. laochel mehen kazzayit lihyot chayyav karet. vechen kol hannotarim:

Kol hannevelot mitztarfot. vaafillu nivlat behema temea im nivlat behema tehora, mitztarfim lechazzayit leinyan tuma. aval lo lemalkot, sheeno loke ad sheyyochal kazzayit minnivlat behema tehora levaddah, o chazzayit min hattemea levaddah, lefi shehen shene shemot, sheen ochel besar behema temea loke mishshum nevela ella mishshum ochel besar behema temea:

Vechol hashsheratzim mitztarfim ze im ze. lechazzayit, lechayyev et haochlan malkot. ushemona sheratzim hakketuvim battora mitztarfim ze im ze, lechayyev haochlan bechaadasha, keshiur tumatan kach shiur achilatan:
Dam hashsheretz uvesaro mitztarfim. dimrabbinan mikkera dichtiv (Vayikra 11) veze lachem hattame bashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz, lerabbot dam hashsheretz sheyyihye metamme chivsaro:
Kol shettumato veshiuro shavin. kegon nevela unevela, o sheretz vesheretz:
Tumato velo shiuro. kegon nevela vesheretz detumatan shava, detarvayhu have tumatan ad haerev. velo shiuro, dinvela shiur tumatah bechazzayit, vesheretz shiuro vechaadasha:
Shiuro velo tumato. kegon nevela umet, detarvayhu metammein bechazzayit. velo tumato, deillu tumat met shiva, vetumat nevela lo have ella ad haerev:
Lo tumato velo shiuro. kegon met vesheretz, detumat met have shiva, vetumat sheretz ad haerev. uveshiuro nammi enan shavin, deshiur met bechazzayit veshiur sheretz bechaadasha:
Ellu en mitztarfin ze im ze. hoil umechullakin hen:

Bammukdashin ella vehema uchele sharet. behema temima, behemat [kadshe mizbeach] temima. dehane lav lifdiyya kayme velav bene fegima ninhu, sheafillu rachav echad al gabbe vehema vehichchishah o talash min tzamrah, adayin reuya hi lekarban, veyesh bah moel achar moel. vechen shata echad bechos shel zahav, afillu im pegamo ufechato, kevan (dekadosh) [dikdushshat hagguf] hu velav lifdiyya kae, rauy hu adayin lesherut veyesh bo moel achar moel. aval kadshe vedek habbayit kegon behemat kadshe vedek habbayit, en bahem moel achar moel, mishshum divne fediyya ninhu, vechevan shemmaal bo echad shehotzio lechullin, tu let bah meila:

Rabbi omer kol davar. sheen lo fegam, sheeno nifsal, dehaynu chol davar sheen lo fidyon ki hane daamaran, afillu fegamo yesh bo moel achar moel. veikka ven tanna kamma lerabbi kadshe mizbeach temimim shennaasu vaale mumim veavar ushechatan kodem pediyya. rabbi omer yikkavru, mishshum devau haamada vehaaracha velo efshar deha metu, hilkach yikkavru, vechevan delo havu tu vene fediyya yesh bo moel achar moel hannehene mehen leachar shechita. vachachamim omrim yippadu, delo vau haamada vehaaracha, vechevan dikdushshat damim ninhu en bo moel achar moel. vahalacha kachachamim:

Veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad yatza. sheyyom sheloshim shel nezirut rishona ola lechan ulechan, vechevan sheyyom sheloshim shel harishona nimne gam min hannezirut hashsheniyya nimtzeu sheloshim yom shel nezirut sheniyya kalim beshishshim chaser echad:
Nazir shehaya shote yayin kol hayyom. velo hitru vo ella achat:
Al tishte al tishte. shehitru bo ben shetiyya lishtiyya:
Vehayta shota yayin umittammea lemetim. veachar kach hefer lah balah:
Hare zo sofeget et haarbaim. al sheavra kodem hafara:

Tispog makkat mardut. middivre sofrim. umakkot mardut haamura bechol makom, kefi mare ene haddayyan uchefi tzorech hashshaa. vedavka baavera shekkevar neesta, aval gabbe mitzvot ase kegon ase sukka veeno ose, tol lulav veeno notel, makkin oto ad sheyyaase o ad shettetze nafsho:
Sheen haumman rashshay lemachran bashsheviit. lemi shehu chashud al hashsheviit, aval lemi sheeno chashud share, deeno kone ella lehatzenia ad [achar] sheviit:
Mizre. shezzorin bo hattevua baggoren:
Dakar. kemin yated shel barzel shekkorin kavelaterav belaaz, vehu asuy lachpor bo et hakkarka, leshon vayyidkor et shenehem (Bamidbar 25):
Maggal yad umaggal katzir vaagala. muttarin, shemma hu [rotze] liktzor min hahefker ulehavi baagala lemaachal beto, veen asur ella lehavi harebe laasot otzar:

Ad shivim lo hifsid kelum. shekkeshehu mafsik neziruto umone nezirut beno umegalleach vechozer umashlim et shello letashlum neziruto min hashshivim shemmana kevar ad hammea shennadar, hem sheloshim yom, nimtza ben tiglachat shel nezirut beno letiglachat shel tashlum neziruto sheloshim yom veeno mafsid kelum. aval im mana yoter mishshivim yom kodem shehitchil binzirut beno uva lehafesik neziruto kede lehatechil nezirut beno, kesheyyegalleach al nezirut beno uva lehashelim neziruto ad mea yom shennadar nimtzeu pachot mishsheloshim yom ben tiglachat shel nezirut beno letiglachat shel neziruto, vei efshar lihyot ben tiglachat letiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom, venimtza mafsid kol otan hayyamim shemmana yoter mishshivim:
Setam nezirut sheloshim yom. af al gav detane lah leel, mishshum devae lemitne sefa gillach o sheggillechuhu listim soter sheloshim yom, hadar tana leh hacha:
Soter sheloshim yom. kelomar soter ad sheyyihye lo giddul sear shel sheloshim yom keshehu megalleach tiglachat shel mitzva:
O shessifsef kol shehu. sheakar vehishshir afillu sear echad, chayyav, dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) taar lo yaavor, lerabbot kol hammaavirin:
Chofef. mechakkech beyado:
Umefaspes. betzipparnav o vichli, uvilvad shello yitkavven lehashshir, dedavar sheen mitkavven muttar:

Aval lo sorek. bemasrek, dahave pesik resheh veasur. af al gav dehammashshir afillu sear achat loke, mikkol makom eno soter sheloshim yom ad sheyyegalleach rov searo vetaar o vemisparayim betzad ikkaro shel sear:
Lo yachof baadama. min mimmine adama shehi mashsheret hassear, deha nammi have pesik resheh. vahalacha kerabbi yishmael:

Hammedel bazzetim. keshehazzetim mekoravim ze laze yoter midday notel echad umanniach shenayim o notel shenayim umanniach echad kede sheyyigdal veyitabbe. medel leshon shelifa vahasara, veyesh mefarshim leshon dildul vedallut, shemmedaldel sadehu min hazzetim:
Yagom. gomem umekatztzetz hailan umashir hashshoresh baaretz, velo yesharesh legamre, shello yerae keoved et haadama:
Umodim bemachalik. kegon im notel shelosha zetim ze betzad ze, shemmachalik pene hakkarka yoter midday, yomru laavodat karka hu mitkavven veasur:
Mittoch shel chavero af hammachalik yesharesh. delo aved inash sheyyetakken karka chavero, veyadua delaetzim hu mechavven:

Hare ze lo maal. baggemara moke la begizbar shel hekdesh, shehaeven vehakkora shel hekdesh hayu mesurot beyado mittechilla, vechi netalan leatzmo adayin hem birshut hekdesh, dechol hecha dimtaltel lehu veveteh havu virshut hekdesh kevattechilla. aval ki netanah lachavero, hotziah mershuto veshinna mehekdesh lechol umaal, vachavero lo maal shekkevar yatza lechullin:

Benaah betoch beto. lo venaah mammash, deim ken hare nehena miyyad shehosif bevinyan beto. ella chegon shennetanah al pi arubba shello vabbinyan, dehashta en lo hanaa ad sheyyadur tachteha veyehane vah beshave feruta, kegon shehayu ferotav netunim tachat haarubba, vehayu geshamim dolfim alehem, vesatam pi arubba veeven shel hekdesh, kevan shehegen alehen beshave feruta, maal:
Netanah labballan. kede sheyyannichennu lirchotz bevet hammerchatz:
Shene shemot. shene lavin chalukin:

Kakkal shebbishnehem. kelomar, delo mitztaref letuma afillu leshiur kal, kegon sheyyitztaref pachot mikkaadasha desheretz lehashelim kazzayit dinvela, vechol shekken delo mitztaref leshiur chamur. vechen chatzi zayit shel met en mitztaref lachatzi zayit shel nevela letamme afillu letumat erev:
Haochel shennitma veav. zehu valad rishon:
Veshennitma vivlad hattuma. zehu valad sheni:
Mitztarfin ze im ze. lechabbetza, shehi shiur tumat ochalin:

Letamme chakkal shebbishnehem. laasot shelishi chederech hashsheni laasot shelishi, vehayenu chakkal shebbishnehem. aval en mitztarfin lehachi sheyyeasu sheni kemo sheose rishon sheni, deim ken haya chechamur shebbishnehem:
Mi sheamar hareni nazir megalleach yom sheloshim veechad. distam nezirut sheloshim yom:
Veim gillach yom sheloshim yatza. demiktzat hayyom kechullo:
Hareni nazir sheloshim yom im gillach yom sheloshim lo yatza. dehoil uferesh sheloshim yom, shelemim kaamar:

Lifsol et haggeviyya. haochel ochalim temeim bechachatzi feras, shehu vetza umechetza ledivre rambam, ushene vetzim ledivre rabbotay, nifselet geviyyato milleechol batteruma, ufosel et hatteruma vemaggao ad sheyyitbol:

Bimzon shete seuddot laeruv. harotze lalechet yoter mealpayim amma veshabbat ose eruve techumin umanniach mezon shete seuddot bammakom sherotze sheyyikne lo eruvo, veholech mimmekom eruvo ulehallan alpayim amma. vehu shesh vetzim ledivre rambam, ushemone vetzim ledivre rabbotay:

Bechabbetza letamme tumat ochalin. sheen ochel metamme vefachot mikkabbetza, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) mikkol haochel asher yeachel, demashma ochel hanneechol bevat achat, veshiaru chachamim sheen bet habbelia machazik yoter mibbetzat tarnegolet:
Bechaggerogeret lehotzaat shabbat. hammotzi ochalim beshabbat mershut lirshut eno chayyav befachot mikkaggerogeret:

Bechakkotevet beyom hakkippurim. sheshshinna hakkatuv vechatav teannu, velo chatav lo tochlu, demashma delo kafed rachamana ella ainnuy, veshiaru chachamim devakkotevet miyyatteva dateh deeynish, befachot mikkakkotevet lo miyyatteva dateh:
Lifsol et haggeviyya virviit. hashshote mashkim temeim birviit, nifsela geviyyato milleechol batteruma ufosel et hatteruma vemaggao ad sheyyitbol:
Uvimlo lugmav. shehashshote veyom hakkippurim melo lugmav, chayyav. pachot mikken, patur:
Benot shuach. teenim levanot hamegaddelot mishshalosh shanim leshalosh shanim:

Sheviit shellahem shana sheniyya. shel shemitta, deferot hachontim bashsheviit en nigmar bishshulan ad shana sheniyya shel shemitta shehi shelishit lachanita, veaz noheg bahen din sheviit, devatar chanata azlinan:
Parsiyyot. min teenim sheosim mishshete shanim lishte shanim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shennitkavvetza. shennittelu kotzeha bashsheviit:

Shennittayyeva. shennechresha hetev, shekkol haolam chorshim paam achat vehu charash shete peamim. umatnitin ayre bishat hassakkana shehayta hammalchut oneset al hammas hammutal al hakkarkaot vehittiru lacharosh bashsheviit kede litten hammas hakkatzuv mittevuatah lammelech, veim charash shete peamim kenasuhu rabbanan, dacharisha achat hittiru velo shete charishot:
O shenniddayyera. sheasu mimmenna dir labbehemot sheasa vah sahar kidamrinan befirkin dilel, velo asa mimmennu ashpot ella hinnicho kede lezabbel bo hassade:
Lo tizzara lemotzae sheviit. dekansinan leh bahane yoter mibbenitkavvetza:
Betova. asur, deen machazikin tova labbealim, derachamana afkerinhu:
Chilluf haddevarim. devet shammay lekulla. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Raa et hakkoy. shishsha bene adam sherau et hakkoy, veamar echad mehen hareni nazir im ze chayya, veamar hashsheni hareni nazir im eno chayya, veamar hashshelishi hareni nazir im hu behema, veamar harvii hareni nazir im eno behema, veamar hachamishi hareni nazir im hu chayya uvehema, veamar hashshishshi hareni nazir im eno lo chayya velo vehema, veatu shelosha acharine mealma veamar chad minnayhu leelu hashshishsha, hareni nazir im echad mikkem nazir, veamar hashsheni hareni nazir im en echad mikkem nazir, veamar hashshelishi hareni nazir im kullechem nezirim, kullan nezirim, hashshishsha harishonim vehashshelosha haacharonim. levet shammay havu nezirim vadday, dinzirut betaut have nezirut, uven oto shennitkayyemu devarav uven oto shello nitkayyemu devarav have nazir. ulevet hillel have nezirut safek, mippene shehakkoy sefek behema sefek chayya sefek beriyya bifne atzmah:
Mi shennadar benazir. uveshaa shennadar hayu lo vehemot veaddata dehachi nadar sheyyakriv karbenotav meotam behemot. vehalach umetzaan shennignevu umechamat ze mitcharet al shennadar benazir:
Im ad shello nignevu vehemotav nadar hare ze nazir. velo yattir lo hechacham befetach ze, denolad have veen potchin benolad:

Veim leachar shennignevu nadar. veamar illu hayiti yodea shennignevu lo hayiti noder, hare ze petach veyattirennu hechacham: vezo taut taa nachum hammadi shekkeshealu nezirim min haggola umatzu vet hammikdash charev. vehem nadru kodem shecharav habbayit, vehittir lahen, veamru lo chachamim denolad hu veen potchin benolad. vahalacha kachachamim:

Sharshe ilan shel hedyot bain beshel hekdesh, lo nehenim velo moalim. devatar ilan azlinan veilan beshel hedyot kae. vehane mille kesheen ben ilan shel hedyot lakkarka shel hekdesh ella shesh esre amma o fachot. aval im yesh benehen yoter mishshesh esre amma, moalin bashsharashim haggedelim bisde hekdesh, delo gerire tu vatar ilan:

Veshel hekdesh bain beshel hedyot lo nehenin velo moalin. kegon sheyyesh ben ilan shel hekdesh lakkarka shel hedyot yoter mishshesh esre amma, desharashim haggedelim beshel hedyot lo gerire vatar ilan shel hekdesh hoil urechokim mimmennu kol kach, hilkach lo moalin. aval im en benehen ella shesh esre amma o fachot, moalim bahen:

Hammayan shehu yotze mittoch sede hekdesh. rabbotay pershuha li, kegon demayan shel chullin hu venovea besade shel hedyot, ella shennimshach veyotze veover betoch sade shel hekdesh, lo nehenim mimmennu vetoch sade shel hekdesh, velo moalim, demishshel hedyot hu novea:
Yatzu. hammayim shebbemayan ze shennovea missade shel hedyot veover besade shel hekdesh yatza missade shel hekdesh, nehenim mimmennu lechattechilla:

Hammayim shebbechad shel zahav. gabbe nissuch hammayim beshivat yeme hechag tenan kemaasehu vechol kach maasehu veshabbat ella shehaya memalle meerev shabbat chavit shel zahav sheenah mekuddeshet min hashshilloach, uveotan mayim lo nehenim velo moalin, delo ikkaddush lenissuch hammayim limila ad sheyyinnatnu litzlochit shel zahav dehaynu keli mekuddash:
Arava. shehayu zokfim otah etzel hammizbeach, keditnan beferek lulav vaarava [mishna 5]:
Notnim hayu mimmennah bellulav. battechilla kodem shezzekafuha. veaf al pi shello likketuha ella chede lezakfah al gabbe mizbeach:
Mi sheamar hareni nazir. kullam nezirim. vehu shehitpis kol echad mehen betoch divre chavero bichde sheelat shalom talmid larav, shehu kede sheyyomar shalom alecha rabbi:
Pi chefiv kulei. vehu sheyyomar pi kefiv miyyayin useari kisaro millehiggazez:

Veshama balah veamar vaani, eno yachol lehafer. shekkevar kiyyem nidrah kesheamar vaani. veim ishsha nadra benazir veshama acher veamar vaani, veachar kach hefer lah balah, eno mufar laze sheamar vaani, sheen habbaal oker hanneder meikkaro kemo hechacham:

Hannehene shave feruta min hahekdesh af al pi shello fagam maal. pelugta derabbi akiva verabbanan mefaresh baggemara kegon bilvusha metziaa. dilvush mibbachutz pagim lealtar, lefi shemmitchakkech bakketalim. velo ifligu nammi vilvush delifnim legabbe visreh, dehahu nammi fagim lealtar mechamat zea, ella vilvusha metziaa. rabbi akiva savar hoil vehave davar dela fagim lealtar af al gav defagim leachar zeman have chedavar sheen bo fegam umoalim bo, kevan shennehena veshave feruta. verabbanan savre, hoil veyesh bo fegam mikkol makom, en moalim bo ad sheyyifgom:

Ketzad. davar sheen bo fegam, kegon natna katla vetzavvarah, ravid shel zahav shel hekdesh, o tabbaat beyadah, o shatta vechos shel zahav shel hekdesh, kol hane en bahem pegam bechach, ella chevan shennehenet mehen shave feruta, maala. vechetzad meshaarim bahen hanaa, omdin kamma ishsha rotza litten sheyyashiluha tachshitim kemot hallalu leholichan levet hammishte lehitkabbed bahen, keoto shiur meshallemet lahekdesh keren vechomesh keshennishtammesha vahen.
Vechol davar sheyyesh bo fegam. kegon lavash bechaluk, o chissa vetallit, o vikka bekurdom, kevan deomdim lippagem, lo maal ad sheyyifgom bahem beshave feruta:
Talash. sear:

Min hachattat. bechattat baalat mum ayre deomedet lippadot, vedavar sheyyesh bo fegam hu, hilkach lo maal ad sheyyifgom beshave feruta. aval bechattat temima ditlishat tzemer vesear la avid bah midi, shekkach hi reuya lehakerava achshav kemo shehayta mittechilla, haveya chechos shel zahav shehu davar sheen bo fegam, vechevan shennehena mimmenna maal:
Keshehi meta kevan shennehena maal. dechevan shemmeta lav bat pediyya hi, deen podim et hakkodashim lehaachilan lakkelavim. umayre ven bechattat temima ben bechattat baalat mum:

Betzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim. betzalim shel shishshit shennichnesu lashsheviit, veyardu alehem geshamim vetzamchu, im hishchiru healin beyadua sheggadlu vehosifu, vaatu giddule sheviit umevattelim haikkar af al pi shehu merubbe. aval im horiku healin az holchim uchemeshin velav meara ka ravu:

Im yecholin littalesh bealin. derech betzalim keshennigmarim yotzin meatzman min haaretz venochin littalesh, veim healin chazakim uchesheochez bahen yachol litlosh habbetzalim min haaretz, az vadday gadlu vashsheviit:

Keneged ken lemotzae sheviit muttarim. lav bivtzalim shel sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit mayre, delo mekilinan behu kulle hay sheggiddule hetter kol shehu yaalu et haissur, ella sefa nammi mayre bivtzalim shel shishshit sheakaran bashshishshit vechazar unetaan bashsheviit, uleachar sheggadlu meat bashsheviit akaran vechazar unetaan bashsheminit, umittoch shekkevar gadlu bashshishshit lo hosifu ki im meat bashsheviit veneesru, ucheshechazru vehosifu meat bashsheminit chazar oto hetter uvittel issur hammuat, sheggam shel shishshit mesayyea levattelo achar shessof giddulo hetter. veen halacha kerabbi chananya ven antignos:
Nitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol. shehare nitma betoch yeme hannezirut. velo amrinan deyom sheloshim ole lechan ulechan demiktzat hayyom kechullo ella kesheggillach vehevi karbenotav bo vayyom:
Rabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva. disvira leh amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo ucheillu nitma leachar melot, vetuma dilachar melot lerabbi eliezer enah soteret ella shiva:

Hareni nazir sheloshim yom nitma yom sheloshim soter et hakkol. ben lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbanan. dechevan deamar hareni nazir sheloshim yom, hakkol modim dishloshim yom shelemim bainan, velo amrinan beha miktzat hayyom kechullo. verabbi eliezer disvira leh shehannitma beyom melot mammash soter sheloshim bilvad veeno soter hakkol, yalef lah mikkera dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) vezot torat hannazir beyom melot, nitma beyom melot ten lo torat hannazir, kelomar setam nezirut sheloshim yom, hacha sheamar hareni nazir sheloshim yom venitma beyom sheloshim shehu yom melot, lechi soter kol hashsheloshim, soter et hakkol. verabbanan nammi diflige aleh derabbi eliezer veamre shehannitma beyom melot soter et hakkol vaafillu mana kamma yamim, hacha ki amar hareni nazir sheloshim yom venitma beyom melot, lechi nammi soter sheloshim soter et hakkol, hilkach ben lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbanan soter et hakkol. uvechol ha deafligu rabbi eliezer vachachamim halacha kachachamim:
Shalosh aratzot lashsheviit. chalukot leinyan din sheviit:
Kol shehecheziku ole vavel. ezra vesiato keshealu mibbavel:

Lo neechol velo neevad. sheavodat haaretz hahi asura bashsheviit, veim neevda vegiddela asur leechol meotan giddulim. perush acher veikkar, lo neechol leachar sheviit belo viur, velo neevad bashsheviit:

Mikkeziv vead hannahar vead amnom. keziv mashuch kelappe hatztzafon letzad mizrach, uretzua yotzet meakko sheyyoshevet beribbuah shel eretz yisrael bemiktzoa tzefonit mizrachit, veotah retzua meshucha kelappe tzafon veholechet ad keziv, uretzua acheret meshucha meakko kelappe mizrach uvah hannahar haamur kan, veellu hashshete retzuot kevashum ole mitzrayim velo chevashum ole vavel:

Vead amnom. hu hor hahar hakkatuv bigvulot haaretz befarashat elle mase, tetau lachem hor hahar metargeminan bayrushalmi ture amnom, vehu bitzfonah shel eretz yisrael letzad maarav etzel hayyam haggadol, vegam zo lo chavshu ole vavel, hilkach neechol leachar habbiur, uleidach lishna im neevad bashsheviit neechol, dikdushsha rishona kadsha lishatah velo kadsha leatid lavo, velo neevad, dilinyan avoda hechmiru leesor midderabbanan:

Minnahar umeamnom velifnim. kach katuv bechol hassefarim, utefe hava nicha i hava garsinan velachutz. veefshar lefaresh bedochak mehannahar velifnim mittechillat hannahar velifnim letzad hannahar chutza laaretz, vechen mittechillat ture amnom velifnim letzad hahar keruya lifnim:

Kadshe hammizbeach mitztarfim ze im ze limila. im nehena mishshene mine kadshe mizbeach beshave feruta, maal. umitztarfim nammi lechazzayit lechayyev alehem mishshum ochel piggul o notar o tame, o lechayyev lammaale chazzayit bachutz:
Kadshe vedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze. limila. aval piggul venotar vetame en bahen:
Kadshe hamizbeach vekadshe vedek habbayit mitztarfim ze im ze limila. aval lo ledavar acher, kedaamaran dekadshe vedek habbayit let behu figgul venotar vetame:
Hashshaliach. shennatan lo vaal habbayit hekdesh o maot hekdesh lehotziam betorat chullin, veasa hashshaliach shelichuto:

Baal habbayit maal. devimila yesh shaliach lidvar avera. uvechol hattora chullah en shaliach lidvar avera chutz mimmeila, mishshum dichtiv bah (Bamidbar 5) veashma hannefesh hahi, mi sheshshagag techilla, dehaynu hameshalleach:
Ten basar laorchim. meoto vasar shel hekdesh:
Venatan lahem kaved. shel hekdesh:

Vehu amar tolu shetayim vechulei. uvilvad sheyyomar hashshaliach telu shetayim middati, az baal habbayit maal, delo akar hashshaliach shelichuto af al pi shehosif al divre hameshalleach, hilkach hameshalleach maal shehare naaset shelichuto, vehashshaliach maal al zot shehosif middato, vehaorchim nammi chayyavim al hashshelishit shennatlu middatam. aval im lo amar hashshaliach telu shetayim middati, ella telu shetayim bishlichut baal habbayit, hameshalleach maal shehare naasa devaro, vehashshaliach patur mippene shehosif al shelichut baal habbayit velo akar et hashshelichut, uma shehosif lo hosif middato:
Geluskema. bilshon yavan korin leteva geluskos. vayisem baaron, targum yerushalmi veshavun yateh bigluskema:
Af al pi sheamar baal habbayit lo haya velibbi ella mizze kulei‏ maal. lefi sheasa hashshaliach maamaro, udevarim shebballev enan devarim:
Hattomen et halluf. min mimmine habbetzalim shergilim letamnan baaretz:

Lo yifchot missatayim. mishshum demechaze kezorea, ad sheyyitmon mehem satayim bachafira achat al gova shelosha tefachim, shello yihyu mefuzzarim ella yihye gova hakkeri vehatztzibbur shelosha tefachim, vetefach afar al gabbe hakkeri:
Vetomno bimkom derisat haadam. kede shello yitzmach. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hammafrish maot linziruto. velo feresh ellu leolati veellu lechattati veellu lishlamay:
Lo nehenim velo moalim. bechol otan hammaot:

Mippene shehen reuyin lehavi chullan shelamim. kelomar dechol maa umaa matzinan lememar zo lishlamim hifrish. ushelamim kadashim kallim ninhu veen bahen din meila, keditnan beshilhe ferek kamma, kadashim kallim lifne zerikat daman en moalim. veaf al gav deikka nammi vahadayhu chattat veola divne meila ninhu, kevan deikka nammi deme shelamim sheenan bene meila, i ka mayte alayhu karban meila ishtakkach demayte chullin baazara, hilkach lo nehenin velo moalin:
Met. hammafrish hammaot. vehayu hammaot setumim, shello feresh ellu lechattat veellu leola veellu lishlamim, yippelu chol hammaot lindava:
Deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach. dechattat shemmetu vealeha hi:
Deme ola yaviu ola. kidamrinan [kinnim sof perek 2] haishsha shemmeta yaviu yorsheha et olatah, dedoron bealma hu:
Veneechalin leyom echad. kedin shalme nazir:
Veenan teunin lachem. divlechem ketiv (Bamidbar 6) venatan al kappe hannazir, vehacha leteh, demit:

Vehishlim et neziruto veachar kach ba laaretz. sheen nezirut noheget ella baaretz, mishshum tumat eretz haammim. umi shennadar nezirut bechutza laaretz mechayyevin oto laalot leeretz yisrael velihyot noheg sham neziruto:
Nazir battechilla. tzarich linhog beeretz yisrael keminyan hayyamim shennadar binzirut, vehayyamim shennahag binzirut bechutza laaretz keillu lo nahag bahem nezirut kelal:

Amar rabbi yehuda lo hayta nezira ella arba esre shana. rabbi yehuda sevira leh kerabbi eliezer deamar leel befirkin hannitma beyom melot eno soter ella sheloshim yom, umishshum hachi kaamar dehilni hammalka shennitmea besof arba esre shana shehaya beyom melot lo satra hakkol velo hutzrecha limnot od sheva shanim acherot ella sheloshim yom bilvad. ulefi shello hayta shana shelema lo menaah bacheshbon, vahare hu cheillu amar lo hayta nezira ella arba esre shana usheloshim yom:

Velad chattat vechulei‏ yamutu. dehane ninhu mechamesh chattaot digmire demetot. vehanach telat leolam metot, ben kodem kappara ben leachar kappara, dilolam lo karve. umishna zo shenuya veresh perek 4‏ ditmura vesham perashnuha:

Rabbi yehuda omer miyyad. veaf al gav devishar yerakot mode rabbi yehuda deasur ad sheyyaase kayyotze vo, beluf hoil vetzarich leakro levet shammay bemaarufot shel etz ulevet hillel bekardummot shel mattachot, veen derech leakro bashsheviit ella al yede shinnuy, hilkach bemotzae sheviit lo shechiach deissura umishshum hachi muttar miyyad, aval yarak shello gazru shello letalsho ki orcheh shechiach nammi deissura bashsheminit, lefichach asur ad sheyyaase kayyotze vo:
Mishsheyyirbe hechadash. bayrushalmi mefaresh dehaynu min happesach veelach. vahalacha kachachamim:
Haddam battechilla en moalin bo. hayenu kodem zerikato, dichtiv (Vayikra 17) vaani netattiv lachem al hammizbeach lechapper, lechappara netattiv velo limila:

Yatza lenachal kidron moalin bo. hayenu vatar zerika, keditnan ellu vaellu hayenu damim hachitzonim vedamim happenimiyyim hannishpachim al mizbach haola, mitarvim baamma, silon shebbaazara, veyotzim lenachal kidron venimkarim laggannanim lezevel, umoalim bahen. vehach meila, midderabbanan hi velo middeorayta, deen lecha davar shennaaset mitzvato umoalim bo:

Yatzu lashshitin. nekev haya vammizbeach shebbo yordim hannesachim lashshitin, dehaynu yesodot shel mizbeach shehen chalulim vaamukkim meod. veim hichnis yado vekibbel hannesachim kodem sheyyardu lattehom, en moalin bahen, shekkevar naaset mitzvatan:
Ufagam bechachatzi shiur. kegon lavash bigde kodesh bahanaat shiur shave chatzi feruta ufagam bechachatzi feruta, shekkara bo ufegamo cheshiur chatzi feruta:
Shennehena veshave feruta bedavar echad. sheyyesh bo fegam velo fagam:
Ufagam beshave feruta bedavar acher. kegon shafach mashke shel kodesh velo nehena:

Hare ze lo maal ad sheyyehane veshave feruta veyifgom beshave feruta bedavar echad. beatzmo, veyihye davar sheyyesh bo fegam. devimila chetiv (Vayikra 5) vechata bishgaga, uveochel teruma chetiv (Bamidbar 18) velo tisu alav chet, ma chet haamur beochel teruma pogem venehene, uvema sheppagam nehena, af chattat haamur bimila tzarich sheyyihye pogem venehene uveoto davar beatzmo sheppogem nehene velo vedavar acher:
Luf sheavra alav sheviit. venichnesa alav sheminit, shehu mitkayyem zeman merubbe baaretz bimchubbar:

Im laktu aniyyim et alav lakatu. daale halluf yesh lahen biur veikkaro en lo biur keditnan lekamman beferek 7, hilkach im laktu aniyyim et alav bashsheviit lakatu, veim lav venichnesu lashsheminit vegadlu healin, nimtzeu giddule sheviit usheminit meoravin yachad:
Yaase cheshbon. vishaer kamma gadal mehen bashsheviit, veyitten laaniyyim, derabbi eliezer savar kerabbi yehuda deamar lekamman aniyyim ochlim achar biur velo ashirim:
Rabbi yehoshua omer en laaniyyim immo cheshbon. desavar kerabbi yose deamar lekamman echad aniyyim veechad ashirim ochlim achar habbiur. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Haish maddir et beno venazir. keshehu katan ad sheyyavi shete searot achar sheyyihye ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad, vechol din nezirut alav, veaviv mevi karbenotav, veim nitma mevi karban tuma. vehay maddiro, sheomer lo tehe nazir o hare beni peloni nazir, vehu shello yimche lo habben velo hakkerovim. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala:

Ketzad, gillach o sheggillechuhu kerovim. ketzad yaase haav bakkarbanot bizman sheggillach habben velo kibbel hannezirut o sheggillechuhu kerovim, o micha o shemmichuhu kerovim, devatel hannezirut. vedavka keshemmicha hu o michu hakkerovim miyyad. aval im hitchil linhog nezirut o shekkibbel alav hannezirut, tu lo matze lemimche lo hu velo kerovim:
Reviit lisa. shemmissea zetim yachol lehotzi reviit hallog shemen:
Potzea. derech hazzetim lefatzan kede lemattek merirutan:
Veochel bassade. dedavar sheddarko leechol hu. aval lasuch lo chazu, veen sachin ella bedavar sheddarko lasuch:
Hichnisu chatzi log. shennitbashshelu ad shehu yachol lehotzi chatzi log missea:
Hichnisu shelish. shennitgaddelu shelish mimma sheatidim lehitgaddel, i nammi shemmotzi mehen achshav shelish mimma shemmotzi lisa keshennitbashshelu yafe:

Kach onatan lashsheviit. en ochlin mehen bashsheviit ad sheyyaggiu leonat maasrot hameforash beferek kamma demaasrot, dedavka teenim vaanavim vezetim regilim leechol kodem bishshulan, lefichach hittiru leechol mehem bassade bashsheviit kodem sheyyaggiu leonat hammaasrot, aval lo bishar perot:
Lo yechappe. habbikkua beafar, shehare hu metakken bechach, sheheafar naase tit umashbiach hailan:
Baavanim uvekash. dahave kemoshiv shomer shello yivash:
Betulat shikma. shello niktzetza meolam:
Mippene shehi avoda. shehi mushbachat bechach:
Kedarkah asur. shehi mitgaddelet umitabba bechach vahave keen zomer laggefanim:
Ella magbiah asara. sheen derech leolam lechartah ella lematta measara:
O gomem meal haaretz. sheen derech lichrot otah kach. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bet shammay omrim hekdesh taut hekdesh. deyalfinan mittemura dahave afillu betaut, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh, vedarshinan yihye lerabbot shogeg kemezid:
Uvet hillel omrim eno hekdesh. delo gamrinan techillat hekdesh, davar sheeno ba mikkoach hekdesh, mittemura shehu sof hekdesh, shebba mikkoach davar acher shehaya hekdesh:
Meematay ochlim perot hailan bashsheviit. mishshum dedarshinan leachla velo lehefsed, veim ochlan kodem bishshulan hayenu hefsed:
Happaggim. pagge teena kedichtiv (Shir HaShirim 2) hatteena chanta faggeha:
Mishshehizrichu. heedimu, vezehu hatechalat bishshulan:
Ochel bahem pitto bassade. aval lelakket ulehachnis labbayit eno rashshay ad sheyyiggamru:

Bichalu. sheggadal harebe, vedome lo vegam nafsham bachala vi (Zecharya 11). uvayrushalmi yalif la middichtiv (Vayikra 25) tihye chol tevuatah leechol uchetiv (sham) min hassade tochlu et tevuatah, bishte tevuot hakkatuv medabber, achat min habbayit veachat min hassade:

Sureya. aram naharayim vaaram tzova shekkavash david, veenah keeretz yisrael lechol davar, mippene shekkevashah kodem shekkavash eretz yisrael kullah, uviktzat dinim asauha keeretz yisrael uviktzatan kechutza laaretz:
Osim betalush. afillu etzel hachashudim, veillu veeretz yisrael tenan lo tavor velo titchan immah:

Aval lo vamchubbar. kegon mesika ketzira uvetzira, vedavka bashshamur, aval bammufkar afillu baaretz muttar, detanya betorat kohanim min hashshamur i atta botzer aval atta botzer min hammufkar. vetaama degazur besureya bimchubbar kede shello yihyu mannichim et eretz yisrael veholchim umishtakkeim besureya, uvetalush hittiru, kede sheyyimtzeu haaniyyim shebbeeretz yisrael ketzat revach besureya shehi kerova lahem, velo yitztarchu latzet meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz:

Kol shekkayyotze vo muttar beeretz yisrael. middeorayta, kegon talush, af al gav demidderabbanan asur belo shinnuy, osin oto besureya ki orcheh veeno tzarich leshannot. i nammi hachi kaamar, kol shekkayyotze vo muttar baaretz bammufkar osim oto besureya afillu bashshamur, aval bimchubbar asur midderabbanan baaretz afillu bammufkar:
Ellu meidim shennadar shetayim. shete neziriyyot:
Veellu meidim shennadar chamesh. beotah shaa sheattem omrim shennadar shetayim, anu meidim shennadar chamesh nezirut. vehu omer shello nadar kelal:
Bet shammay omrim nechleka haedut. hoil umachchishot zo et zo nitbattelu divrehem veen kan edut kelal:
Uvet hillel omrim yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim. vihe nazir shetayim:

Shenehem maalu. vehu sheyyehe oto haetrog shave shete ferutot kemo shennatan lo vaal habbayit. baal habbayit maal kevan shekkana lo hashshaliach kemo sheamar veshave chemo shennatan lo, hare naaset shelichuto. vehashshaliach maal, shehare kana rimmon bifruta middato shello vishlichut baal habbayit:

Rabbi yehuda omer baal habbayit lo maal. deamar leh lashshaliach illu hayita kone etrog bishte perutot kemo shennatatti lecha hayita mevi li etrog gadol shave arba perutot, achshav shello natatta ella feruta heveta li etrog shave shete ferutot shehu katan vera, venimtza shello asita shelichuti. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hareni nazir mea yom nitma yom mea soter et hakkol. rabbanan letaamayhu deamre nitma yom melot keillu nitma betoch zemanno vesoter et hakkol:
Rabbi eliezer omer lo soter ella sheloshim. disvira leh nitma beyom melot eno soter ella sheloshim:

Nitma yom mea veechad. lerabbanan soter sheloshim, degazru yom mea veechad shehu yom tiglachat attu yom mea. umikkol makom lo hechmiru alav laasoto keyom mea shehu yom melot shehu soter hakkol, vegazru sheyyistor setam nezirut shehu sheloshim yom bilvad:
Verabbi eliezer omer eno soter ella shiva. veazda letameh daafillu beyom sheloshim lo gazar beomer hareni nazir setam:

Dishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora. haddeshen shellahem usheyare happetilot shel menora, haya motzi umannichan etzel hammizbeach hachitzon, mekom shemmanniach sham terumat haddeshen shel mizbeach hachitzon. veachar shehotzi sham lo nehenin velo moalim, divhane lo chetiv vesamo etzel hammizbeach kemo vedishshun mizbach haola:

Hammakdish dishshun battechilla moalim bo. hachi kaamar, hammakdish deme dishshun, battechilla kodem shehotzio laazara yesh bo meila. kegon deamar deme dishshun alay veachar kach hotzio lachutz uva acher venehena min haddishshun, af al pi shekkevar naaset mitzvato, afillu hachi moalim bo, dechevan denehena mimmenna vechissar min haddeshen, shuv lekka leshaer kamma hayu damav keshennitarech ze, venimtza ze mafsid lahekdesh, mishshum hachi moel bo lealtar keshennehena mimmennu:
Torin. shehikdishan kodem zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan:

Lo nehenim velo moalim. velo damu limchussar zeman babbehema shehu kadosh kodem zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno, divhema miggo dachashiva deit bah kedushsha cheshehi vaalat mum lihyot tzericha fidyon, it bah nammi kedushsha afillu cheshehi mechussar zeman. aval ofot delekka lememar behu hay miggo, shehare en hammum posel beofot velet behu fidyon, shello neemar pidyon ella vabbehema, hachi nammi en bahen kedushshat mechussar zeman:
Torin shello higgia zemannan moalin bahen. kevan dilkamman mechazu, it behu meila hasheta. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ken shebberosh ilan shel hekdesh. shebbenao haof meetzim vekismin shehevi mimmakom acher:

Shebbaashera yattiz bekane. yappil hakken laaretz bekane veyehane mimmennu. vedavka yattiz. aval lo yaale al haashera, deim ole littol hakken, nimtza nehene min haashera. vehabbetzim vehaefrochim shebbakken, kol zeman shetztzerichim leimman asurim, ben shebberosh ilan shel hekdesh ben shebberosh haashera:
Hammakdish et hachoresh. targum yaar, churesha:
Moalim bechullo. baetzim uvaanafim uvealim:
Haggizbarim shellakchu et haetzim. shekkanu etzim miyyaar shel chullin letzorech korot:
Moalim baetzim. rambam peresh, laatoye chatichot etzim shechotchin bammegera veet shemmetakkenim otan lekorot, shemmoalin bahen:
Lo vashshippuy. nesarim dakkot shennosrin min haetzim keshemmachalikin otan:
Nemiyya. alin shebbaatze hayyaar:
Hachashuda al hashsheviit. leechol perot sheviit achar habbiur belo viur:
Nafa. sheani omer lispor bah maot hi lokachat:
Kevara. sheani omer lichbor bah et hachol:
Rechayim. deshemma litchon bahem sammanin:
Tannur. shemma leyabbesh bo unin shel pishtan:
Velo titchan immah. sheasur lesayyea yede ovre avera:
Uvoreret vetochenet immah. velo asru hacha beeshet am haaretz hachashuda al hammaasrot kidasru bachashuda al hashsheviit, mishshum derov amme haaretz measserim hen:
Aval mishshettattil hammayim. baissa:
Lo tigga immah. lefi shemmishsheggilgela hutbela lechalla veka mittammea mechamat kelim temeim, shehare huchshera lekabbel tuma, vezo mesayyatah legalgel, veasur ligrom tuma lechalla:
Vechullan lo amru. lo hittiru lehasheilan kelim ulesayyean belo sheat avera atzmah ella mishshum darche shalom:
Machazikin yede nachrim. aggav gerara dedarche shalom tana leh hacha, umeforash leel beferek 4:

Chochrin nirin. yachol yisrael lekabbel alav bechach vechach korim leshana sede hannachri shecharashah bashsheviit lezarah lemotzae sheviit, veaf al pi sheggorem lannachri lacharosh bashsheviit. nirin leshon niru lachem nir (yirmeya 4):
Umachazikim yede nachrim. im metzao choresh yachol lomar lo yishar kochacha vechayyotze vaze:
Veshoalim bishloman. vaafillu beyom chaggam:
